title: After the Concubine's Fake Death, the Heir Searches for Three Years
author: Gui Yan Jiu
synopsis:
At first, in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes, Yu Ying was just an ordinary concubine…beautiful, flattering, nothing more than a plaything.

Watching Yu Ying scheme her way up, reveling in her petty triumphs, he treated it all as mere amusement.It wasn't until she faked her death and escaped that Zhao Xuanyou realized; he didn't just covet her beauty, but everything about her, including her cold, icy heart.

Her birth mother was gravely ill, so she sold herself into the marquis' mansion.Sent to the heir's bed by the mistress, she fell into a plot to replace the mother with the child.

After reincarnating, Yu Ying walked alone in the darkness. For revenge, she discarded her dignity and freedom.She never thought someone would walk beside her, hand in hand, all the way to the pinnacle of power.

A pearl in the crown, admired by all.

chapters.title: Borrowing a Womb
chapters.content:
Last night, the rain was sparse and the wind fierce, the embroidered canopy fragrant, spring passion in full bloom.

The lotus flowers embroidered on the canopy trembled slightly, as if buffeted by wind and rain, lifelike.

The unfamiliar bed made Yu Ying uneasy, but she was so groggy she couldn’t muster the strength to escape.

The canopy was dim; she couldn’t see his face, but she knew his identity.

She had already been suffocated to death; how could she still be with him...?

She reached out to push the man on top of her, but her weak hand only touched his solid muscles, like hitting a wall.

This action only amused him further. He seized her fair hand, kissed it, and hoarsely whispered, "Good girl."

Yu Ying suffered in agony before losing consciousness again.

"Wake up! After climbing into the heir’s bed, how dare you sleep so soundly!"

"Shameless! Get up at once!"

Bright morning light spilled into the embroidered bed. Feeling someone scrubbing her face with a wet cloth, Yu Ying struggled to open her eyes.

Zhao Xuanyou’s wife’s personal attendants, Zhou Mama and Baochuan, stood by the bed, glaring at her with disdain, their mouths full of curses.

"You usually seem honest and modest, but who knew you were a vixen!" Baochuan said, yanking Yu Ying upright.

Zhou Mama glanced at Yu Ying’s painfully pale body, her gaze flickering slightly.

Yu Ying, who usually dressed in drab clothes in the flower room, had always seemed pretty but not extraordinary.

But now, stripped of her clothes, she seemed reborn; her skin was delicate, her waist slender, her curves full and firm.

Even Zhou Mama, with her heart of stone, couldn’t help but be moved by such a figure.

A creature of such beauty was absolutely forbidden near the heir, yet Yu Ying’s features bore a resemblance to the heir’s wife, making her the only viable choice for their scheme.

"By the rules, anyone who secretly climbs into the master’s bed and seduces him shall be beaten twenty times with a board and expelled from the marquis’ mansion," Zhou Mama declared sternly.

Secretly climbed into the bed?

In her past life, Yu Ying had been misled by them into believing she had drunkenly stumbled into the heir’s bed, committing a grave sin, and had meekly let them control her.

"In my opinion," Baochuan said sarcastically, "we should throw you onto the street as you are, so everyone can see how cheap you are."

Yu Ying was still unclothed, her ink-black hair cascading to her waist, barely covering half of her snow-white body. Baochuan wished she could spit on her.

Zhou Mama said leisurely, "How to punish her is up to the mistress. But she looks far too indecent right now. Take her away to clean up first."

The heir had already left for social engagements; this was the perfect time to deal with Yu Ying.

Clothes were scattered haphazardly on the floor. Baochuan, supporting Yu Ying, carelessly stepped on a peach-colored undershirt, then two steps later, a green undergarment.

"Tch!" she scoffed, tightening her grip on Yu Ying’s arm.

In the side room, warm water had been prepared. Yu Ying, weak all over, barely managed to stand by the bath tub.

Her porcelain-like back was covered in red marks, and the traces of her first night as a woman extended all the way to her feet.

Baochuan, burning with resentment, scooped up water and splashed it over her head, washing away the blood and other stains.

The scalding water stung, and Yu Ying’s grip on the tub tightened.

It’s all the same. Everything is exactly as it was in my past life.

It had also been the day the heir returned to the capital. The heir’s wife, Madam Cui, had rewarded all the servants with food and drink.

Yu Ying couldn’t hold her liquor, but the head maid, Baozhu, had urged her to drink several cups. Drunk, Yu Ying had spent a wild, passionate night with the heir.

When she woke the next morning, the heir was already gone. Yu Ying was seized by Zhou Mama and others, then taken to Madam Cui for punishment.

Madam Cui had spared her, not pursuing the crime of climbing into the heir’s bed, and instead ordered her to serve the heir in her stead.

Yu Ying had dared not disobey. Every night, she concealed her face and voice, sharing the heir’s bed.

Soon, Yu Ying became pregnant. Madam Cui sent her to a manor to give birth, promising her the position of a concubine after a safe delivery, and even vowed to pay for medical treatment for her ailing mother.

For ten months, Yu Ying was confined to a small, dark room, seeing no sunlight.

Anxious and terrified, she had no way to escape, and could only endure in suffering.

On the day she gave birth to a son, Zhou Mama and the others arrived at the manor. As they carried out their plan to discard the mother and keep the child, they finally revealed the truth.

The fruit wine she had been given that night had been drugged. It wasn’t Yu Ying who had climbed into the heir’s bed; they had carried the drugged Yu Ying there themselves.

This was all part of Madam Cui’s meticulously planned scheme to borrow a womb.

Yu Ying had been chosen because she bore a slight resemblance to Madam Cui, ensuring the child would raise no suspicions.

As for Yu Ying’s mother; she had never received any treatment. She had died months ago!

Each word struck Yu Ying’s heart like a knife.

At her most desperate and weakest moment, they had smothered her with a wet quilt.

Her final memory was the overwhelming suffocation, just like the water being splashed over her face now.

Yu Ying took a deep breath. After the extreme humiliation, hatred, and anger, she surprisingly calmed down.

From outside the door, Zhou Mama said, "Madam has finished her breakfast. Bring that little vixen over for questioning."

"Coming," Baochuan replied, taking a dry silk cloth to wipe Yu Ying’s face.

For a moment, their eyes met, and Baochuan inexplicably felt a pang of guilt under Yu Ying’s clear gaze.

Snapping back to reality, Baochuan put on the air of a senior maid and scolded harshly, "What are you staring at?"

Baochuan truly despised her.

A natural-born vixen, yet she was lucky; her resemblance to Madam Cui had allowed her to share a night of passion with the heir, a man as divine as an immortal.

"Put it on yourself!" Baochuan angrily threw the clothes at Yu Ying and turned to leave the side room.

Yu Ying didn’t rush to dress. Noticing a pot of cold tea on the table, she drank half of it in one go before finally putting on her clothes and pushing the door open.

The room was filled with the scent of expensive incense. Madam Cui Yichu sat in the seat of honor, slowly sipping her tea.

She exuded a radiant, noble, and elegant aura, adorned with gold and jade.

Baozhu, the maid who had urged Yu Ying to drink the night before, stood beside her, fanning her.

"Madam," Zhou Mama said respectfully, "such a lowly creature deserves either a beating or to be sold off. She must be severely punished."

Cui Yichu set down her teacup, her gaze falling on Yu Ying, but she gently shook her head. "Yu Ying, I truly never expected you to do such a thing."

"Caught in the act, Madam must not let her off lightly," Zhou Mama added.

As soon as Zhou Mama finished speaking, Baozhu chimed in, "Perhaps Yu Ying was just momentarily confused. Madam is magnanimous. Why not give her a chance to reform?"

Cui Yichu’s eyes burned with intensity as she looked down at Yu Ying from her lofty position. "Do you have anything to say for yourself?"

Heh.

Watching their flawless acting; some playing the harsh enforcer, others the sympathetic advocate; Yu Ying couldn’t help but sneer inwardly.

If the maids were the ones who directly killed her, then Cui Yichu was the true mastermind behind it all.

First, they had drugged her and placed her in Zhao Xuanyou’s bed. Then, after she gave birth, they had discarded her while keeping the child. Every step had been orchestrated by Cui Yichu.

What was there to say? It was simply a debt of blood to be repaid in blood.

chapters.title: The Stand-in Maid
chapters.content:
A gentle morning breeze blew in from outside, lifting Yu Ying’s hair.

Her eyes were red, filled with fear and terror. She pleaded, "Madam, last night this servant drank too much. I don’t remember anything!"

Revenge was a must.

But for now, she was just a lowly maid. She couldn’t act recklessly; she had to proceed step by step, gathering strength.

If they could deceive her with their acting, then she could do the same!

"Good one, claiming you don’t remember!" Zhou Mama snapped.

"I wouldn’t dare deceive Madam. It must have been the wine... I truly shouldn’t have drunk that cup. Madam, I know I was wrong. Please, spare me. Don’t drive me out of the mansion!" Yu Ying played her part, knowing full well they wouldn’t beat her or expel her.

"Climbing into the master’s bed is no small matter," Baozhu sighed. "I can’t even help you plead for mercy."

Zhou Mama scowled, her voice vicious. "The marquis’ mansion has its rules. If we don’t beat her until her skin splits, other little sluts will follow her example, and there’ll be chaos!"

"Or maybe just ten strikes? Twenty is too harsh," Baozhu said falsely.

"How can we set an example without severe punishment?"

The summer breeze rustled the silver hooks on the window gauze. Listening to the servants’ chatter, Cui Yichu remained composed, leisurely fanning herself.

She held a sandalwood-handled palace fan, its surface painted with a pair of mandarin ducks playing in water; a masterpiece, lifelike and exquisite.

"Yu Ying, were you truly so drunk last night that you were completely unaware?"

Her noble upbringing gave her speech a drawn-out, gentle cadence.

When the slave trader had first brought Yu Ying to the Jingyuan Marquis’ mansion, Cui Yichu had spoken to her in that same warm, kind tone, asking about her age, ancestry, and family.

She had even given her the name Yu Ying and assigned her to work in the flower room.

Yu Ying had always believed Cui Yichu was a celestial being untouched by worldly concerns; beautiful beyond compare, and kind-hearted to boot.

Even when she had inexplicably ended up in Zhao Xuanyou’s bed after a few drinks, even when she later became pregnant and was sent to the manor, she had never suspected Cui Yichu for a moment.

It wasn’t until her past life, when she was suffocated to death, that she realized the cruel heart hidden beneath Cui Yichu’s noble and detached exterior.

She had been so foolish to think Cui Yichu was a good person.

Recalling her past life, Yu Ying’s hatred surged again, and she couldn’t stop trembling.

Cui Yichu cast her a glance with her beautiful, indifferent eyes, but didn’t think much of it.

The heir was a military man, and he looked rough; Yu Ying was young, and it had been her first time. Last night must have been tough for her.

Now, with her life hanging in the balance, it was only natural for an inexperienced maid like Yu Ying to be trembling in fear.

"Madam is speaking to you! Answer her!" Baochuan shoved Yu Ying.

Yu Ying, off-balance, stumbled forward and knelt on the ground.

Noticing the red marks on Yu Ying’s neck, Cui Yichu lightly pursed her lips and asked with concern, "Your body... The heir really doesn’t know how to cherish a woman."

Cherish? Impossible.

She couldn’t drug the heir, so to deceive him, she had ordered the kitchen to prepare many aphrodisiac dishes; bull penis, deer antler, you name it.

Faced with Yu Ying, who had been given a love potion, no red-blooded man like Zhao Xuanyou could have shown restraint.

But of course, it was all her doing. Seeing Yu Ying in such a battered state, she felt nothing but disgust, barely managing to feign concern.

She’s just a lowly slut. If I could bear children myself, would I have let her climb into his bed?

"Madam, please understand," Yu Ying lowered her head, forcing herself not to meet Cui Yichu’s eyes, struggling to stay calm. "This servant doesn’t remember seeing the heir. I truly don’t know what happened last night! I don’t know if I ate or drank something unclean. I can’t recall anything."

At these words, the mistress and her four servants exchanged glances.

The ever-composed Zhou Mama spoke first. "Still trying to talk your way out even at death’s door! Last night, Madam rewarded us with food and drink. Everything the servants ate and drank was the same as the masters’. Do you mean to say Madam’s rewards were unclean? What is your intention?"

"I didn’t mean that. It was my fault; I shouldn’t have drunk when I can’t hold my liquor. I know I was wrong. Please, Madam, spare my life."

Cui Yichu paused for a moment before slowly saying, "The fruit wine from last night was personally brewed by my mother. It was buried under a begonia tree for a full seven years before being unearthed. It tastes sweet, but the aftereffects are strong. How many cups did you drink, you foolish girl?"

"Four."

Of course. Baozhu had urged her repeatedly, saying one moment that she couldn’t refuse Madam’s kindness, the next that it was as fine as drinking fragrant dew. Between coaxing and forcing, she had made Yu Ying drink the drugged fruit wine.

"No wonder." Cui Yichu acted as if she had just realized something, holding her palace fan, gazing at Yu Ying. "Four cups would knock out even a strong man, let alone you."

Yu Ying, having just experienced intimacy for the first time, had flushed cheeks and a delicate, weak demeanor, like a begonia flower drenched by rain; exquisitely alluring.

She looks like me... but even more naturally seductive.

Cui Yichu’s expression subtly shifted, her gaze meaningful.

Seizing the moment, Zhou Mama’s eyes darted as she asked, "Madam, you’re not thinking of promoting her, are you?"

"I’ve been unwell lately. My periods come irregularly, and my body is very uncomfortable. The heir has been stationed at the border for a year, and now that he’s back in the capital, I can’t serve him. I don’t know how to explain this to the heir. Since you and the heir have already... well, it’s a done deal. Yu Ying, from now on, you will serve the heir in my place at night. Are you willing?"

Yu Ying asked cautiously, "Madam won’t punish me?"

Cui Yichu smiled slightly. "You did wrong. Naturally, you must be punished."

Baozhu, catching Cui Yichu’s signal, clarified, "Madam wants you to serve the heir, but not as a concubine. Do you understand?"

"I don’t understand." Yu Ying shook her head, looking at Cui Yichu with feigned confusion. "Madam, if I’m not a concubine, how can I attend to the heir?"

"What’s there not to understand?" Zhou Mama, seeing Yu Ying’s clueless expression, had no choice but to explain more clearly. "Your figure and appearance happen to resemble Madam’s. As long as you don’t speak, you won’t be discovered."

For Cui Yichu, the stupider Yu Ying was, the better.

Watching Yu Ying’s confused look, she felt no impatience, but instead smiled warmly at her. "Do you understand now?"

Understand? Of course I do.

In her past life, Yu Ying had spent night after night sneaking into Zhao Xuanyou’s bed, deliberately altering her voice and covering her face, fulfilling Cui Yichu’s wifely duties in her stead.

Suddenly, a rapid footsteps could be heard from outside.

"Madam, the heir has returned!"

chapters.title: Forced to Be a Concubine
chapters.content:
"Prince Heir." The maid in the courtyard greeted loudly.

It was too late for Yu Wan to leave!

Cui Yichu exchanged a glance with Baochuan, who understood and pulled Yu Wan toward the adjacent study.

Just as they rounded the screen, the door was pushed open.

"Madam."

Jingyuan Marquis's heir, Zhao Xuanyou, had a handsome appearance with phoenix-like eyes that sparkled. Despite his young age, he was highly trusted by the emperor, and his every move carried an imposing presence without anger.

Upon seeing Cui Yichu, his gaze softened slightly.

"The door was closed; I thought you hadn't woken up yet."

Cui Yichu, with guilt in her heart, lowered her eyes and gently pressed her forehead. "I didn’t sleep well last night. My body is very tired, and my eyes felt sore, so I had the maid close the door."

Last night... Zhao Xuanyou, of course, had not rested well either. Seeing his wife looking so delicate and shy, he slightly pursed his lips and sat beside her.

Yu Wan stood behind the screen. Following Baochuan’s instructions, she held a feather duster and wiped the antique vases on the display shelf. Listening to the voices outside, she slightly shifted her position and peeked through the gap in the screen.

Zhao Xuanyou was not dressed as a military officer today. His raven-black brocade robe was quite fitted, outlining his tall and straight figure. Without the stern military demeanor, he exuded a refined and elegant charm.

Of course, no matter how he dressed in civilian clothes, his aura was vastly different from the pampered royal relatives in the capital. After years of battling on the battlefield, a cold and sharp aura had long since condensed in his brows and eyes, capable of intimidating the wicked with just a glance.

Thus, when he arrived, the previously skilled actors like Zhou Mama and the others fell silent, shrinking back. Only Cui Yichu remained composed.

"Didn’t the Prince Heir go to visit Prince Ping? Why did you return so quickly?" Cui Yichu asked softly.

Prince Ping had practiced martial arts with the Marquis since childhood and had always maintained a close relationship with the Marquis's mansion. Yesterday, as soon as Zhao Xuanyou returned to the capital, the Prince's mansion sent word, asking Zhao Xuanyou to visit today.

"On the way, I encountered the Prince's mansion guards. They said the Empress Dowager was unwell, so the Prince went into the palace to attend to her."

Yu Wan, peeking through the screen, saw this man, and her fingertips trembled slightly.

She and Zhao Xuanyou had not even exchanged a single word. He did not even know of her existence, yet they had been intimate, and she had even given birth to his son.

Should she rush out? Explain everything to Zhao Xuanyou, tell him that it was she who had shared his bed last night?

Of course not, Yu Wan thought bitterly.

Everyone around was Cui Yichu's people. If she accused Cui Yichu of deception, they would surely counter-accuse her of climbing into bed, brand her as a madwoman, and beat her to death.

Moreover, even if Zhao Xuanyou believed that she had been drugged and sent to his bed, she was just a maid. A noble heir like him had slept with her, so why would he punish his wife over a mere maid?

To seek revenge, she had to proceed step by step and accumulate strength.

She watched as Cui Yichu smiled sweetly, her usually cold face towards the servants now softened. "The Prince Heir must have eaten breakfast in a hurry. Shall I have the kitchen prepare a new meal and send it over?"

"No need."

Zhao Xuanyou had often eaten in the wind and slept under the stars during military campaigns. Food to him was merely to fill the stomach, unlike the nobles in the capital who were particular about their meals.

Cui Yichu was momentarily speechless. Zhao Xuanyou noticed the dark circles under her eyes and realized she had not rested well last night either.

He still did not know that the woman who had shared his passionate night was not the one before him. Thinking that he had been too rough last night, he could not help but say, "If you are tired, go back to sleep. In the Marquis's mansion, it is just Grandmother, you, and me. There is no need to be too constrained by formalities."

Cui Yichu was a legitimate daughter from a noble family, raised in luxury with a large and prosperous clan. The Jingyuan Marquis's mansion, with its single line of descent for three generations, was different; fewer people, fewer restrictions, and stricter rules.

"Grandmother has always been lenient. I have never felt constrained in the Marquis's mansion."

Hearing her response, Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly, looking at her with approval.

Cui Yichu was not only beautiful but also skilled in calligraphy and painting. Her talent and beauty had earned her much praise. At the age of ten, she had been chosen as a companion reader for the princess, frequently entering the palace.

When it was time for marriage discussions, suitors had flocked to her door.

Zhao Xuanyou, as the heir of the Marquis, was a suitable match for Cui Yichu.

However, Zhao Xuanyou had joined the army at a young age and rarely stayed in the capital. Before marriage, he and Cui Yichu had never met. It was the old lady of the Marquis's mansion, Lady Ye, who had arranged the marriage through a matchmaker.

Their wedding night had not been pleasant, but after this return home and a night of intimacy, the estrangement between them had vanished, which naturally pleased him.

"Since I don’t need to go out, let’s go together to pay respects to Grandmother and keep her company for the meal."

"Prince Heir," Cui Yichu lowered her eyes, looking somewhat troubled, "I am too tired, and my appearance is not presentable. It would not be good for Grandmother to see me like this. Today..."

Her dark circles were evident; it was clear she had not slept well last night.

Zhao Xuanyou understood her shyness and asked softly, "Are you in pain? Do you need medicine?"

Facing Zhao Xuanyou's deep, gentle eyes and hearing his soft-spoken question, Cui Yichu felt inexplicably uncomfortable.

Last night, he must have been very satisfied.

She pretended to be shy and turned her face away, nodding. "I just bathed, and the maids were about to apply medicine for me."

"Then rest. I will come back later."

"Thank you, Prince Heir." Cui Yichu smiled, feeling relieved in her heart.

She was the most beautiful woman in the capital, with a cold and elegant demeanor, delicate and charming, and her smile was captivating.

As she watched Zhao Xuanyou leave the courtyard, Cui Yichu's delicate eyebrows lifted, and her expression changed instantly. "Bring her out."

The maids acted in tacit understanding. Baochuan closed the door and stood guard outside, while Baozhu led Yu Wan, who had been pretending to clean behind the screen, out.

"Did you remember everything I said earlier?" Cui Yichu picked up her scented tea and took a sip, her tone noticeably colder than before.

Yu Wan had heard their conversation clearly from behind the screen and naturally understood what displeased her.

Zhao Xuanyou had asked about last night with a noticeably gentler tone, which had obviously provoked Cui Yichu's jealousy.

She lowered her head and replied, "This servant remembers."

Cui Yichu's expression softened slightly at her compliance, then asked, "Baozhu mentioned that you sold yourself into servitude because your mother was seriously ill?"

Yu Wan had relied on her mother since childhood. They had a small house, half an acre of thin land, and lived a poor but peaceful life.

Unfortunately, three years ago, her mother had fallen off a cliff while picking herbs in the mountains and had been in a coma ever since.

She sold the house and the land, but it was still not enough to pay for her mother's treatment. With no other choice, Yu Wan had sold herself into servitude.

Hearing her mention her mother, and recalling how in her past life her mother had died alone and uncared for, Yu Wan's hatred surged again, and her gaze darkened. "Yes."

"Where is she now?"

In her past life, when Cui Yichu had mentioned this, Yu Wan had thought her mother might be saved. Little did she know that Cui Yichu had used it as bait, waiting for her to take the hook.

"My mother lives in the almshouse of Yunshui Nunnery, surviving on the porridge given by the nuns."

Cui Yichu spoke with feigned concern, "With such a serious illness, ordinary doctors cannot treat her. Yu Wan, as long as you complete this task, I will send someone to invite a famous doctor to treat your mother."

"Really?" Yu Wan pretended to be overjoyed, looking at Cui Yichu with gratitude. "Thank you, Madam, for saving my mother's life."

Seeing how easily Yu Wan believed her words, Cui Yichu felt a mix of contempt and satisfaction. After a pause, she continued, "I have always rewarded and punished fairly. As long as you do your job well, I will not mistreat you."

Baozhu, sensing the timing was right, added, "Haven't you understood yet? Now that you have climbed into the Prince Heir's bed, if Madam promotes you, others will follow your example. You should serve the Prince Heir first. As long as you perform well, Madam will naturally promote you to the status of a concubine. Don't rush; go and express your gratitude."

"Really?" Yu Wan looked at Cui Yichu with surprise, as if she had received a great favor.

Cui Yichu gently fanned herself and nodded slightly.

Having been raised in a noble family with strict teachings, her mother had taught her how to manage servants from a young age.

Servants were lowly and foolish, but they were also relied upon to get things done. Therefore, one had to use both the carrot and the stick; punish them and then reward them.

So this time, dealing with Yu Wan, they first caught her in the act of adultery to threaten her life, then offered her the position of a concubine and the chance to save her mother. There was no way she would disobey.

"Madam is generous and does not hold my drunken misconduct against me. Instead, she is willing to promote me. I am willing to be a cow or a horse to repay Madam for the rest of my life."

Cui Yichu was just about to dismiss Yu Wan when she saw Yu Wan kneel down.

"Madam, this servant has one more request."

chapters.title: Turning the Tables
chapters.content:
"What is it?"

"It has been two months since I last saw my mother. Please, Madam, grant me a day off to leave the mansion and visit her." Yu Wan knew that Cui Yichu would not openly mistreat her at this moment and quickly thought of a way to take advantage of the situation.

Cui Yichu was displeased. "It's not your day off this month, is it? Breaking the rules is not allowed."

Yu Wan replied, "It is true that it is not my day off this month, but for the past two months, the mansion has been preparing for the Old Madam's birthday banquet. I have been busy in the flower room and have not had a day off."

Cui Yichu glanced at Zhou Mama, who softly confirmed, "That is true."

"Alright, I will allow you to leave the mansion to fulfill your filial duty. But only this once; do not make it a habit."

"There is one more thing..."

Zhou Mama knew Cui Yichu was displeased and immediately flew into a rage, shouting at Yu Wan, "Don't think that just because Madam has a task for you, you can push your luck. If you do not serve the Prince Heir, there are plenty of others who would be happy to. If I call out in the courtyard now, I don't know how many maids would step forward."

"I would not dare," Yu Wan looked at Cui Yichu with a sorrowful expression, her voice trembling with tears as she pleaded, "It's just that my mother has been without medicine for a long time. Please, Madam, be thorough in your kindness and advance me my monthly allowance..."

Yu Wan's plea was sincere, but in her heart, she was coldly smiling. If Cui Yichu liked to pretend to be kind, then she would give her the opportunity.

Indeed, although Cui Yichu was displeased, she gestured to Baozhu, who understood and took two strings of coins from the nearby vanity case, handing them to Yu Wan.

"Madam has a kind heart. These are a reward for you; your monthly allowance will still be paid."

"Thank you, Madam, for saving my life." Yu Wan gratefully took the money and bowed to Cui Yichu.

Her eyes were slightly red from the tears she had just shed, her hair was disheveled, and her entire being exuded a spring-like allure; both delicate and timid, both clever and enchanting.

Cui Yichu, well-versed in literature, looked at Yu Wan and suddenly thought of a poetic line:

Her cloud-like hair about to brush her fragrant, snowy cheeks.

A mere maid actually had such beauty, somewhat resembling her, but perhaps even more... Her gaze became complex.

Baozhu and Baochuan led Yu Wan out. Zhou Mama noticed Cui Yichu's displeased expression. After the door was closed, she stepped forward and whispered, "She is just a cheap slut. After sleeping with the Prince Heir and not being punished, but instead allowed to continue sharing his bed, she thinks she has gained favor and dares to make demands of Madam. Please do not take it to heart, Madam. She won't be smug for long."

Cui Yichu's eyes turned cold, her gaze flickering.

"Forget it. It's better if she is insatiably greedy. Having to rely on me will make her work harder. Since I have promised her today, you all should also pamper her a bit in private."

"Madam, rest assured. This servant understands."

"I hope she gets pregnant soon."

Zhou Mama said, "This servant has already arranged for the kitchen to prepare special meals for her, adding a dose of fertility medicine every day. There will be good news soon."

"You have followed my mother for many years; I trust you the most," Cui Yichu thought for a moment and said, "Send someone to go with her, to clearly see what her mother looks like. If she disobeys in the future, we can use it against her."

At this moment, with no one else in the room, the indifference in Cui Yichu's eyes vanished, replaced by ruthlessness.

Originally, when she had her accident, it had ruined her body, leaving her with the inability to bear children. Her mother had helped her come up with the plan to borrow a womb, to deceive everyone.

Although Yu Wan was lowly and foolish, her appearance bore a five-part resemblance to Cui Yichu. Moreover, her figure was full and curvaceous, making her a rare, perfect candidate to bear a child for her.

Even if the child did not resemble the Prince Heir but instead looked like Yu Wan, no one would notice the discrepancy.

Unexpectedly, after raising her in the Marquis's mansion for a year, the unremarkable Yu Wan had blossomed into a beauty: a long, graceful neck, delicate collarbones, and a thin dress that failed to conceal her graceful figure.

She tried to stop herself from comparing with this cheap slut, but she could not help but wonder: in the eyes of men, the seductive Yu Wan might be more alluring than her own cold and noble self.

Even without those aphrodisiacs, facing Yu Wan's seductive figure, Zhao Xuanyou might not be able to resist.

Last night, to prevent any mishaps, Cui Yichu had stood guard in the corridor for most of the night. In the quiet of the night, the intimate sounds from inside were ear-piercing.

Yu Wan's tender, coquettish moans and Zhao Xuanyou's satisfied growls echoed in Cui Yichu's mind like a tight hoop, turning her world upside down.

Cui Yichu was furious and swept her hand, knocking over the teacup beside her.

"Come with me."

After leaving the main room, Baozhu went to attend to other matters, and Baochuan led Yu Wan toward the back courtyard.

At the back of the courtyard, next to a low wall, there was a row of ear rooms. Although narrow and dim, they were reserved for the senior maids of the Marquis's mansion.

"You will live here from now on." Baochuan pushed open the door to the farthest room and pointed inside.

The ear room was neat and clean, with all the bedding and supplies provided.

It was clear that this room had been prepared for her long ago. In her past life, she had not noticed any clues and had truly believed that Cui Yichu was being kind, sparing her life and even promoting her.

"Sister Baochuan, I am no longer a maid of the Fangfang Pavilion. Isn't it against the rules for me to live here?"

Baochuan impatiently replied, "Madam is the mistress of the house; she is the rule. If she tells you to live here, then you live here. The flowers and plants in the back courtyard of the Fangfang Pavilion will be your responsibility."

Cui Yichu had ordered that Yu Wan be confined to the back courtyard to prevent Zhao Xuanyou from seeing her.

"Sister Baochuan, when can I leave the mansion?"

"With your disheveled appearance, where would you go? Return to your room and wait. Zhou Mama will make the arrangements."

"Yes."

Yu Wan carefully lowered her head and silently entered the room, sitting there in a daze, thinking about the events of her past life and the path she needed to take in this one.

After a moment, Baochuan entered with a food box and placed it on the table with a thud.

"This is a reward from Madam. Eat while it's hot."

The red-lacquered food box had three layers, with faint steam and aroma wafting out, making one's mouth water.

Yu Wan said, "Thank you, Sister, for conveying my gratitude to Madam."

Baochuan hummed in response, her gaze falling on Yu Wan, causing her to frown.

With her small, delicate face, slender waist, and full, prominent chest, she was a natural-born vixen.

A hint of jealousy arose in Baochuan's heart.

If she had been born with Yu Wan's appearance, Madam would not have needed to go through so much trouble. She could simply promote her to a concubine, and everything would be fine.

She would be absolutely loyal to Madam and could serve the Prince Heir well, bearing him children.

Baochuan suppressed her jealousy and left without a word.

Yu Wan watched Baochuan's retreating figure, her gaze flickering. In her past life, she had not paid any attention to Baochuan. If Baochuan had feelings for Zhao Xuanyou, perhaps she could use that to her advantage, eliminate Baochuan, and cut off one of Cui Yichu's wings.

She opened the food box, and the aroma of the food hit her face.

The first layer contained a plate of pastries: green bean cakes, kidney bean cakes, rose cakes, and chestnut cakes, all steaming hot.

The second layer had three small dishes: scallion oil chicken, vinegar-pickled melon, and stir-fried bamboo shoots.

The bottom layer held a pot of glutinous, fragrant yam and chicken congee.

Each dish was aromatic, as if taken directly from Cui Yichu's own table.

Cui Yichu often rewarded her with rouge and food, promising to invite a famous doctor to treat her mother. Yu Wan had thought she had encountered a kind mistress and was grateful, never suspecting the malicious intent behind it.

From the beginning, she had walked into a huge trap.

They had fed and pampered her only to send her, plump and fair, to Zhao Xuanyou, so she could bear a healthy son to inherit the Marquis's title.

In this life, Cui Yichu, Baozhu, and Baochuan were saying the same things to her, but with a different mindset, Yu Wan now saw the trap in every word.

The elegant and noble Cui Yichu had uncontrollable disdain in her eyes. The experienced Zhou Mama changed her face at a moment's notice. The kind and gentle Baozhu hid a knife in her smile. Baochuan, who had always disliked her, was filled with jealousy.

Enemies surrounded her; she had to find a way to break them down one by one!

chapters.title: Not a Virgin
chapters.content:
Heaven had given her a second chance at life, and she would make those who wronged her pay the price.

Many mysteries swirled in Yu Wan’s mind.

Before her death in her past life, Baochuan had said that Cui Yichu was infertile.

But Cui Yichu had been married for only a year, and the heir had rarely been in the capital. Why had she been so certain of her own infertility? Why had she been in such a hurry to send herself to Zhao Xuanyou’s bed?

A sudden chill ran through Yu Wan as she noticed a detail she had overlooked in her past life.

She had been a virgin, and in the morning, Baochuan had helped her to the side room, washing away the bloodstains on her body.

The bed must have been stained with blood.

Zhao Xuanyou had woken up before her. Even though the bed curtains were dim, if he went to bathe, he would certainly see the blood on his body.

Wouldn’t he find it strange that his wife had bled twice?

Cui Yichu was cunning and vicious, her schemes meticulous. How could she have left such a glaring oversight unless... she had intentionally let Zhao Xuanyou see Yu Wan’s blood?

Yu Wan’s heart pounded violently.

Could it be that Cui Yichu was not a virgin?!

That was why, as soon as Zhao Xuanyou returned, she had hastily drugged and sent Yu Wan to him, deliberately leaving traces of their first time together.

But this fact was too incredible to believe.

Cui Yichu was a legitimate daughter of a ducal family. How could she have lost her virginity before marriage?

The more she thought about it, the more convinced she became.

Cui Yichu had been a royal princess’s study companion, beautiful and talented. With her status, she could have married a prince. Yet, among all the noble sons in the capital, she had chosen Zhao Xuanyou, who was always away leading troops.

The old marquis had passed away years ago, and the old master was injured and recuperating outside the capital. The only person left in the marquis’s residence in the capital was the elderly dowager, who never left her quarters. She would have known nothing about Cui Yichu, let alone her scandalous affairs.

If Zhao Xuanyou found out that she had lost her virginity before marriage, she would be ruined.

How could she make Zhao Xuanyou suspect her...

Yu Wan bit her lip. To use Zhao Xuanyou’s power against Cui Yichu, merely knowing her secret was not enough. She needed to gain Zhao Xuanyou’s favor.

Recalling last night, Yu Wan felt a glimmer of confidence.

At least... Zhao Xuanyou was infatuated with her body. There was still a chance.

Last night, Yu Wan had been exhausted, sleepy, and thirsty.

After all this thinking, Yu Wan was starving. She devoured the contents of the food box, then washed up again. Just as she was about to ask about leaving the residence, Baozhu pushed open the door.

“Have you rested well?” Baozhu asked, her face as warm and kind as ever, like a truly good person.

Yu Wan replied, “Can I leave the residence now?”

“That’s exactly why I’m here. Coincidentally, Cui Rong is going to help the mistress buy rouge, and he can drive you to Yun Shui An.”

“Leave in the marquis’s carriage? How is that possible?”

Yu Wan appeared overwhelmed by the favor. Baozhu smirked inwardly at her stupidity and said gently, “What’s the big deal about leaving in a carriage? The mistress has specifically ordered that, on the surface, you’re still a flower room maid, but in private, your food, clothing, and expenses are to be treated as those of a concubine.”

As she spoke, Baozhu took out a money pouch and handed it to Yu Wan. “Aren’t you in a hurry to get money to treat your mother? This is the monthly allowance for a concubine. The mistress has given it to you in advance. It’s not from the public funds, so on payday, you can still receive your share as a flower room maid.”

According to the marquis’s rules, a concubine could receive two taels of silver per month, which was twice as much as a first-class maid like Baozhu.

Yu Wan, having spent all her money to treat her mother, was penniless. These two taels were crucial.

“The mistress’s great kindness is beyond repayment.”

“Being a concubine is nothing. If you can bear a son or daughter for the heir, you’ll be raised to a concubine and receive five taels a month.”

Listening to Baozhu’s promises, Yu Wan felt like laughing. She feigned ignorance, “The mistress hasn’t borne a legitimate son. How dare I think of such things? Being able to serve the heir as a concubine is already more than enough. By the way, will the mistress grant me contraceptive soup?”

Just now, the food in the box had been laced with pregnancy-inducing medicine. Why would they give her contraceptive soup?

Baozhu’s eyes flickered, and she evasively replied, “Don’t talk nonsense. The mistress is broad-minded and hopes the marquis’s residence will have many branches and leaves. When you go to Yun Shui An later, offer more incense and pray for a child.”

“Really?”

“Of course.”

Yu Wan coldly smiled but said nothing.

However, after a momentary lapse, Baozhu quickly regained her composure. She chatted with Yu Wan for a few moments, reminded her to return early, and then left.

Yu Wan put away the silver, exited the marquis’s residence through the side gate, and saw a green-curtained carriage waiting there.

“Are you Yu Wan?” A young servant standing by the carriage asked. It was Cui Rong, Cui Yichu’s personal servant.

“Yes.”

“Let’s go.”

Cui Rong appeared to be in his twenties, with a lean and agile figure. After waiting for Yu Wan to board the carriage, he quickly drove toward Yun Shui An.

Yun Shui An was located in a remote town in the west of the city. The abbess, Hui Jing, had been a medical woman before becoming a nun. She used the temple’s incense money to build a charity hall, providing shelter, food, and cheap medicine to homeless women.

After getting off the carriage, Yu Wan saw Cui Rong following closely. Knowing that Baozhu must have instructed him to keep an eye on her, she said nothing and headed straight into the temple.

The nuns in the temple were familiar with Yu Wan. Seeing her come to visit her mother, they kindly led her to the charity hall.

The charity hall was small, crowded with more than twenty people, each with only a wooden board as a bed.

Yu Wan’s mother lay at the very back, just as motionless and emaciated as when Yu Wan had last seen her.

“Mother.” Yu Wan knelt beside her mother, tears welling up in her eyes.

Many women in the charity hall were like Yu Wan’s mother; critically ill, homeless, and left with no means of survival after falling ill. They could only wait for death.

A foul odor permeated the air. Yu Wan noticed Cui Rong covering his nose. She deliberately sat in front of the wooden bed, wiping her tears, watching as Cui Rong’s expression grew increasingly unpleasant. She then stood up and left Yun Shui An.

“This hall is full of women. You might be uncomfortable here. There’s a teahouse over there. Why don’t you order some food? I need to get medicine for my mother and prepare it. It will take a while.”

Cui Rong, of course, did not want to stay in Yun Shui An. However, since Baozhu had ordered him to keep a close watch on Yu Wan, he was in a difficult position.

Seeing his hesitation, Yu Wan gave him a generous amount of money for drinks, finally persuading him to leave.

Once Cui Rong entered the teahouse, Yu Wan went to the town’s medical clinic.

Today’s outing was not solely for visiting her mother but to address a more urgent problem.

If she did nothing, she would be pregnant within a month. Cui Yichu would immediately send her to her maternal family’s estate, and then she would have no chance to turn her situation around.

Yu Wan prepared a fragrant sachet to refresh her mind and obtained several doses of contraceptive medicine. The doctor, seeing her young age, was initially reluctant to provide it. Fortunately, Yu Wan had enough money to persuade him. She returned to Yun Shui An and immediately brewed and drank the medicine.

This trip was all about obtaining the contraceptive medicine.

As for her mother, her illness could not be cured by quack doctors or cheap medicine.

Yu Wan paid a generous amount of incense money and moved her mother from the dark, windowless charity hall to a nearby meditation room.

As she left, Yu Wan looked back at her unconscious mother and silently vowed that the next time she came to Yun Shui An, she would bring her mother to see a famous physician.

Yu Wan did not stay long at Yun Shui An. On her way back, she begged Cui Rong to take her to the docks.

Cui Yichu had assigned her to tend to the flowers and plants behind the main courtyard, clearly intending to isolate her from others.

This time, under the pretext of visiting her mother, she had managed to leave the residence. Whether she could do so again next month was uncertain. She needed to establish a contact outside the marquis’s residence who could assist her.

---

chapters.title: Secretly Making Plans
chapters.content:
Cui Rong was sent by Madame Zhou to monitor Yu Wan and was naturally unwilling to take her to the docks.

Yu Wan had no choice but to flatter Cui Rong and slip him some money. Seeing the money, Cui Rong’s eyes lit up. He took the money, drove her to the docks, and even warned her not to tell anyone.

Money could make the devil push the millstone. It seemed that taking more money from Cui Yichu was the right decision.

The docks were the busiest place in the capital, with merchant ships from all over coming and going. People from all walks of life gathered here.

Yu Wan got out of the carriage and looked around. After many inquiries, she finally found the person she was looking for.

Back in the village, there had been a cowherd named Chen Da Niu who often received help from Yu Wan’s mother. Later, after Chen Da Niu’s parents passed away, he was taken to the capital by his clan elders to make a living. It was said that he worked at the docks, helping to load and unload goods.

Seeing Yu Wan, Chen Da Niu was very surprised. After all, it had been four or five years since they last met.

Without time for pleasantries, Yu Wan got straight to the point and told Chen Da Niu that her mother was seriously ill and recovering at Yun Shui An.

Chen Da Niu earned twenty copper coins a day from heavy labor at the docks. Yu Wan gave him a string of coins and asked him to go to Yun Shui An to help take care of her mother.

With the kindness of Yu Wan’s mother and the chance to escape the hard labor at the docks, Chen Da Niu was more than willing. They agreed that he would go to the marquis’s residence to find her in five days.

Yu Wan acted swiftly and did not linger. She returned to the marquis’s residence while it was still early, and even Madame Zhou did not suspect anything.

However, when Baochuan saw her return, she immediately took her to the ear room in the back courtyard. “You don’t need to worry about the flowers in the courtyard. Just rest during the day and serve the heir well at night. And don’t wander around. Be ready to serve at any time.”

Sure enough, they intended to prevent Yu Wan from interacting with others.

“Do I have to serve the heir tonight as well?”

“Aren’t you willing?” Baochuan said with displeasure.

Seeing the jealousy in Baochuan’s eyes, Yu Wan said, “In noble families, when they promote a concubine, isn’t it usually from the mistress’s personal maids? If you ask me, Sister, you’re so beautiful and trusted by the mistress. You should be the one serving the heir.”

How could Baochuan not have thought the same?

But the heir was sharp-eyed. The mistress did not dare to drug him, so she had to find someone who looked like her. How could she have chosen Baochuan?

“It’s not your place to comment on the master’s affairs.” With that, Baochuan angrily slammed the door and left.

Yu Wan found it amusing and then turned her thoughts to the current situation.

Cui Yichu had ordered Baochuan to take care of her and keep her in the room to rest, which was a way to keep an eye on her.

With such “careful attention,” she couldn’t even see Zhao Xuanyou, let alone seduce him.

She wanted to get close to Zhao Xuanyou, but that could only happen if Cui Yichu arranged it.

In her past life, every night she had to drink the sedative soup given by Cui Yichu before serving him.

Those drugs were not aphrodisiacs. They only made her consciousness blurred, leaving her unable to do anything properly except that one thing.

---

Twilight fell, and the various courtyards of Jingyuan Marquis Residence were gradually lit with lanterns.

Cui Yichu sat in her room, restless. She tried to pick up a brush to copy a scripture, but she couldn’t calm her mind.

“Why are you so worried, Mistress?” Baozhu, who had served her since childhood, knew her thoughts best. She brought over tea and softly comforted her. “The most difficult first night has passed smoothly. There won’t be any problems in the future.”

“The heir is a general, but he’s not a coarse man. He’s more difficult to deal with than I imagined.” Cui Yichu’s brows remained furrowed. “I won’t be at peace until Yu Wan is pregnant.”

Baochuan entered with a plate of sesame crisp cakes, just in time to hear this. Her eyes flickered, and she stepped forward. “Mistress, there’s no need to worry. Yu Wan has already taken your place for the wedding night. If she can’t get pregnant after a few months, you can always promote another maid to serve the heir. Eventually, someone will conceive.”

Cui Yichu’s gaze shifted to Baochuan, deep in thought.

Baozhu, however, understood that Baochuan’s words had touched Cui Yichu’s reverse scale. She quickly interjected, “The few pots of morning glory in the courtyard are looking wilted. Send someone to the flower room to pick some better ones.”

“Yes.”

Watching Baochuan leave, Cui Yichu’s face showed a hint of mockery. “That girl has grown up. Her thoughts are becoming more active. It’s really time to find her a man and marry her off.”

“Mistress, there’s no need to mind her. She just doesn’t like Yu Wan and doesn’t understand your far-sighted plans. I will reprimand her.” Baozhu had always been close to Baochuan and quickly spoke a few kind words on her behalf.

They were both personal maids who had served her since childhood. Although Cui Yichu was displeased, she wouldn’t do anything to them.

“Fortunately, I didn’t tell her. She’s always been impatient. Who knows when she might let something slip. Normally, it would be fine, but now that the heir has returned, we must avoid any unnecessary trouble.” Cui Yichu rolled her eyes in annoyance. “If she causes any trouble, I absolutely won’t spare her.”

“Mistress is wise.” Seeing that she was truly angry, Baozhu changed the subject. “This morning, someone came from the ducal mansion to deliver a message.”

“What did Father and Mother say?”

“The duke still urges Mistress to be careful and not to let the heir discover any flaws.”

Cui Yichu sighed. “Don’t I know that? If I’m not careful, it will be my ruin.”

When she had married, the duke had repeatedly warned her that Zhao Xuanyou’s martial arts were profound and unfathomable. He had secured his position in the court at a young age and was not someone who could be easily fooled like the idle noble sons in the capital.

That was why she had come up with this perfect plan: finding Yu Wan, who resembled her, burning aphrodisiac incense in the room, and adding some male tonics to his food and drink.

“Is the kitchen still preparing deer antler soup every day?”

“Aunt Yu is someone we brought from the ducal mansion. She’s thorough in her work. Besides deer antler soup, she’s also prepared tiger bone wine, all used in cooking.”

Hearing this, Cui Yichu finally nodded in satisfaction. “The prince’s mansion has called the heir again. He might return late. Send someone to wait at the residence gate. As soon as he enters, come and report.”

“Should we have Yu Wan serve the heir tonight?”

“Let’s play it by ear. Maybe he’ll come back drunk.”

---

Baochuan, having been reprimanded, felt extremely stifled.

Yu Wan was right. In other families, the mistress would promote her own personal maid to be a concubine. Why did her mistress have to make things so complicated?

The loss of virginity had already been concealed. Why insist on Yu Wan bearing the child?

Why not promote her to be a concubine?

Looking at the row of wilted morning glories by the courtyard wall, Baochuan couldn’t help but sigh. The mistress appeared gentle, but she was cold-hearted. Once she made a decision, even the duke couldn’t interfere. It seemed she was doomed to be a maid for life.

Just as she was about to assign a servant to go to the flower room, she turned and saw Yu Wan walking through the moon gate from the back courtyard.

“Why are you out here? Didn’t I tell you to rest?”

Yu Wan replied, “The teapot ran out of hot water. I came out to get some.”

Baozhu’s jealousy grew even stronger. They were both maids, yet while she bustled about, Yu Wan lounged in the room drinking hot water!

“The flowers in the courtyard are about to wither. Go to the flower room and pick some better ones to replace them.”

Earlier, she had said Yu Wan didn’t need to do any work, but now she immediately assigned her a task.

Seeing Baochuan’s unhappy expression, it seemed she had been scolded by Cui Yichu.

“Yes.”

Yu Wan went to the flower room and got a wheelbarrow. She returned the dozen or so morning glories that had passed their blooming period from Ling Fang Guan to the flower room, then carefully selected fresh flowers to send to Ling Fang Guan.

Baozhu came out of the main house and bumped into Yu Wan bustling in and out. She looked at Baochuan with a helpless expression. “Why are you making her do this? Let her stay in the room more to avoid being seen by the heir.”

Baochuan was unimpressed. “There’s someone waiting at the residence gate. As soon as the heir returns, I’ll have Yu Wan go in.”

The flower room was in a remote location, and the masters would never pass by there. It seemed there would be no trouble, so Baochuan didn’t say anything more and went to prepare the evening meal for the heir and his wife.

Yu Wan worked alone, bustling back and forth for a full hour before everything was arranged to her satisfaction.

Night had completely fallen.

Looking at the full flower wall, Yu Wan realized she had missed a pot of crape myrtle. She turned back and hurried to the flower room, picked the best blooming crape myrtle, held it in her arms, and quickly made her way back to Ling Fang Guan.

As she hurried along, someone suddenly blocked her path.

chapters.title: An Unexpected Marriage
chapters.content:
"How do you walk? Don't you know you've bumped into the heir?"

Yu Yuan was slightly taken aback. She lowered the zhiwei flower in her arms, only then noticing a young servant boy in blue standing before her. He was about fifteen or sixteen years old, with a youthful face.

Behind the servant boy, a tall and straight figure stood hidden in the night.

Although his features were not clear, the outline alone made it clear that it was Zhao Xuanyou.

She had seen him too many times in the military camp.

Why was Zhao Xuanyou here? This small path was only used by the rough servants and maids of the Marquis's mansion, not to mention carrying flowers and vegetables, but even the chamber pots from each room were sent this way for cleaning.

Before Yu Yuan could think further, she lowered her head and curtsied to him, "This servant greets the heir."

Her voice was clear and carried a soft, sweet tone. Zhao Xuanyou inexplicably found it somewhat familiar.

"Which courtyard are you from?"

"In response to the heir, this servant works in the Liu Fang Pavilion."

Upon hearing that she was a maid from Liu Fang Pavilion, Zhao Xuanyou took a few steps forward. The young servant boy, who had been blocking Yu Yuan, quickly stepped aside.

Yu Yuan looked up at the right moment, and her gaze met Zhao Xuanyou's.

It was a clear night, with moonlight washing over the quiet Jingyuan Marquis's mansion, casting a thin, pale yellow veil over it.

Under the moonlight, the girl had features as delicate as a painting, as soft and tender as the fresh flowers she held. The thin clothes she wore swayed with the night breeze, making her appear even more graceful and charming.

Her facial features bore some resemblance to Cui Yichu, but she was in no way inferior in beauty to Cui Yichu, who was renowned for her beauty in the capital.

Cui Yichu was cold and delicate, while she was enchanting and graceful.

Under such moonlight, her allure seemed even more outstanding.

However, Zhao Xuanyou, hardened by years of battlefield experience and with a heart of steel, was not easily swayed by beauty.

He was just a little puzzled. This maid not only looked like his wife, but even her trembling voice sounded somewhat familiar.

"What is your name?"

"Yu Yuan."

The maids that Cui Yichu had added were all named with characters like hairpins, rings, jade, and treasures.

She lowered her eyes, looking aggrieved as she explained, "This servant was just focused on walking and did not see the heir. I have bumped into the heir. Please, heir, spare this servant this time."

Zhao Xuanyou was a noble heir. Outside, he led troops in battle with decisive actions, so he certainly wouldn't hold a grudge over such a small matter.

Moreover, it wasn't Yu Yuan's fault. Today, he had returned from socializing, feeling a bit drunk and very tired, so he had taken this shortcut through the side gate used by the servants.

But Yu Yuan's appearance bore some resemblance to his wife, especially her pleading voice, which made Zhao Xuanyou unable to help but recall the taste of that night.

As the night breeze blew, he sobered up a bit, feeling an inexplicable restlessness. He waved his hand, indicating he had nothing more to say.

"Go."

"Thank you, heir." Yu Yuan, holding the zhiwei flower, silently stepped aside.

Zhao Xuanyou led his attendant straight ahead. When he had walked far away, Yu Yuan did not follow.

Judging by the direction he was heading, it should be towards Liu Fang Pavilion.

If they entered one after another, Cui Yichu would certainly know they had met.

After some thought, Yu Yuan simply turned and walked towards the greenhouse.

"Didn't you say you were staying in the study tonight, my lord?" The attendant saw Zhao Xuanyou striding towards Liu Fang Pavilion and couldn't help but ask curiously.

Zhao Xuanyou neither confirmed nor denied.

Tonight, he had drunk a bit too much at the prince's mansion. His body carried a strong smell of alcohol. Originally, he had intended to stay in the study, but now... he just wanted to see Cui Yichu as soon as possible.

This trip back to the capital, his wife had given him too many surprises. This marriage was indeed the right choice.

When the Marquis of Jingyuan was young, he had been injured, leaving him with a serious illness. Therefore, he had high expectations for Zhao Xuanyou. When Zhao Xuanyou was ten years old, he took him to the military camp, letting him familiarize himself with his old subordinates, who taught him martial arts and military strategies personally.

By the time the Marquis of Jingyuan's wife passed away, the Marquis's body could no longer handle the heavy military affairs. At the age of fifteen, Zhao Xuanyou took on the responsibility, establishing military merits and stabilizing the power of the Marquis's mansion, which also delayed his marriage.

When his grandmother wrote to say she wanted to arrange a marriage for him with Cui Yichu, the most beautiful woman in the capital, he had no objections.

Zhao Xuanyou rarely stayed in the capital. Due to the separation of genders, he had never seen Cui Yichu, but since his grandmother said she was good, she must be extremely good.

However, due to his busy military affairs, he only returned to the capital ten days before the wedding.

Feeling that he had let Cui Yichu down, he doubled the betrothal gifts.

On the wedding night, when he lifted the bride's red veil, he indeed saw a beautiful woman with elegant and refined features.

But the beauty had slightly furrowed eyebrows, with a hint of sadness in her eyes.

She stood up and gave Zhao Xuanyou a graceful bow, saying that she had caught a severe cold a few days ago and might not be able to serve her husband on their wedding night.

Although Zhao Xuanyou was a military general, he was not a vulgar man. Even though he felt disappointed, he knew to take care of his wife. After accompanying her for three days of returning to her maiden home, he received orders from the Ministry of War to go and quell a rebellion, which kept him away for a year.

It was only when he returned to the capital yesterday that he finally consummated his marriage with his wife.

Just one night of intimacy had swept away all of Zhao Xuanyou's dissatisfaction from the past year.

"My lord?" Seeing Zhao Xuanyou lost in thought, the attendant couldn't help but ask.

Zhao Xuanyou said nothing and quickly walked away.

Inside Liu Fang Pavilion, Cui Yichu had just washed her feet and was drinking a calming soup. The old servant guarding the courtyard gate saw Zhao Xuanyou standing at the entrance. Remembering Zhou Mama's instructions, she loudly announced, "The heir is here."

Zhao Xuanyou slightly furrowed his brows, his expression displeased.

The maids and servants in Liu Fang Pavilion were always startled and flustered. When he came in the morning, they had also shouted loudly in the courtyard, as if they were guarding against him.

Zhao Xuanyou strode into the house and entered the inner room, where he saw Cui Yichu, dressed neatly, coming out to greet him.

"You've returned to the mansion, my lord?" Cui Yichu's eyes were full of surprise, but there was no joy to speak of.

Facing this gaze, Zhao Xuanyou, who had been in high spirits, felt somewhat disappointed.

However, since he had the intention to be a good husband, he still sat down next to Cui Yichu and responded with a deepened voice, "Mmm."

Cui Yichu had calmed her mind by now and noticed his displeasure. She forced a smile and softly said, "You left late, my lord. I thought you would return very late tonight."

At these words, Zhao Xuanyou's gaze softened slightly. "I drank a lot at the banquet. I'm a bit hungry now."

"I'll have the kitchen send something over."

Cui Yichu stood up as she spoke. Zhao Xuanyou reached out to hold her, "Let the maid go. There's no need for you to go yourself."

"Since you rarely return to the capital, my lord, I naturally want to take care of everything personally. Chef Yu from the kitchen is someone I brought from the Duke's mansion. She has excellent cooking skills. I've been eating her food since I was a child. Why doesn't my lord try it?"

Zhao Xuanyou let go of her hand. Cui Yichu lowered her eyes with a smile and stood up to walk out, with Baozhu following behind her with her head lowered.

When they reached the corridor, Cui Yichu ordered the maid to prepare a sobering soup for Zhao Xuanyou and then softly said, "Prepare a calming soup for Yu Yuan as well. She should be on call at any time."

Baozhu's eyes flickered. Cui Yichu noticed the strange look and frowned, asking, "What's wrong?"

"Some of the flowers in the courtyard have withered. Yu Yuan is busy in the greenhouse right now."

"Didn't I tell you..." Cui Yichu's usually indifferent face suddenly showed anger. Seeing Baozhu lowering her head, she suddenly understood. When Baopeng walked over, she raised her hand and gave her a slap.

"Idiot!"

---

chapters.title: Entering the Bridal Chamber Again
chapters.content:
After returning to the greenhouse, Yu Yuan put down the zhiwei flower in her hands and leisurely began to look at the flowers.

When she heard hurried footsteps outside the greenhouse, a faint, almost imperceptible smile appeared on her lips.

"Yu Yuan, come out here!"

Behind her, she heard Baopeng's flustered and angry voice.

Yu Yuan put down the flowerpot in her hands and turned to face her. Seeing the clear fingerprint on her cheek, she put on an innocent and surprised expression, "Sister Baopeng, what happened?"

Baozhu and Baopeng were both senior maids in the Marquis's mansion. The Old Dowager had not managed household affairs for many years, so their status was extremely high as they had served Cui Yichu since she was young. Even Zhou Mama was a step below them.

The only one who could directly slap Baopeng was Cui Yichu.

Baopeng was seething with anger, but since Cui Yichu was urgently looking for someone, she didn't dare to delay. She suppressed her anger and said, "Return to Liu Fang Pavilion."

"Yes."

Yu Yuan answered obediently, picked up the zhiwei flower from the ground, and followed Baopeng back to the courtyard.

At this moment, Cui Yichu was accompanying Zhao Xuanyou in the warm pavilion for dinner. The orange lamp light spilled out, casting a hazy and tranquil glow on the window gauze.

Yu Yuan put down the zhiwei flower and looked at the two intimate figures inside through the window. She secretly made up her mind to tear this tranquility apart.

Back in the side room, a clean and neat nightgown was already laid out on the table. The quality of the fabric made it clear that it was valuable, the kind only Cui Yichu could use.

"Change into these clothes and wait in the room."

After saying this, Baopeng went to the main room. The slap she had received was quite heavy, and half of her face was red. She couldn't go in to serve in this state.

After waiting for a while in the corridor with her head down, she saw Baozhu sending a small maid in to clear the table.

"Where is Yu Yuan?"

"She's waiting in the room."

Baozhu nodded and added, "The mistress is in a bad mood. Be careful with your work."

"I understand." Baopeng knew her mistress's methods well and didn't dare to disobey.

"Sister Baozhu, the mistress's calming soup is ready."

A small maid carried a tray over. Baozhu took the tray and entered the room. Seeing Cui Yichu's inquiring gaze, she subtly nodded.

"Mistress, it's late. Why not rest?"

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou say this, Cui Yichu secretly blamed Yu Yuan for being too seductive, luring him to the point where he couldn't let go. However, her face still held a smile, "Baozhu, go and attend to the heir's change of clothes. I'll come after I drink my calming soup."

Baozhu was about to step forward when Zhao Xuanyou raised his hand to refuse, "No need."

Having been away for many years, he had long been used to dressing himself and didn't need servants to attend to him.

Cui Yichu smiled gracefully and watched him enter the inner room. Only then did she give Baozhu a meaningful look.

"Is the medicine for Yu Yuan ready?"

"It's ready."

"Don't use the aphrodisiac tonight." After all, Yu Yuan was going to serve Zhao Xuanyou in her place. If she kept feeding her aphrodisiacs to make her overly lascivious, it would damage her reputation as a noble daughter of the Duke's mansion.

"It's a sleeping draught. I guarantee that Yu Yuan won't last long after entering."

Now that the first night had passed smoothly, in the future, they just needed to make Yu Yuan unconscious and let Zhao Xuanyou do as he pleased.

Cui Yichu finally felt at ease. She slowly drank her calming soup before entering the inner room.

Zhao Xuanyou had already changed into his nightclothes. Seeing her enter, he sat at the edge of the bed and smiled at her.

Cui Yichu looked at him, her emotions surging.

Initially, when her family had chosen the Marquis of Jingyuan's mansion as her marital home, she had been unwilling. Later, when she heard about Zhao Xuanyou's iron-fisted methods on the battlefield and in the court, and knowing the high status and power of the Marquis of Jingyuan's mansion, she gradually developed an admiration for him.

The moment she saw Zhao Xuanyou on their wedding night, the slight disappointment in her heart completely vanished.

She had meticulously planned all of this to have a long life with Zhao Xuanyou.

After working so hard to set this up, she couldn't afford to reveal any flaws now.

Baozhu walked to the cabinet and flipped through the clothes inside. Turning back, she said, "I can't find the new nightgown that the mistress had made."

"Maybe it was put in the side room?" Cui Yichu put on an annoyed expression, walked to the cabinet, and looked inside. "Forget it. I'll go find it myself."

Zhao Xuanyou, however, raised an eyebrow, "It's just a nightgown. We can look for it tomorrow."

A spring night is worth a thousand gold. Anyway, it's all going to come off.

Cui Yichu pretended to be shy and lowered her eyes, "My lord doesn't understand. The new one fits better and looks better."

"Oh?"

"Never mind, my lord. Let's sleep first." Cui Yichu said this and turned to blow out the candles in the room, then left with Baopeng.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't think much of it and lifted the curtain to lie down first.

Yu Yuan, waiting in the corridor, saw the lights go out in the room and knew it was about time.

Soon, Cui Yichu came out and saw that Yu Yuan had already changed into her nightclothes. Her expression softened slightly.

"Did you drink the pregnancy-preventing medicine?"

"Yes, I did." In reality, she had only sipped a little. While Baopeng wasn't paying attention, she had poured the entire bowl of medicine into the courtyard.

Anyway, it was dark, and no one could see. By morning, the stone slabs would be dry.

She heard Cui Yichu lower her voice and instruct, "Serve him well when you go in. If you can get pregnant, I will definitely promote you to the rank of a concubine."

Yu Yuan put on a panicked look, shook her head at Cui Yichu, and softly said, "This servant doesn't dare."

Her fair and delicate face was indeed moving. Even Cui Yichu, who prided herself as the most beautiful woman in the capital, was slightly affected.

The jealousy was fleeting.

No matter how beautiful Yu Yuan was, she was just an empty shell. There was no reason for her to be jealous.

Once Yu Yuan gave birth to a child, this empty shell would be destroyed.

Thinking of this, and seeing Yu Yuan's pitiful appearance, Cui Yichu was left with only disdain and arrogance, "Speak less when you go in, to avoid the heir noticing any flaws."

The more she let her stay, the better. If there was good news within a month or two, it would prevent any unforeseen problems.

Cui Yichu nodded indifferently, "Don't sleep tonight. Wait until the heir is done, then call Baozhu in to attend to him."

"Yes."

Yu Yuan curtsied to Cui Yichu and silently walked towards the room.

Perhaps thick curtains had been intentionally arranged, as even though the inner room had windows on three sides, it was pitch black inside, with not a trace of moonlight entering.

Yu Yuan relied on her memory to walk to the edge of the bed. As she fumbled to lift the curtain and get on the bed, a strong hand suddenly steadied her.

"Why were you in such a hurry to put out the light? Won't you let me see what your nightgown looks like?"

Hearing these warm, heart-pounding words, Yu Yuan felt a bittersweet emotion.

Zhao Xuanyou was a military general. He looked dignified and imposing, making it hard to imagine what expression he would have when saying such intimate words.

In her past life, after she died, Cui Yichu took her son, and Zhao Xuanyou, thinking the child was Cui Yichu's, must have been very heartbroken. The couple probably lived very happily together, and these affectionate words were likely said to Cui Yichu every night.

Feeling the slight tremor in the small hand he held, Zhao Xuanyou simply sat up and pulled Yu Yuan onto the bed, his tone somewhat helpless.

"Why aren't you speaking?"

"No... it's just a bit cold." Yu Yuan tried her best to imitate Cui Yichu's voice, trying to keep her words as short as possible.

It wasn't time to confront Cui Yichu yet. Everything had to be done according to her wishes.

Zhao Xuanyou took the opportunity to pull her into his embrace.

Feeling the man's breath, Yu Yuan felt a moment of helplessness and simply rested her head on his broad shoulder.

She and this man had already been intimate, even having a child together, but this was the first time she had been consciously aware while quietly embracing him.

She realized something.

Zhao Xuanyou had always been sober. Perhaps he had said such intimate words last night as well, but she had been drugged and unable to respond.

But tonight she was sober, and he thought she was his noble wife. So she could do some things as Cui Yichu.

She couldn't do anything too excessive, or it would anger Cui Yichu.

But... causing some trouble for Cui Yichu would be harmless.

Of course, before that, she needed to make Zhao Xuanyou happy.

Yu Yuan's eyelashes trembled slightly. She looked up at his chin, and an idea struck her. Suddenly, she tilted her head up, and her thin lips touched his Adam's apple.

chapters.title: Whispers in the Tent
chapters.content:
She could clearly feel his shoulders tremble slightly, and the arm holding her tightened.

The tent was filled with a sweet fragrance. Yu Wan grew bolder, parting her lips slightly as her teeth gently grazed his Adam’s apple, like a kitten seeking its master’s favor.

Zhao Xuanyou was amused by her playful action.

But before he could say anything, Yu Wan leaned close to his ear and whispered, "Your Highness."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a soft hum, devoid of anger, and instead carried a hint of affection.

He was a sucker for this.

Yu Wan felt a flicker of pride in her heart, but she didn’t dare to go further.

She had just taken the contraceptive decoction today. If they were intimate again, wouldn’t that have been for nothing?

How could she refuse Zhao Xuanyou without angering him?

As she hesitated, the man beside her pulled back her quilt, and a warm breath quickly enveloped her.

He was too tall, too strong.

In his arms, Yu Wan felt like a crepe myrtle battered by wind and rain, powerless to resist.

Feeling her nightgown being removed, Yu Wan managed to call out, "Your Highness."

"Hmm?" Zhao Xuanyou’s deep voice rang out, showing no intention of stopping.

Yu Wan didn’t rush to stop him, only pitifully said, "Your Highness, I’m not feeling well tonight. Can we… skip it?"

Zhao Xuanyou lifted his head, moving his hand to the bedding, his voice softening slightly. "Did last night tire you out?"

"Mmm."

This wasn’t an excuse. Last night, she had been drugged by Cui Yichu. When she encountered Zhao Xuanyou, it was like dry wood meeting a raging fire; she had nearly been burned to ashes.

Zhao Xuanyou let out a heavy sigh, saying nothing, and rolled over to lie down.

Yu Wan blinked, a faint smile tugging at her heart.

With the title of the esteemed wife of the heir and the legitimate daughter of the ducal household, her words carried weight with Zhao Xuanyou.

If the roles were reversed, and she had come to Zhao Xuanyou as a mere concubine, could she have so easily asked him not to touch her?

Yu Wan suddenly had a crude understanding of power.

But right now, she couldn’t even guarantee her own survival, let alone seek power.

Looking at Zhao Xuanyou beside her, Yu Wan took a deep breath, clearing her mind of stray thoughts, and leaned against his shoulder to sleep.

This affectionate gesture softened Zhao Xuanyou’s heart. He lifted his arm to hold her, allowing her to rest her head on it.

"Madame… actually…"

"What is it?"

There was a hint of helplessness in Zhao Xuanyou’s tone. "If you’re not feeling well, why did you order deer antler soup for dinner?"

Deer antler soup?

Ah, right…

Cui Yichu was thorough. Since she had drugged Yu Wan, she must have ensured Zhao Xuanyou wouldn’t remain idle.

Drinking deer antler soup every day?

No wonder… in her past life, Zhao Xuanyou had been insatiable, like a beast at night.

Every morning, Yu Wan felt as if she had been crushed by a boulder, utterly drained.

When she found out she was pregnant, she had even rejoiced at finally being able to stay away from Zhao Xuanyou.

Now, thinking back, it wasn’t entirely Zhao Xuanyou’s fault; Cui Yichu deserved most of the blame.

"Your Highness misunderstood. It wasn’t my order."

"Not you?"

Yu Wan thought for a moment, then blamed Zhou Mama.

"My attendants are all from my maternal family. Your Highness knows that. My parents hope I can bear children for the marquis’s household soon."

"They listen to your mother, not you?"

Hearing this retort, Yu Wan’s heart leapt with joy.

As expected, Zhao Xuanyou disliked others wielding influence in the marquis’s household.

Yu Wan stopped there, then covered for Cui Yichu. "They wouldn’t dare disobey, but Your Highness has been away from the capital for so long. Every time I return to my maternal home, my parents nag me about it, so they remembered."

Zhao Xuanyou thought about how he had been away for a year, and indeed, it had been hard on his wife.

After all, she was still young, and the only elder in the ducal household was his aged grandmother. It was natural for her to want to be closer to her maternal family.

He turned his head and pressed a kiss to her dark hair. "In the future, when I’m not in the capital, you can return to your maternal home more often."

"When will Your Highness leave the capital?"

"Didn’t I just say?"

At dinner, Zhao Xuanyou had already discussed the arrangements with Cui Yichu; he would return to the army on the seventh day of next month.

In her past life, Zhao Xuanyou had only stayed in the residence for a little over ten days before leaving. Yu Wan had known this, which was why she brought it up.

She hadn’t expected him to have already told Cui Yichu.

Fortunately, this mistake could still be rectified. Yu Wan feigned a pout. "Leaving next month is too sudden. I was thinking… could Your Highness find a way to stay in the capital a little longer?"

Cui Yichu was indifferent by nature. During meals, she certainly wouldn’t persuade Zhao Xuanyou to stay longer in the capital.

Moreover, Cui Yichu wanted to pull off her scheme of swapping the child. The less time Zhao Xuanyou spent in the capital, the better; it would prevent him from staying.

But Yu Wan was different.

With Zhao Xuanyou at home, Cui Yichu would have to act with restraint. Without him, Cui Yichu would be the true mistress of the marquis’s household.

No matter what, she had to take the risk. If she could keep him here, her revenge would be twice as effective.

"Earlier, when Madame heard I was leaving next month, didn’t you have nothing to say?"

Sure enough, Cui Yichu couldn’t wait for him to plant the seed and leave.

Yu Wan laughed softly, her voice tinged with grievance. "Your Highness, don’t tease me. With all the maids and matrons around, how could I bring up such things?"

"In that case…" Zhao Xuanyou listened to her aggrieved tone, and unconsciously pursed his lips.

"Is that a yes or a no?"

Hearing her persistent question, Zhao Xuanyou’s mood improved greatly. He said gently, "This isn’t something I can decide alone. I’ll ask around and let you know when there’s news."

"Alright, but…" Yu Wan cunningly added, "You have to tell me secretly, late at night."

"Why?"

Yu Wan tilted her head up, leaning close to Zhao Xuanyou’s ear and whispering, "Otherwise, how can I give my thanks to Your Highness?"

Her words were flirtatious. Zhao Xuanyou had barely suppressed the desire ignited by the deer antler soup, and now it flared up again.

His voice was hoarse as he asked, "What kind of thanks?"

"You’ll know when the time comes."

"Hmph." Zhao Xuanyou chuckled softly.

Tonight, he had agreed not to touch her, but there were plenty of other things they could do besides that.

The room was filled with the promise of spring, but outside on the veranda, Cui Yichu’s face was dark with fury.
