Listening to the tender laughter from inside, the hatred in her eyes was almost palpable.

"Madame, it’s late. Let this servant keep watch here." Baozhu brought over a cloak and draped it over her, urging in a low voice.

Cui Yichu ignored her, instead turning to Baopeng, who was crouched beside the brazier. "Why is there still talking inside? Did you give Yu Wan the sedative?"

"I did." Cui Yichu’s gaze was too terrifying. Baopeng felt as if she might receive another slap, her voice trembling slightly as she replied.

"Did you watch her drink it with your own eyes?"

Baopeng had seen Yu Wan pick up the bowl, but then she had been distracted by her thoughts. When she looked back, the bowl was already empty.

But she didn’t want another slap, so she dared not tell the truth. She firmly said, "I watched her finish it with my own eyes."

Cui Yichu stared at her for a moment, then turned to Baozhu. "From now on, you will watch Yu Wan take her medicine."

"Yes."

Seeing that Cui Yichu’s expression was still unsettled, Baozhu persuaded her bitterly, "His Highness favors Madame. Right now, he dotes on her because he thinks he’s doting on you."

Was that so?

Cui Yichu thought of Yu Wan’s graceful and voluptuous figure, her skin as fair as porcelain, and her hatred grew even stronger.

In bed, she might not be a match for that wretch.

She had long known that powerful men never cared about a woman’s background or status. Whoever could please them in bed was the one they truly favored.

A surge of anger made her instinctively want to kick over the copper pot to vent her frustration. Baozhu, quick-eyed and quick-handed, grabbed her and desperately shook her head.

Zhao Xuanyou was inside. If they made a noise, it would surely alert him.

After the momentary burst of anger, Cui Yichu regained her composure. She closed her eyes and said in a low voice, "Keep a good watch. Bring Yu Wan out before dawn."

---

chapters.title: The First Signs of Passion
chapters.content:
Cui Yichu went to rest in the side room, while Baozhu and Baopeng took turns keeping watch in the corridor.

As dawn approached, Zhou Mama arrived. She was older, and as a long-time attendant of the Duchess, Cui Yichu had consideration for her and didn’t let her take the night shift.

"Did everything go smoothly last night?" Zhou Mama asked.

Baozhu nodded. "Similar to the night before. It’s about time to take Yu Wan out."

"Be careful. Don’t wake His Highness."

These past two days, Cui Yichu’s outbursts had noticeably increased. Baopeng, who had been slapped, knew this, and so did Zhou Mama and Baozhu.

"I know."

Baozhu pushed open the door. The inner room was silent, likely because the two were still asleep. Baozhu walked around the screen, and before she could approach the bed, she heard Zhao Xuanyou’s deep voice.

"Who’s there?"

A general who had fought in battles, no matter how tired or sleepy, remained exceptionally alert.

Baozhu steeled herself and carefully said, "Replying to Your Highness, it’s this servant, Baozhu. I’ve come to help Madame get up."

"The ducal household’s rule?"

Baozhu was taken aback by the question, sensing the displeasure in Zhao Xuanyou’s tone. She quickly explained, "Last night, Madame was unable to accompany Your Highness to pay respects to the Old Dowager. Feeling guilty, she decided to personally make some flaky pastries this morning to apologize to the Old Dowager. She asked me to calculate the time for the Old Dowager’s meal, and said she had to get up now to make it in time for breakfast."

Zhao Xuanyou said nothing more.

Baozhu knew she couldn’t delay any longer. Summoning her courage, she pulled back half of the bed curtains. Glancing at the two people lying inside, she felt her cheeks burn as if they might drip blood.

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes were closed, and the woman beside him was soft and boneless, resting on his arm. Her raven-black hair covered her face and half her body, making her skin look as white and tender as snow.

If Madame were to see this scene, she would likely lose all composure.

Baozhu averted her gaze and softly reminded, "Madame, it’s time to get up."

Yu Wan had woken up by now. Seeing that it was Baozhu, she tried to sit up but was too exhausted. She weakly said, "Help me up."

Baozhu reached out to pull her from Zhao Xuanyou’s embrace, straightening her nightgown.

Just as she was about to help her off the bed, a strong arm wrapped around Yu Wan’s slender waist.

"Grandmother knows of your filial piety. There’s no need for you to do a servant’s work."

Looking at Yu Wan’s sleepy eyes, Baozhu’s heart leapt to her throat, afraid she might lie back down.

Zhao Xuanyou’s alertness was indeed extraordinary. If they didn’t take Yu Wan away now, dawn would break soon, and all their plans would go to waste.

Baozhu, though clever, didn’t dare speak.

If she interrupted now, she would only anger Zhao Xuanyou.

"What’s wrong with a servant’s work?" Yu Wan suddenly smiled softly, her voice weak. "I’m willing to serve Grandmother."

"Hmph," Zhao Xuanyou chuckled softly, then said, "As you wish," and released his hold, pulling the thin blanket over himself as he rolled away.

Baozhu stood there in a daze until Yu Wan pinched her arm, bringing her back to her senses. She helped Yu Wan walk out.

The morning wind was chilly, and Yu Wan, still in her nightgown, felt a bit cold.

"Hurry back to your room." Zhou Mama scolded coldly.

Yu Wan, however, didn’t rush. She asked in a low voice, "Where is Madame? I have something to report."

"Madame is washing up. Follow me."

Zhou Mama’s expression was stern. Baozhu thought for a moment, then led her to the side room.

The side room was originally prepared for Cui Yichu’s sisters from her maternal family to rest when they visited. These past two nights, she had been staying there herself.

It was close to the main house, so if anything happened, she could respond immediately.

As they entered, Baopeng was helping Cui Yichu with her makeup.

Cui Yichu had been staying up late and waking up early for two consecutive days, so the dark circles under her eyes were quite obvious. The previous night had been manageable, but this morning it was harder to conceal, hence the need for powder and rouge.

When Yu Wan entered, Cui Yichu had only finished half of her makeup.

Catching sight of Yu Wan in the mirror, Cui Yichu’s gaze sharpened.

Outside, the sky was just beginning to brighten. As the door opened, Yu Wan entered along with the morning breeze and floral fragrance.

The nightgown she wore was newly made by an embroideress under Cui Yichu’s orders. The fabric was a new imperial bestowal to the ducal household, and though it wasn’t heavily embroidered, its texture was as fine as brocade, and its color was delicate and tender. Worn on her, it made her look as if she were standing in a field of flowers.

However, since it was tailored for Cui Yichu, it didn’t fit Yu Wan perfectly. Especially around the chest and hips, it was snug, barely containing her figure.

Yu Wan wore no powder or rouge, yet she radiated a natural glow, her expression full of springtime allure.

Baozhu immediately noticed Cui Yichu’s mood and quickly blocked Yu Wan at the door. "If you have something to say, say it quickly. Don’t disturb Madame’s toilette."

Yu Wan seemed oblivious to their hidden motives. She respectfully curtsied to Cui Yichu. "Last night, His Highness asked why deer antler soup was being made."

Cui Yichu would have asked about this sooner or later. It was better to come forward first and appear loyal.

"Did he ask about that?" Cui Yichu’s earlier displeasure at Yu Wan’s appearance vanished instantly.

Zhao Xuanyou was indeed sharp; he had even detected the deer antler in the soup. Fortunately, she hadn’t drugged him before, or he would have seen through it immediately.

"Yes."

"How did you respond?" Cui Yichu’s gaze flickered as she pressed further.

If Yu Wan’s answer had been poor, she would have to find a way to cover for her.

"It was Madame’s idea when she returned to her maternal home. The Duke and Duchess sent it to nourish His Highness."

The answer, though not entirely complete, had no major flaws.

Cui Yichu let out a sigh of relief. Looking at Yu Wan again, she felt a hint of wariness. This girl was smarter than she had thought.

"What else did he say?"

Yu Wan lowered her gaze, appearing uneasy. "His Highness did say a lot, but last night I was so exhausted I couldn’t keep my eyes open. I just mindlessly agreed, and after a while, I fell asleep. I was afraid of making a mistake, so I came to see Madame as soon as I could."

"Understood."

After Baopeng finished her makeup, Cui Yichu selected a gilded hairpin and inserted it, then rose to leave.

Yu Wan silently followed behind them. Once they exited the side room, it was still dim outside.

Baozhu sent Yu Wan back to her own room to wait, then, with Baopeng, flanked Cui Yichu on either side as they left the Fragrant Pavilion.

"Do you think Yu Wan is actually quite clever?" Cui Yichu suddenly remarked.

Baozhu draped a thin silk cloak embroidered with begonia flowers over her, not responding. Baopeng, however, instinctively disagreed. "How is she clever? She came to say all this just to flatter Madame."

Cui Yichu coldly laughed. "In any case, she’s far cleverer than you."

Baopeng had struck a nerve again. Afraid of another slap, she shrank her neck and lowered her head even further.

Baozhu seized the moment. "It’s not necessarily cleverness. She’s just quick-witted and sharp. Actually, it’s good that she’s sharp. That way, the child she bears for Madame will be sharp as well."

"That’s true." Baozhu’s words always aligned with Cui Yichu’s thoughts. She agreed, "A dull, pig-like child would be nothing but trouble."

More than Yu Wan’s cleverness, Baozhu was concerned about the scene she had witnessed outside the bed curtains earlier.

Yu Wan had only served His Highness for two nights, yet the way they spoke to each other was already so familiar and intimate.

Even though Yu Wan held the title of Madame, Baozhu knew that no one, not even the real Madame, could speak to His Highness like that.

After serving His Highness just twice, she had already figured out his temperament. The way they interacted was more like a real couple than the actual husband and wife…

But she knew Cui Yichu’s temper too well. If she spoke up now, and they couldn’t immediately kill Yu Wan, it would only infuriate Cui Yichu, and both she and Baopeng would end up as punching bags.

The best course was to wait for Yu Wan to become pregnant as soon as possible, then dispose of her to eliminate any future troubles.

chapters.title: Laying Groundwork Early
chapters.content:
In the kitchen, Aunt Yu had already made preparations. Minced meat, shiitake mushrooms, and flour were all neatly arranged on the chopping block.

When Cui Yichu arrived at the kitchen, the strong smell of cooking fumes made him immediately cover his nose and mouth with a handkerchief before turning and leaving.

"Hurry up and make them. The mistress still needs to deliver them to the Old Dowager while they're hot."

Zhou Mama knew full well that Cui Yichu’s fingers had never touched a drop of water for chores. His offer to make pancakes was just for show to deceive Zhao Xuanyou; he wouldn’t actually cook.

"Yes." Aunt Yu, upon hearing this, quickly began kneading the dough and preparing the filling.

She was also an old servant who had followed from the Duke’s mansion. The Duchess never allowed disobedience, and this young mistress was even more formidable than her mother, so she dared not slack off.

As the oil in the pan heated up, the smell in the kitchen grew even more pungent, and Cui Yichu moved further away.

Fortunately, the pancakes were soon ready. Aunt Yu divided them into two food boxes. One was taken by Baochuan to deliver to the Old Dowager, while the other was brought back to the Liu Fang Pavilion.

By now, the sky had brightened slightly, yet Zhao Xuanyou was still asleep.

Cui Yichu took the food box himself and entered the inner room. Before he could speak, Zhao Xuanyou lifted the bed curtain and sat up.

"So fragrant. Weren’t these made for Grandmother? Do I get a share?"

"Of course. The pancakes are still hot. The heir can sleep a little longer."

Cui Yichu paused by the folding screen, a faint smile appearing on his face.

He was a renowned beauty in the capital, and his smile was especially captivating.

But after Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze lingered on his face for a moment, he inexplicably felt a sense of distance between them.

"I’m going to take a cold bath."

Zhao Xuanyou got up and went to the inner room. The smile on Cui Yichu’s face instantly froze.

Getting up early just to take a bath...

Suppressing his anger, he carried the food box to the warm chamber to arrange breakfast.

Before long, Zhao Xuanyou emerged, fully dressed. The table was already laden with food.

As the couple ate in the warm chamber, Yu Wan also sat in the room, eating the breakfast Baochuan had brought.

Having just been slapped the day before, Baochuan dared not neglect her duties today. She reminded Yu Wan not to leave the side room.

"Shouldn’t the flowers in the garden be taken care of? The lotus bowls in the back courtyard need changing."

"When we need you, we’ll call for you. When we don’t, stay put and don’t cause trouble."

"I understand."

Baochuan rolled her eyes and left. Yu Wan wiped her face with cold water and returned to the table to eat.

The food in the box wasn’t as exquisite as the previous day’s, but it was far better than what the maids ate.

There was a bowl of yam porridge cooked with red dates and goji berries, a dish of pickled melon, and a dish of chicken shreds with sugar and oil. Thinking of the deer antler soup Zhao Xuanyou had mentioned last night, she realized that all these dishes were medicinal meals meant to aid conception and pregnancy.

No wonder she had conceived within a little over a month in her past life.

Yu Wan was relieved that she had insisted on going out yesterday to buy contraceptive medicine. She was also relieved that she hadn’t slept with Zhao Xuanyou last night.

There were still a few doses of medicine hidden in the room, but Baochuan and Baozhu kept a close watch on her, so she had no chance to brew them.

That day, she had instructed Chen Da Niu to look for some contraceptive pills, but she didn’t know if he had managed to buy any. Regardless, she had to hold on until five days later when he came to the Marquis’s mansion.

That day, the weather was warm with clear skies. Zhao Xuanyou was in a good mood and praised the pancakes highly, finishing them all.

"Originally, I only heard that the mistress is skilled in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting. I didn’t expect her to be adept in the kitchen as well."

Cui Yichu gave a gentle smile. "I only know how to make some small snacks. How could I dare claim to be skilled in cooking? The heir mustn’t tease me."

Looking at his shy and modest wife, Zhao Xuanyou recalled the words he had said last night. He softened his voice. "The climate in the capital is indeed much more comfortable than at the border. Such a clear morning, sitting here eating breakfast, is truly a pleasant affair."

Cui Yichu was well-read and intelligent. He understood that Zhao Xuanyou was showing affection toward him.

But he also knew that Zhao Xuanyou was not saying this because of the pancakes. It was that cheap slave, Yu Wan, who had served him well.

But there was no time to resent Yu Wan now.

After a moment’s thought, he felt that Zhao Xuanyou’s words implied that he wanted to stay longer in the capital... That wouldn’t do...

If Zhao Xuanyou wasn’t in the capital, the Old Dowager was elderly, and Cui Yichu could do as he pleased in the Marquis’s mansion. If Zhao Xuanyou stayed, Cui Yichu would have to be cautious in everything he did.

However, he didn’t dare to express his true feelings. He could only vaguely agree with Zhao Xuanyou’s words. "The capital is the most prosperous place in the world. Naturally, nowhere compares to it."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod, always feeling that the mistress’s attitude was different from last night.

He raised his eyes and looked at Zhou Mama, who was standing by. His gaze darkened slightly.

Perhaps it was because she was always standing there that the mistress’s words and actions differed between day and night.

Compared to the reserved and restrained mistress, he preferred her nighttime demeanor.

By his usual stubborn nature, he couldn’t stand servants bullying their masters. He wanted to drive her away immediately. However, since she was sent by his father- and mother-in-law, if he dismissed her without cause, they would surely be displeased.

Cui Yichu, unaware that Yu Wan had given his attendants a signal last night, saw that Zhao Xuanyou was silent. He could only probe cautiously. "Is the heir going out to socialize today?"

"No."

Zhao Xuanyou had entered the court as an official in his teens. He was steady and did not enjoy associating with the idle noble sons of the capital. He had no interest in cockfighting, dog racing, listening to music, watching plays, or drinking and making merry.

Even after returning to the capital, he was extremely selective about social engagements.

"I’d rather stay at home and spend more time with Grandmother and you."

"In that case," Cui Yichu, with ulterior motives, hoped he would go out every day, but could only say, "Yesterday, I delayed paying my respects. Now, the heir can accompany me to see Grandmother."

"Alright."

Zhao Xuanyou stood up, intending to reach for Cui Yichu’s hand. But he saw Zhou Mama and Baozhu quickly step forward, each supporting one of Cui Yichu’s hands to help him up.

Cui Yichu had thick, soft padding on his chest. If Zhao Xuanyou were to touch him in a moment of passion, he would immediately notice the difference in weight.

Therefore, Cui Yichu ordered Zhou Mama and others to stay close at all times, not daring to get too close to Zhao Xuanyou.

"Heir, please."

Cui Yichu smiled warmly, but Zhao Xuanyou felt a sense of discomfort.

This feeling was like returning to their wedding night. He had been full of anticipation, but she had coldly kept him at a distance.

He said nothing more, just raised his eyebrows and walked out.

Cui Yichu followed behind him, with Zhou Mama and Baozhu still guarding him on either side.

The Old Dowager of the Marquis’s mansion lived in the Leshou Hall. This place was located in the northeast corner of the Marquis’s mansion, not in the best position, but the courtyard was spacious. Zhao Xuanyou had spent a lot of money two years ago to renovate it, painting it with bright colors and gold, making it grand and imposing.

Upon entering, there was an exquisitely embroidered "Pine Crane Longevity" screen. As they walked around the screen, the Old Dowager was already waiting for them in the main seat.

The grandson and granddaughter-in-law had come to pay their respects, which delighted the Old Dowager. She held onto them and chatted nonstop. Just as the conversation was lively, a servant came in to announce that the fourth young master of the Anning Marquis’s mansion, Ye Mosui, had come to visit the Old Dowager.

The Ye family of the Anning Marquis’s mansion was the Old Dowager’s maternal family. The Marquis of Jingyuan had not been in the capital for a long time. Before Zhao Xuanyou was married, the Old Dowager lived alone in the Marquis’s mansion and often relied on the care of the Ye family relatives. The two families were quite close.

Especially Ye Mosui, who was cheerful and talkative, and most favored by the Old Dowager. Although he was a nephew from her maternal family, he treated her with the filial piety of a grandson, visiting every month.

Upon hearing that it was Ye Mosui, Cui Yichu’s eyes flickered slightly, and his fingers tightened.

Zhao Xuanyou noticed his momentary loss of composure and frowned slightly, but the Old Dowager did not notice. Her smile deepened. "Quickly, invite him in."

---

chapters.title: Initial Signs
chapters.content:
Cui Yichu forcibly suppressed the unease in his heart and calmed himself down.

The Marquis of Jingyuan’s mansion had few people, and the Marquis and the heir were often away from the capital, so there were few visiting families.

The Anning Marquis’s mansion had no one in the court in recent years and had declined somewhat. However, in the past two years, a favored concubine had emerged from the family, and the Ye family had been entering and exiting the palace more frequently.

If Cui Yichu had a choice, he would not want to associate with the Ye family.

Fortunately, he was already the daughter-in-law of the Zhao family. If the Ye family knew what was good for them, they should not bring up those rumors in front of Zhao Xuanyou.

After a moment, Ye Mosui, dressed in splendid robes, entered Leshou Hall.

He was seventeen years old this year. Without relying on hereditary titles to become an official, his family had sent him to study at an academy, preparing to take the imperial examinations. He was in the prime of his youth.

"Greetings to the Old Ancestor." Ye Mosui stepped forward to pay his respects to the Old Dowager first.

"Don’t stand on ceremony. Come and meet your brother and sister-in-law." The Old Dowager smiled kindly. "You’ve been studying hard at the academy lately. It’s been a long time since you’ve seen Xuanyou."

"Yes, so when I heard that Brother Xuanyou had returned to the capital, I rushed over early in the morning. The Old Ancestor won’t find me bothersome, will she?"

"You child, now that you’re here, you’re not allowed to leave."

Ye Mosui was four years younger than Zhao Xuanyou. When they were young, he had been the one following Zhao Xuanyou around everywhere.

Later, when Zhao Xuanyou went to the military, each time he returned to the capital, it was always in a hurry, so their interactions had become less frequent, but their friendship remained.

Today, upon hearing that Zhao Xuanyou had returned to the capital, he had made a special early visit.

"Younger brother greets Brother and Sister-in-law. Congratulations on your marriage."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded and patted his shoulder. "Haven’t seen you in two years. You’ve grown quite a bit."

Last year, when Zhao Xuanyou got married, Ye Mosui had been injured in a mountain climbing accident at the academy and had to stay in the countryside to recuperate, so he couldn’t return to the capital for the wedding.

Today, he had brought a belated wedding gift.

After a few pleasantries, Ye Mosui became restless. "The weather is nice today. Brother, would you like to go riding outside the city?"

Zhao Xuanyou had just said he wouldn’t go out to socialize, so naturally, he wouldn’t go back on his word.

"I don’t feel like moving. I brought back a few jars of good wine from Yuzhou. If you’re interested, stay and drink with me."

"Excellent."

The three of them stayed in Leshou Hall, chatting with the Old Dowager for a while. Ye Mosui indeed did not mention Cui Yichu’s past, and they had a pleasant conversation.

At noon, they had lunch there. After the Old Dowager went to her room for a nap, Cui Yichu also returned to the Liu Fang Pavilion. Zhao Xuanyou took Ye Mosui to the study.

"Last time you wrote that you were studying hard at the academy. How come you’re back in the capital again?"

Ye Mosui gave a hey-hey laugh. "You know I’m not cut out for studying to become an official. I can only endure ten days or half a month before I have to return to the capital."

"If you’re not cut out for studying, why not go back to Yuzhou with me and join the army?"

Hearing the teasing in Zhao Xuanyou’s voice, Ye Mosui laughed. "I’d like to go, but I’m afraid that after a few days, you’d blame me for corrupting military discipline and send me back to the capital."

"You try this Qing Zhu wine from Yuzhou." Zhao Xuanyou knew his temperament well. He was a young master who loved romantic pleasures. How could he endure the hardships of the border? He was just teasing him.

Ye Mosui picked up the wine cup, took a few sips, and then downed it in one go.

"Truly strong."

"Another cup?"

Ye Mosui shook his head repeatedly, feeling a burning sensation in his throat. "No, I’ll stick to the apricot blossom wine brewed by the Marquis’s mansion."

The two of them drank and chatted, and soon both were slightly tipsy.

"When I first heard the news of your engagement, I was a bit worried," Ye Mosui said, putting down his wine cup. "But seeing you and Sister-in-law so harmonious today, I’m relieved."

The speaker had no intention, but the listener did.

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes narrowed slightly. He asked in a deep voice, "What made you feel uneasy?"

Facing his profound gaze, Ye Mosui suddenly sobered up a bit. He realized he had misspoken but didn’t know how to rectify it. He scratched his head and stammered, "It’s just... I heard some rumors before."

"About the mistress?"

Ye Mosui was backed into a corner and could only nod. "Sister-in-law has a good background, good looks, and a good temperament. There must be many who are jealous of her, so they spread some rumors..."

"What rumors exactly?" Zhao Xuanyou’s tone had noticeably hardened.

Ye Mosui twisted his hands and feet. "If I had told Brother before the marriage, I would have. But now that you two are happily married, if I say anything, wouldn’t that make me a petty person?"

When he had first heard that the Zhao and Cui families were going to marry, Ye Mosui had hesitated about whether to write to Zhao Xuanyou. But by then, the wedding date had already been set, so he had to give up.

"Tell me. It’s better to hear it from you than from outsiders."

The engagement had indeed been arranged very hastily.

Zhao Xuanyou was already past the age of twenty. Most of his peers were already fathers, so the Old Dowager was very anxious. When the matchmaker came to propose Cui Yichu, she had immediately agreed.

After all, in terms of background and beauty, Cui Yichu was the cream of the crop among the noble ladies of the capital.

"Alright." Ye Mosui rubbed his hands and slowly said, "I had never met Sister-in-law before, so everything I know is from my third sister. You know, ever since my aunt became a Zhao Yi, my third sister has often entered and exited the palace, so she’s heard quite a few rumors."

Rumors from the palace?

Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t expected it to involve the palace.

"Go on."

Ye Mosui felt a murderous aura and didn’t dare to hesitate anymore. He blurted out everything. "I heard that Sister-in-law used to flatter several princes when she was a companion reader for the princess. She wanted to become a princess consort..."

"And then?"

Given Cui Yichu’s status as a legitimate daughter of a ducal family, wanting to become a princess consort was not a delusion. It would be strange if she couldn’t.

"I heard that the Empress Dowager didn’t like her, so when the princes of marriageable age got married, they went through all the noble families but didn’t choose her. They even took away her position as a companion reader for the princess."

"What happened that made her offend the Empress Dowager?"

"That, I don’t know. The Empress Dowager wouldn’t say, and others wouldn’t dare to discuss it. Brother, don’t worry about this anymore. I think Sister-in-law is fine. Let’s just let the past stay in the past."

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t speak. Ye Mosui knew he had misspoken while drunk, so he changed the subject to other gossip about the high-ranking families in the capital.

Fortunately, Zhao Xuanyou seemed not to take it to heart. He even kept Ye Mosui for dinner at the Marquis’s mansion. By the time Ye Mosui left, it was already completely dark.

Zhao Xuanyou strolled to the Liu Fang Pavilion. The main room was already dark.

"The heir has arrived." Tonight was Baochuan’s shift. Seeing Zhao Xuanyou enter the courtyard, she quickly announced loudly.

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze darkened slightly.

Every time he came to the Liu Fang Pavilion, the servants in the courtyard seemed especially nervous.

He walked up the steps, and the door opened. Cui Yichu, draped in a robe, walked out.

"Heir."

"Come inside. Don’t catch a cold."

Cui Yichu lowered his eyes and smiled slightly, stepping aside to let Zhao Xuanyou enter first. Only then did he follow behind him.

Seeing that Baochuan was about to follow, Zhao Xuanyou coldly said, "You may leave."

Baochuan was stunned for a moment before dryly replying, "Yes."

Cui Yichu noticed Zhao Xuanyou’s unhappy expression and gave Baochuan a look. Baochuan lowered her head and left, closing the door behind her.

Thinking about how Zhao Xuanyou had chatted with Ye Mosui for a long time today, his heart sank.

Those past events were little known, but the Ye family had connections with the palace. Perhaps they had heard some rumors, and Ye Mosui must have told Zhao Xuanyou.

He pretended not to know and remained gentle and warm. "The heir smells of alcohol. Would you like the kitchen to prepare a bowl of sobering soup?"

"No need." Zhao Xuanyou had an excellent capacity for alcohol. Although he was tipsy, he was still very clear-headed.

His face was dark and terrifying, which Cui Yichu noticed.

If he asked, Zhao Xuanyou would surely tell him.

But he didn’t ask...

"Then rest early." Cui Yichu said this and waited for Zhao Xuanyou to wash up and change clothes. Then, he quietly slipped out the door.

Under the corridor, Baochuan had already brought Yu Wan, who had changed into her nightclothes.

Cui Yichu looked at Yu Wan, his eyes flickering with hidden anxiety.

"Where is the calming soup prepared for Yu Wan?"

Baozhu, hearing the news, hurried over just in time to hear Cui Yichu’s words. The two servants exchanged glances, and Baozhu silently retreated. Soon, she returned with a bowl of clear soup.

The night wind blew on her face. Yu Wan took the bowl and smelled it. She recognized it as the same kind of aphrodisiac soup she had been forced to drink on the first night.

She showed no reaction and drank it all in one go in front of the three of them.

chapters.title: Pillowside Honeyed Schemes
chapters.content:
"Go, and serve him carefully."

Yu Wan did not respond, only respectfully bowed to Cui Yichu before lowering her gaze and entering the room.

Tonight was another clear night, with a waxing moon hanging high, casting a layer of soft light.

As soon as she entered the room, Yu Wan’s cheeks puffed up. She quickly went to the side room and spat all the medicinal soup into the chamber pot.

Today, she had stayed in the ear room all day, doing nothing but practicing how to hold water in her mouth without swallowing it, using a pot of water.

According to her memories from her past life, Cui Yichu would make her drink medicine every night; sometimes aphrodisiacs, sometimes sleeping draughts.

Last night, she had taken advantage of Baozhen’s momentary distraction to avoid drinking it, but she couldn’t evade surveillance every night. So she had deliberately practiced holding liquid in her mouth, and tonight, it had come in handy.

Yu Wan picked up the tea and rinsed her mouth again, feeling rather relieved.

Baozhen had been beaten yesterday, and today, she was unusually tight-lipped. Who knew what had happened?

Had she quarreled with Zhao Xuanyou?

Cui Yichu had lost her chastity before marriage and was hiding so many secrets. She truly didn’t dare to be completely honest with Zhao Xuanyou, which gave Yu Wan an opportunity to exploit.

Returning to the inner room, Zhao Xuanyou, having changed into his nightclothes, was sitting by the bed and had not yet lain down.

Yu Wan couldn’t help but feel a little worried. Right now, she still needed to use Cui Yichu’s identity to do some things. She couldn’t let Zhao Xuanyou find out that she was just a maidservant.

She reached up and tousled her hair, letting it cover half her face, then raised her hand to feign a yawn before walking straight toward the bed.

Before Zhao Xuanyou could speak, she climbed onto the bed from beside him.

Only after she had curled up under the covers did she soften her voice and say coyly, "World Honored One, it’s late. Let’s extinguish the lamp and rest."

"Are you sleepy?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

In just two words, his tone carried a hint of suspicion.

Yu Wan hummed in agreement and reached out from under the covers to tug at the sleeve of his nightclothes.

This gesture greatly pleased him. Stirred, he got up and blew out the candle.

The bed curtains immediately plunged into darkness. The two lay quietly, still separated by a small distance.

This was clearly different from last night; Zhao Xuanyou showed no intention of coming closer.

Although this suited Yu Wan’s wishes, it was not conducive to her gathering information.

Recalling Cui Yichu’s reaction, Yu Wan boldly asked, "Is the World Honored One angry with me?"

Zhao Xuanyou did not move. After a long moment, he slowly said, "No."

What should he say?

He didn’t care about others’ gossip, but some things he couldn’t help but overthink.

When they married, Zhao Xuanyou was twenty-one, and Cui Yichu was nineteen; both were older than the usual age for nobles to marry, which was why both families had been eager to arrange the wedding.

He had been delayed because he was stationed in the military for years, but what about her?

She was a talented and beautiful young lady from a noble family. It was said that many had sought her hand in marriage. The fact that she had not been betrothed for so long must have been, as the rumors suggested, because she was waiting for one of the princes to choose her as his consort.

So, on their wedding night, when she had deliberately rejected him, was it because she was unwilling to marry into the Marquis’s household? Was this marriage a second-best option for her?

Zhao Xuanyou’s innate pride made it hard for him to accept this.

"I don’t believe you."

A gentle yet stubborn voice interrupted Zhao Xuanyou’s thoughts. He turned his face to look at the woman beside him.

The brocade curtains were thick, letting in no moonlight. Even with his excellent night vision, he could only make out her outline.

Hearing her coy rebuttal, his cold, hardened heart seemed to be poked by something soft, and that bit of displeasure dissipated.

He shifted his body closer to her.

"Can my lady give me an honest answer?"

"The World Honored One speaks as if I’ve been hiding something from you."

She said this in a way that sounded truly pitiful. Zhao Xuanyou’s heart softened, and he reached out to pull her into his embrace, letting her rest her head on his arm as she had the night before.

"When you first found out you were to marry me, did you feel wronged?"

Yu Wan’s eyebrows twitched.

Why would Zhao Xuanyou ask such a thing? What had happened today? Had the two of them had a quarrel?

No, with Cui Yichu’s cunning and deceitful nature, she wouldn’t confront Zhao Xuanyou directly.

Zhao Xuanyou’s tone was gentle, so he probably didn’t know yet about Cui Yichu losing her chastity before marriage. But he must have heard something... What had happened today?

She guessed and guessed but got nowhere, so she decided to ask directly.

"What did the World Honored One hear?"

Zhao Xuanyou considered for a moment before saying softly, "Mo Han said you had a chance to be selected as a royal consort."

Who was Mo Han?

Had Cui Yichu once wanted to be a royal consort?

Given her family background, she was indeed qualified to be one. But she hadn’t become one. Was her loss of chastity related to this? It wasn’t something she could figure out just by thinking.

Yu Wan pondered for a moment before saying softly, "My parents naturally hoped I could become a royal consort, but these matters weren’t up to them."

"Your father and mother sent you into the palace to be a princess’s study companion, which must have been with high hopes."

Seeing that the conversation had indeed turned to Cui Yichu’s maternal family, Yu Wan secretly rejoiced and continued, "They did hope I could climb high and secure the Duke’s position for the sake of the family. It’s only natural."

"Were you unwilling?"

"I wasn’t unwilling, nor was I willing." Yu Wan answered vaguely. If she spoke plainly, Zhao Xuanyou might go to Cui Yichu and expose her. "Marriage wasn’t something I could decide. While I was unmarried, I only hoped for a good future. Is the World Honored One angry because of this?"

As she spoke, Yu Wan reached out and draped her arm over Zhao Xuanyou’s shoulder. Just like the night before, she tilted her head and kissed his chin.

This kiss made Zhao Xuanyou feel refreshed.

"I was just worried you felt wronged."

Yu Wan didn’t speak again. She lay quietly in his arms for a moment before softly asking, "If I truly had some grievance, what would the World Honored One do?"

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in response. "What grievance do you have?"

"Didn’t the World Honored One see it last night?" Yu Wan continued.

Zhao Xuanyou frowned, recalling what had been said the night before.

"The servants in the courtyard?"

"Yeah. The maids who came with me to the Marquis’s household are mostly my parents’ trusted people. They are indeed skilled, but they always act as if I’m young and should listen to them more. The deer antler soup was like that."

"Last night, you said they all listen to you."

"Then you won’t help me?"

Her playful words amused Zhao Xuanyou.

"How does my lady want me to help?"

Yu Wan didn’t make a sound. After a moment of silence, she said, "Baozhu and Baozhen have been with me since we were little and always listen to me. But Zhou Mama was originally my mother’s confidante, and she always puts on airs."

"Should I drive her away?"

"Really?" Yu Wan asked joyfully. "Can the World Honored One really help me with this?"

In the darkness, Zhao Xuanyou caught a glimpse of her eyes, which had suddenly lit up. He couldn’t help but laugh.

"If I drive her out of the household, others will think I’m undermining your authority."

"I don’t want to do anything to her. Just send her back to the Duke’s household. She’s my mother’s trusted aide. If I drive her away, my mother will scold me the next time I return home. But if the World Honored One finds fault with her, my mother can’t blame me."

Zhao Xuanyou had only been back at the household for two days, but he had indeed noticed that Zhou Mama was overreaching, acting as if she were half the mistress of the Marquis’s household.

At night, his wife was playful and cute, but during the day, with Zhou Mama watching over her, his wife was forced to wear a mask, like a boring puppet.

In the Marquis’s household, it was only the two of them in charge. They should be more at ease.

Since his wife had brought it up, he naturally had no reason to refuse.

"Then I’ll really drive her away?"

"Thank you, World Honored One." Yu Wan hadn’t expected things to go so smoothly. She struck while the iron was hot. "After all, she is my maid. When the time comes to drive her away, I’ll have to say a few words for her. The World Honored One must drive her away."

"Alright."

Zhao Xuanyou agreed readily. But as soon as he spoke, he clearly felt something warm touch his lips.

---

chapters.title: True Identity Revealed
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou found it amusing. Just helping her deal with a servant could make her so happy.

Thinking of this, Zhao Xuanyou said, "You are the mistress of the Marquis’s household. Whether it’s your maids or the old servants of the household, if you don’t like them, just replace them. Give them a generous severance, and that’s that."

The Marquis of Jingyuan was one of the five marquisates established at the founding of the current dynasty. With heavy military power and dominance over the western border, the annual taxes from the fief and the stipends from the court were stable. Additionally, over the past century, the accumulated fields and shops had brought in considerable income.

Moreover, the direct line of the Marquis’s household was sparse. Zhao Xuanyou ate and lived in the military, the old Marquis was convalescing in the south, and the greatest expense was on medicine. The Old Madam Ye was a devout Buddhist who, apart from her meticulous diet, spent very little on clothing and jewelry. Even if Cui Yichu was as extravagant as she wanted, the public funds of the household would still have a surplus of eight or nine tenths each year.

Compared to the noble households in the capital that often supported dozens of people, the Marquis of Jingyuan’s household was indeed much more affluent. Zhao Xuanyou had never worried about money.

"That won’t do." Yu Wan nuzzled against his neck and cooed, "The World Honored One is in the capital. If there’s a villain, of course the World Honored One should be the one to deal with it."

"As you wish." Zhao Xuanyou, usually cold and hard, had a rare note of indulgence in his voice.

Holding the warm and soft woman in his arms, he moved a little closer, feeling a fragrant breeze wafting toward him.

"Are you feeling better tonight?"

Zhao Xuanyou’s voice was low as he asked near her ear, naturally carrying a warm breath.

Yu Wan’s ears burned. She knew what he was asking about.

But that matter was something she wanted to avoid if possible. She didn’t even know if Chen Da Niu would be able to deliver the contraceptive pills in five days.

"I’m better." Yu Wan leaned on his shoulder and answered softly, though her tone carried a hint of pitifulness.

Zhao Xuanyou heard the implication in her words and tightened his embrace around her with a sigh.

"Did you apply the medicine?"

"Yes, I did."

Cui Yichu had indeed given her high-quality ointment. Not only that, but the rouge and powder in the ear room were the same as Cui Yichu’s.

Yu Wan had no intention of mistreating herself. She applied the medicine on time, and the delicate flower that had been ravaged a few days ago had indeed recovered a lot.

"Then shall we do as we did last night?"

"Mmm."

After Yu Wan spoke, she gently closed her eyes, feeling the tenderness of the man beside her. A hint of emotion filled her heart.

In her past life, she had always drunk Cui Yichu’s "calming soup" before serving him. Apart from knowing that he had endless stamina, she knew nothing else.

But in reality, he was not an unrestrained man.

The woman beside him was more full of pity than desire. If she was unwilling, he was willing to restrain himself.

The spring scene in the brocade curtains swayed gently.

By the time dawn was near, Baozhu entered the room and whispered that the water was ready for the lady to bathe.

When they entered the side room, Cui Yichu was already waiting there.

Since it was time to bathe, Baozhu naturally had to play her part fully.

She unbuttoned Yu Wan’s nightclothes and skillfully helped her bathe.

Cui Yichu caught a glimpse of the red marks all over Yu Wan’s shoulders and neck and filled her eyes with disdain.

Yu Wan found it amusing.

It was indeed not a glorious thing for a nameless, lowly bed attendant. But she had never willingly climbed into bed. It was Cui Yichu who had drugged her and sent her there.

She, a noble lady, had lost her chastity before marriage. How dare she look down on a servant girl who was forced into it?

Yu Wan was very curious to know what expression Cui Yichu would have when, in front of Zhao Xuanyou, her mask was torn off!

Of course, for now, Yu Wan wore a face of obedience and let Baozhu scrub and wash her.

"Put it on yourself." Baozhu threw over a set of maidservant’s clothes and waited for Yu Wan to dress. Then the three of them left the side room. Cui Yichu went back to the inner room, while Baozhu and Yu Wan walked out of the main room together.

But as soon as the two of them stepped out the door, they saw a male servant standing at the entrance arguing with a servant woman.

"Step aside quickly. I have urgent news to report to the World Honored One."

The servant woman said, "The World Honored One and the lady are resting. Even if there’s something urgent, someone has to go in and report it."

Yu Wan looked up and met the man’s gaze. They recognized each other immediately.

"Yu Wan, quickly go inform the World Honored One. There’s an urgent matter."

Baozhen recognized the man at the door as Yuan Qing, who followed Zhao Xuanyou. But she hadn’t expected that Yuan Qing would know Yu Wan.

Yuan Qing had returned to the capital with the World Honored One and usually stayed in the front courtyard. How could he know Yu Wan?

Shocked, Baozhen said, "Don’t shout. I’ll go in and report it now."

But before she could turn around, the door behind them opened.

Zhao Xuanyou, draped in a robe, walked out. Baozhen and Yu Wan had to step aside.

"Move aside." Seeing Zhao Xuanyou come out, Yuan Qing pushed aside the servant woman blocking his way and walked straight up to him, whispering something in his ear.

"I understand."

As soon as Zhao Xuanyou spoke, Cui Yichu also came out, asking with concern, "World Honored One, what happened?"

"Nothing major. I need to go out for a few days."

Go out?

Cui Yichu couldn’t wait for him to leave, but her peripheral vision caught Yu Wan still standing to the side, which immediately infuriated her.

Coincidentally, Zhao Xuanyou seemed to be looking at Yu Wan as well.

Yu Wan lowered her gaze and stood beside Baozhu, her head bowed so low that she seemed reluctant to let anyone see her.

The morning breeze blew under the corridor, and the hem of her skirt swayed. Zhao Xuanyou’s nose was faintly assailed by a fragrant breeze.

Cui Yichu made a quick decision and spoke loudly, "Since there’s an urgent matter and you need to go out, Baozhu, have the kitchen prepare a meal immediately."

"Yes." Baozhu immediately understood and pulled Yu Wan toward the kitchen.

Yuan Qing, seeing this, hurriedly said, "World Honored One, I’ll have someone prepare the horses and bows." With that, he followed Yu Wan out.

Watching Zhao Xuanyou see the three of them out of Liu Fang Hall, Cui Yichu felt as if her heart was being torn apart.

She had worked so hard to set everything up, only for Zhao Xuanyou to notice Yu Wan.

Yu Wan did look like her and had such a seductive figure. It was hard for him not to notice.

It wasn’t until the three of them had walked far away that Zhao Xuanyou slowly withdrew his gaze and went inside to change clothes.

The kitchen always had someone on duty. Since Zhao Xuanyou was in a hurry to leave, they quickly prepared a simple but delicious congee.

Zhao Xuanyou was not picky and ate some casually.

In the warm pavilion, only the two of them remained. Zhao Xuanyou hesitated for a moment before telling Cui Yichu the truth.

"It’s not a big deal. Prince Ping has ordered me to go hunting outside the city. He suddenly got the idea and wants to leave immediately. I might be back in three to five days."

"In that case, I’ll have someone prepare some dry rations." Previously, when Zhao Xuanyou returned to the capital, he had visited Prince Ping’s palace. This time, it was a private hunting trip outside the city. She hadn’t expected his private relationship with Prince Ping to be so good...

So, was the Marquis of Jingyuan’s household on Prince Ping’s side?

Zhao Xuanyou seemed to see through Cui Yichu’s thoughts and said softly, "It’s just hunting. It has nothing to do with court politics."

This was not an excuse.

He and Prince Ping had known each other since childhood. In the past, when Prince Ping went hunting, he had followed as a guard.

But their statuses were different. It wasn’t the kind of close friendship like between Ye Moqing and his sworn brothers.

After Zhao Xuanyou established himself in the western border, every time he returned to the capital, Prince Ping would invite him to drink and hunt.

For a heavyweight like Zhao Xuanyou, who held military power, Prince Ping’s intentions were not just about hunting.

He didn’t want to take sides in the matter of the crown prince, but the other party frequently invited him, so he couldn’t keep refusing. He could only maneuver in secret.

Court politics were not something he needed to discuss too much with Cui Yichu. First, to avoid worrying her, and second, to prevent her from reporting back to her natal family and causing unnecessary trouble.

He put down his chopsticks and wiped his mouth with a handkerchief.

Suddenly remembering something, he looked up at Cui Yichu.

"That maidservant named Yu Wan does look somewhat like you."

chapters.title: Long Since Deflowered
chapters.content:
Cui Yichu had no idea that Zhao Xuanyou had seen Yuman before. She thought he had only glanced at her once and yet left such a deep impression, and her heart inexplicably fluttered with unease.

"Does she look like me?" she subconsciously retorted.

The reason she had chosen Yuman was because their faces bore some resemblance. But hearing Zhao Xuanyou say this, she instinctively felt disdain.

How could a lowly maidservant dare to be compared with her?

In an instant, the coldness and disgust in her eyes were hard to suppress. Zhao Xuanyou, ever perceptive, noticed her expression and was somewhat surprised to see such a look on her face. For a moment, he said nothing.

Cui Yichu realized her loss of composure and forcibly suppressed the dissatisfaction in her heart, regaining her usual dignified and gentle demeanor.

"At first, I just thought this girl had a pleasant appearance, so I kept her in the courtyard to tend to the flowers. I didn’t think much of it. Does she really look like me?"

She pretended to be generous, tilting her face up as if inviting Zhao Xuanyou to compare.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her delicate, elegant face and suddenly had a thought.

If they had been whispering in the tent like a pair of mandarin ducks, she wouldn’t have reacted this way. She would have said something witty to make him laugh.

Now that he thought about it, the charming allure in the corners of Yuman’s eyes and brows resembled Madame’s lively demeanor at night even more.

"No."

Zhao Xuanyou felt a little bored and dropped these two words before standing up.

There was a distinction between ruler and subject. He needed to hurry to the city gate to await Prince Ping.

Cui Yichu saw him out of Liu Fang Hall. Once Zhao Xuanyou was far enough away, her expression instantly collapsed.

"Madame need not worry," Baozhu knew she was angry because Yuman had been seen by the young master. She supported Cui Yichu back into the house and only advised, "When the young master came out, Yuman was already in the corridor. If that Yuan Qing had arrived a step earlier and the young master had seen Yuman inside the room, that would have been truly terrible."

Cui Yichu was well aware of this.

But Zhao Xuanyou had only glanced at Yuman once and already left an impression. How could this not make her angry?

"Where is Yuman?"

"She’s back in the ear room. This servant reminded her not to come out again."

After all her meticulous planning, Zhao Xuanyou had unexpectedly seen Yuman. Her flawless plan now had a flaw.

Cui Yichu took a deep breath, forcing herself to calm down, and soon made a decision: "Since the young master has seen her, there’s no need to hide her anymore."

Zhao Xuanyou had seen Yuman, taken notice of her, and knew she was a maid in the flower room. If she continued to hide her in Liu Fang Hall, it would only arouse suspicion.

Most of the people in Liu Fang Hall were the accompanying servants from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. However, most of the servants in the Marquis’s mansion were still the old staff. It would be best to proceed cautiously.

"From now on, should we send Yuman back to the flower room to work?"

"Have her work in the flower room during the day and serve here at night."

Cui Yichu did not want to see Yuman often.

The flower room was remote; out of sight, out of mind.

Baozhu received the order and went straight to the ear room to call Yuman out, ordering her to return to the flower room for work.

Finally, she could leave Liu Fang Hall...

Yuman was overjoyed upon hearing this, but her face still showed a worried expression. "Is Madame driving me away? Sister Baozhu, what about the matter of being promoted to a concubine..."

"Shh!" Baozhu quickly covered her mouth. "Don’t talk nonsense. Back then, you climbed into the bed and broke the Marquis’s rules. It was only thanks to Madame’s kindness that she kept you. Don’t let this spread. When the young master wants a concubine, Madame will recommend you."

Yuman nodded, though there was still some reluctance in her eyes.

Baozhu let go of her hand, her gaze filled with disdain. With such shallow thoughts, it was no wonder Madame had outmaneuvered her.

"Go back to the flower room, work honestly, and don’t gossip with others."

"Will I still stay in Liu Fang Hall at night?"

"Of course."

Yuman’s worried expression vanished, and she smiled again. She bowed to Baozhu and happily walked towards the flower room.

She wasn’t pretending.

Being confined in the ear room was like being under house arrest. It was difficult to even leave Liu Fang Hall.

Today, she had unexpectedly run into Zhao Xuanyou, and it had brought such unexpected good fortune.

It seemed even Heaven was helping her.

Baozhu returned to the main house and saw Cui Yichu absentmindedly playing the guqin. She stepped forward and said, "I’ve already sent Yuman to the flower room."

To please Cui Yichu, Baozhu added with disdain, "She even had the nerve to ask when she could be promoted to a concubine."

"Hmph," Cui Yichu sneered, "She’ll have her moment in the spotlight."

Just then, Zhou Mama came to attend to her duties. Sensing something amiss, she couldn’t help but ask, "Madame, has the young master seen Yuman?"

Cui Yichu hummed in response, her expression tinged with unwillingness.

Zhou Mama said, "Then we should be cautious. Now that she has caught the young master’s eye, who knows if she won’t get ambitious and throw herself at the young master to seek favor."

"That shouldn’t happen." Baozhu thought for a moment. "Madame is the mistress of the inner chamber. As long as Madame doesn’t agree, the young master won’t take her."

Cui Yichu listened to their words but fell into deep thought.

She should indeed be cautious, but what she needed to guard against was not Yuman seeking favor; it was her womb.

What if she never became pregnant? What then?

---

chapters.title: Hasty as Eating Tofu
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou’s horse entered the capital city just before the city gates closed.

After escorting Prince Ping’s carriage back to the prince’s mansion, Prince Ping, having drunk to his heart’s content, hosted a night banquet filled with music, dance, and endless toasts, which was quite lively.

By the time Zhao Xuanyou returned to the Jingyuan Marquis’s mansion, it was nearly the zi hour (midnight).

A few days ago, when he had left the mansion, he had been alone.

Tonight, however, he returned with an additional woman.

At the prince’s banquet, Prince Ping, in high spirits from drinking, had bestowed upon him the most beautiful dancing girl from his mansion. After several polite refusals, Zhao Xuanyou, seeing Prince Ping’s face darken, had no choice but to accept the gift with gratitude.

Rushing back as quickly as possible, he had originally been thinking of the warm and soft embrace awaiting him in Liu Fang Hall. But Prince Ping’s unexpected interference had complicated matters.

What would her expression be when she found out he had brought a woman back?

After sending the dancing girl away to be settled, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly said, "Call Steward Song here."

"So late, and Master still isn’t resting..." Yuan Qing grumbled but didn’t dare delay. He quickly ran to deliver the message and soon brought the mansion’s steward, Song Defu, over.

Song Defu knew Zhao Xuanyou had just returned and assumed that being summoned so late at night meant something major had happened. He ran all the way, and by the time he entered the study, he was already out of breath.

"Have some water first."

Steward Song had been promoted by Old Lady Ye and had served three generations of the Marquis’s family. He was quite the veteran.

The old Marquis had treated him well, not only freeing his entire family from servitude but also securing a ninth-rank clerk position in the capital for his youngest son. As a result, Steward Song was even more loyal to the Marquis’s family.

"Thank you, Young Master." Steward Song took the water from Yuan Qing, caught his breath, and respectfully asked, "Young Master, you called for this old servant so urgently. Has something pressing happened?"

"Not urgent. I just thought of some matters regarding the mansion to ask you."

"Yes."

Zhao Xuanyou drank some hangover soup, considered for a moment, and then slowly said, "After Madame moved in, how many personal servants did she bring?"

Steward Song hadn’t expected to be asked about Madame’s affairs and was momentarily stunned before replying, "Ten maids, five matrons, along with four young servants and one accountant."

"What do they manage?"

"In the inner courtyard, apart from Old Lady Ye’s kitchen, all the stewards in each area have been replaced over the past year. If they’re not Madame’s personal servants, they’re people Madame assigned. The front courtyard remains the same, except for the addition of one accountant. Madame’s young servants only run errands and make purchases for her."

After Madame had moved in, Old Lady Ye had instructed Cui Yichu to manage the inner household, and most positions in the rear courtyard had been filled with people from the Duke’s mansion.

Since Zhao Xuanyou was often away from the capital, many matters in the front courtyard also required her input.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou had suddenly asked about this, Steward Song tentatively inquired, "Young Master, is something amiss?"

"Not at all."

Cui Yichu was the newly wedded daughter-in-law. It was only natural that she would use her own people to manage the household more smoothly.

Since he had married her, Zhao Xuanyou certainly didn’t mind this.

He was only asking because of his wife’s request.

"Does Zhou Mama, who attends to Madame, usually help manage the inner household?"

"Yes," Steward Song replied. "Baopeng and Baozhu mostly follow Madame’s orders, but Zhou Mama handles the most affairs in the inner household. She could be considered Madame’s chief steward."

Zhao Xuanyou got straight to the point: "Has Zhou Mama made any mistakes in her work?"

Steward Song was taken aback again, truly unable to fathom Zhao Xuanyou’s intentions.

"Young Master means...?"

"If we want to drive her out, we need a reason. See if you can find any faults with her."

"Drive her out? But she’s Madame’s personal servant..." Everyone in the mansion knew that Young Master and Madame were deeply in love. Why would he want to drive out Madame’s servant and embarrass her?

Steward Song was puzzled, but Zhao Xuanyou clearly had no intention of explaining himself.

Facing Zhao Xuanyou’s unfathomable gaze, Steward Song dared not say more and quickly replied, "If we’re talking about faults, Zhou Mama indeed can’t withstand close scrutiny."

"Oh?" Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t expected Steward Song to say this. "What has she done?"

Although Zhao Xuanyou had readily agreed to drive Zhou Mama out, his years of military command had instilled in him a strict sense of discipline.

Even when dismissing someone, there had to be a proper reason to convince others.

"Currently, Zhou Mama is in charge of major purchases for the inner household. This old servant doesn’t understand Madame’s personal expenses, but the meals for the servants have worsened considerably compared to before, yet the spending has doubled. After some discreet inquiries, I heard that Zhou Mama’s son runs a tavern in the city, and now the Marquis’s mansion buys its vegetables and meat from that tavern."

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression remained unchanged. He didn’t care about such small amounts of money, but he thought that Madame must have known about Zhou Mama’s actions and, due to her maiden family’s influence, found it difficult to deal with her directly.

"To catch a thief, we need evidence. Can you obtain proof?"

"Truly drive her out?" Steward Song asked, then quickly added, "That won’t be difficult. The tavern also has suppliers. This old servant can send someone to check the supplier’s accounts and compare them with the Marquis’s mansion’s accounts. It will be clear immediately."

Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes and tapped the table lightly but firmly. "That alone isn’t enough. We need to implicate her personally. Handle this matter as soon as possible."

"Understood."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod. After Steward Song left, he lifted his hand and pressed his forehead.

"Young Master, would you like another bowl of hangover soup?" Yuan Qing asked.

"No need."

Seeing that he still didn’t seem ready to rest, Yuan Qing suddenly teased, "Tonight, Master should still go to Liu Fang Hall to rest. Otherwise, Master won’t be able to sleep at all."

"You little brat!"

Zhao Xuanyou’s face darkened instantly. Yuan Qing stuck out his tongue and didn’t dare speak further.

Now that he was back at the mansion, of course he would rest in Liu Fang Hall.

It was just that he had brought a beautiful girl back with him. But by helping Madame resolve the trouble with Zhou Mama, perhaps she would be less angry when he told her?

The moon was bright, and the stars were sparse.

Zhao Xuanyou quickly walked to the entrance of Liu Fang Hall. The main house was already dark.

As soon as she saw him, the matron at the door, as expected, loudly announced, "Young Mas…"

Yuan Qing understood Zhao Xuanyou’s intentions and immediately scolded, "Quiet! Master doesn’t want to wake Madame."

The matron, meeting Zhao Xuanyou’s dark gaze, felt her scalp tingle and quickly lowered her voice to explain, "Madame ordered that when the Young Master arrives, he must be announced."

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t bother with formalities and walked straight in.

Tonight, the person on night duty in the corridor was Baopeng. She stepped forward and bowed to Zhao Xuanyou: "This servant greets Young Master."

"Has Madame retired for the night?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"She has been asleep for half an hour. This servant will…"

"No need."

Zhao Xuanyou pushed open the door and entered.

Since he didn’t want to disturb anyone inside, he deliberately moved lightly, making no sound as he entered.

Having been here several times, he was already familiar with the layout of the main house. Without needing a lamp, he went straight to the wardrobe to change his clothes.

Looking at the bed with its lowered curtains, a fragrant breeze wafted over, and the small flame in Zhao Xuanyou’s heart suddenly blazed up.

He quickly stepped forward, lifted the curtain, and sat down, reaching his large hand into the bedding. But he didn’t find the prey he was looking for.

Just as he frowned, a soft, sweet voice suddenly came from behind him.

"Whom is Young Master looking for?"

chapters.title: A Touch of Jealousy
chapters.content:
A single voice was enough to make one's skin tingle.

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head and saw a graceful figure standing by the folding screen. Without a word, he strode forward and lifted her into his arms.

Yu Wan had just gone to the side room to spit out her medicinal soup, fearing something might happen, she hurried over. Before she could react, she was swept off her feet, letting out a startled "ah" as she found herself nestled in his arms.

"Worldly Son..."

"Have you recovered?"

The man's voice was hoarse; of course, she knew what he was asking.

Thinking of how he had endured these days, it was likely that no excuse would work tonight.

Fortunately, Chen Da Niu had bought the contraceptive pills a few days ago.

Yu Wan felt a bit helpless. "Why doesn't the Worldly Son take a look for himself?"

It was just a casual retort from her, but to Zhao Xuanyou, it carried an unusual meaning.

She was seducing him.

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes flickered slightly as he pulled her into the tent.

At this moment, the moon was obscured by clouds, and no light filtered down. Cui Yichu, standing on the veranda, had a very dark expression.

Soon, Yu Wan's voice could be heard from inside, sometimes low, sometimes high, faintly, like a cat.

Bao Chun cursed, "So lewd, it seems this life is meant for the brothel."

"Madam," Baozhu supported Cui Yichu, "let's go back to the side room to rest. This servant will keep watch here."

Cui Yichu nodded slightly, allowing Bao Chun to help her towards the side room.

Baozhu had just sighed in relief when suddenly a maid rushed into the Liu Fang Hall, whispering something into Bao Chun's ear.

"Really?"

Bao Chun was shocked and, after asking the maid a few more questions, quickly ran into the side room.

Cui Yichu had just changed her clothes and was about to get into bed when she saw Bao Chun rush in.

"Aren't you keeping watch on the veranda? Why are you here?"

"Madam, tonight the Worldly Son brought a woman back with him when he returned to the mansion."

Cui Yichu's eyes flickered. "Where is she from?"

"It's not clear yet, but the Prince said he went out of the city to hunt, so it might be related to the Ping Prince's mansion."

"Hmph." Cui Yichu's expression grew even uglier, her gaze dark and menacing, looking quite frightening. "The Ping Prince's mansion has many singing girls and actors. Many noble families in the capital have concubines bestowed by the Ping Prince."

Bao Chun had been scolded the other day and was now eager to perform in front of Cui Yichu. "Even though the Worldly Son has a new woman, as soon as he returned to the Marquis's mansion, he came straight to Liu Fang Hall, showing that he doesn't care about that woman."

She had thought this through, but she hadn't considered that the person Zhao Xuanyou was holding now was Yu Wan. How could it sound pleasant to Cui Yichu's ears?

Baozhu was a bit smarter. Seeing the situation, she directly cut off the conversation and advised, "Madam, there's really no need to worry. The Worldly Son has placed that person in the west corner, near the remote area where the maids and servants live. Clearly, he doesn't care about that cheap woman."

Cui Yichu finally nodded in agreement, then suddenly thought of something.

Zhao Xuanyou had come to Liu Fang Hall so late; besides that matter, he might bring up the matter of that woman.

"What is Madam worried about?" Baozhu saw her sudden tension and quickly asked.

"What medicine did you give Yu Wan to drink today?"

Baozhu replied, "It was a sleeping aid, the dosage is about the same as before."

Aphrodisiacs couldn't be used every night. She was a lady from a noble family; if Yu Wan, this stand-in, were truly so promiscuous, it would only make Zhao Xuanyou look down on her.

Who knew how Yu Wan would respond when Zhao Xuanyou brought this up.

At this moment, Cui Yichu suddenly realized that if the medicine didn't take effect quickly enough, wouldn't Yu Wan remain awake the whole time?

Yu Wan, using her own identity to speak with Zhao Xuanyou, these words would definitely be taken seriously.

For a moment, she was actually at a disadvantage?

Cui Yichu tightly clenched her delicate fists, a fierce light flashing in her eyes.

Unfortunately, there was nothing she could do but silently hope that the calming soup would take effect quickly.

The clouds in the sky grew thicker. At first, they only obscured the moon, but later, the thick clouds completely blocked the night sky. Soon, the rain started pouring down.

"So cold." Baozhu and Bao Chun, who were keeping watch on the veranda, could only sit closer to the small red clay stove.

Outside, the wind and rain raged, but inside the embroidered canopy, it was warm and fragrant.

The exhausted Yu Wan reached out and touched the thin sweat on Zhao Xuanyou's chin, softly asking, "Worldly Son, you've sweated so much. Let the maid prepare water for a bath."

While bathing, she could find an opportunity to slip away.

Tonight, his interest was extremely high, and even though she had experienced it before, she found it a bit overwhelming.

Zhao Xuanyou's index finger traced from her collarbone to the tip of her nose. "Madam has sweated just as much. Why not bathe together?"

"No."

Once the lights were on, she would be exposed. How could Cui Yichu allow that?

"Shy?" Zhao Xuanyou's usually cold and firm tone was now extremely gentle. He held the person in his arms and kissed her hair. "What are you afraid of?"

"Afraid of you." Yu Wan said, trying to struggle out of his arms.

But her strength was no match for his. As soon as she moved, she was pulled back and held tightly in his arms.

"There's something I need to tell Madam."

Hearing the change in his tone, Yu Wan's heart skipped a beat. "Is it about Mother Zhou?"

"I've already ordered someone to handle this matter. Madam need not worry."

Yu Wan was overjoyed. If Zhao Xuanyou said it was being handled, then it would surely be done soon. However, she couldn't guess the other matters.

"Are there other things?"

Zhao Xuanyou pondered for a moment before slowly saying, "Tonight, the Ping Prince bestowed a dancing girl upon me. I couldn't refuse, so I had to bring her back to the mansion."

A dancing girl?

In her previous life, Yu Wan had always been strictly controlled by Baozhu and Bao Chun and didn't know there was another dancing girl bestowed by the Ping Prince in the mansion.

In the Marquis's mansion, only Cui Yichu held absolute power. Adding another woman could complicate the situation, which was a good thing.

However, if she showed her joy, it would surely arouse Zhao Xuanyou's suspicion.

This chapter is not yet complete. Please click on the next page to continue reading the rest of the exciting content!

"Does the Worldly Son want to take her as a concubine?" She asked tentatively, pretending to be jealous.

"No." Zhao Xuanyou said firmly, "I don't like her. Madam need not worry."

He was not a flirtatious person to begin with. Now that he was in harmony with his wife, he didn't want to create a rift over a dancing girl.

"Really?" Yu Wan felt a slight disappointment, but in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes, it was another interpretation.

"Don't you trust me?" As he spoke, Zhao Xuanyou placed a kiss on her forehead. "Let's keep her in the mansion for now. She was a dancing girl before, and she can remain a dancing girl. The Marquis's mansion can afford to keep a dancing girl."

Yu Wan's feelings were quite complicated.

It was rare to have someone who could cause trouble for Cui Yichu, yet Zhao Xuanyou treated her like a worn-out shoe.

No wonder in her previous life, she had never heard of this dancing girl. Since Zhao Xuanyou didn't favor her, she must have been disposed of by the ruthless Cui Yichu later.

"The Worldly Son must keep his word."

"Of course."

After performing the act of jealousy, thinking of Cui Yichu's usual hypocritical behavior, Yu Wan said, "Although she is a dancing girl, she is after all a person bestowed by the Prince. If the Worldly Son treats her so coldly, when word spreads to the Prince's mansion, it might displease the Prince."

Her voice sounded a bit pitiful. Zhao Xuanyou hummed softly, seemingly a bit displeased, and said indifferently, "I've already accepted her, which gives enough face. There's no need to worry too much about other things."

In his words, he wasn't afraid of offending the Ping Prince.

This was understandable. The Jingyuan Marquis's mansion was a hereditary marquisate, controlling the military power of the northwest for generations. They only took orders from the Emperor.

No matter how noble the Ping Prince was, Zhao Xuanyou didn't need to fear him.

"But I still feel it's not appropriate."

"What's inappropriate?"

"If I speak, will the Worldly Son listen to me?" In just a few exchanges, Yu Wan had already thought of a good way to cause trouble for Cui Yichu.

Zhao Xuanyou felt a bit helpless as his fingertip traced over her body.

Although it was pitch black inside the canopy, her skin was as smooth as fine porcelain, without a single flaw, which truly made him unable to let go.

The excitement that had taken an hour to subside suddenly flared up again.

"Whether I listen or not depends on Madam's ability."

---

chapters.title: Whispering in the Pillow Again
chapters.content:
Having come this far, how could Yu Wan back down? She could only hook her arms around his neck.

A faint sweet fragrance filled the canopy. After the storm subsided, Yu Wan, weak and breathless, said, "Will the Worldly Son keep his word?"

"Still thinking about these things?" Zhao Xuanyou yawned deeply. "Let's talk about it tomorrow morning."

After half a night of exertion, he wasn't so much tired as he was sleepy.

Originally, he had wanted to hold the beauty in his arms and sleep, but she still wanted to talk.

"Has the Worldly Son gone back on his word?"

Of course he had.

Yu Wan cursed silently. If it weren't for this matter, would she have to go through so much trouble?

Thoughts were thoughts, but her attitude was still obedient and charming.

"What does Madam want to do with her?"

Finally, the conversation had come to this. Yu Wan sighed in relief and softly spoke her true thoughts. "Since she's already in the Marquis's mansion, why not make her a concubine?"

"There's no need for that."

Hearing that Zhao Xuanyou truly had no interest in the dancing girl, Yu Wan wasn't surprised. She still persisted in advising, "If I had heard earlier that such a person was to be added, I would certainly be unhappy. But since the Worldly Son has already agreed, why cause displeasure to the Prince?"

Her words were appropriate, expressing both her discontent as the main wife and her consideration for her husband, which indeed made it difficult for Zhao Xuanyou to refuse.

"Really want to make her a concubine?"

"Of course. But the Worldly Son must agree to one request of mine."

At this moment, it was quiet enough to hear the rain outside picking up again. In the soft red gauze canopy, Zhao Xuanyou, having acquired a taste for the beauty, held her close. In this situation, whatever she said, he would agree to.

"Alright."

"I haven't said it yet." Yu Wan hadn't expected him to agree so readily. She couldn't help but sit up a bit, giving him a kiss. "Until the Worldly Son leaves the capital, you must not touch her."

So that was it. Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement. "As you wish."

Yu Wan was secretly pleased when Zhao Xuanyou suddenly sat up.

Before she could ask, Zhao Xuanyou had already ordered someone to prepare water.

Indeed, the night had been excessively wild. Not to mention the stickiness on their bodies, even the bedding had been messed up beyond recognition.

Afraid of being exposed, Yu Wan put on the air of a mistress and added, "Light a candle and place it in the corner. It'll be less dazzling that way."

Baozhu had been as anxious as an ant on a hot pan. Hearing Yu Wan's words, she finally calmed down. She ordered a small maid to help with the water and lit a white candle, placing it in the corner.

The candlelight was dim and weak, enough to move around but not enough to see clearly.

"Leave." Once the warm water was presented, Zhao Xuanyou dismissed everyone.

Yu Wan knew what he wanted to do and decided to wash herself.

Every night before being sent in by Cui Yichu, Yu Wan had already cleaned herself thoroughly. There was no need to wash so carefully at night.

The candlelight in the side room was very weak. Yu Wan stood with her back to Zhao Xuanyou. The dim light shone on her, making her figure appear even softer and more graceful. Zhao Xuanyou's initially diminished excitement rose again.

"Why wash so quickly?" Zhao Xuanyou embraced her from behind.

Yu Wan let the gourd ladle in her hand fall into the bath tub and placed her hands on the edge of the tub.

Having served him for two lifetimes, this was the first time she had encountered such a situation.

"Aren't you sleepy, Worldly Son? Let's rest early tonight."

Yu Wan tried to push him away, but his body was like a wall. How could she push him?

---

Bao Chun had remade the bed and was about to leave when she heard Yu Wan's soft cries from the side room again.

The Worldly Son certainly had great stamina.

With no end in sight, it was no wonder Madam was jealous. Bao Chun curled her lip and stepped back to close the door, only to see Cui Yichu standing behind her.

She was still wearing her nightclothes, with only a cloak draped over her shoulders.

"Madam." She softly called out, concerned. "It's windy and rainy outside. Be careful not to catch a cold."

"It's fine."

"There's nothing wrong here in the main house. Madam, please rest assured and go to sleep." Baozhu stepped forward to support Cui Yichu back to the side room, then glanced at a small maid, signaling her to serve there.

Everyone in Liu Fang Hall, inside and out, were people brought from the Duke's mansion. They were all reliable.

Entering the side room, Baozhu asked, "Since the Worldly Son returned to the mansion, Madam has been full of worries. What is troubling you?"

Cui Yichu remained silent.

"Is it because of the dancing girl sent by the Prince?"

Cui Yichu shook her head. "A mere dancing girl, can she climb above my head?"

"Then is Madam worried about Yu Wan?" Baozhu gently massaged her shoulders and whispered, "That dancing girl might have a foothold thanks to the Prince's face, but Yu Wan is just a maid with no background. How can she pose a threat to Madam? Madam really doesn't need to worry."

"Yu Wan can't do anything to me, but all my plans rely too much on Yu Wan. If the Worldly Son doesn't get her pregnant during this trip back, am I supposed to just let her serve him night after night?"

"Are you afraid that time will reveal the truth, that Yu Wan is replacing Madam?"

"Of course."

Baozhu said, "This servant sees that Yu Wan is quite clever. Just now, when the Worldly Son suddenly wanted to bathe, it was she who quickly suggested lighting a candle in the corner."

"They are bathing?" Cui Yichu's gaze grew colder. No wonder she had heard the sound of water while standing on the veranda earlier.

But then she thought of something.

"Didn't we give Yu Wan the calming medicine? How is she so awake?"

"The Worldly Son has just returned from outside. Perhaps he was in a hurry. They haven't slept much this past half of the night."

Cui Yichu still felt something was off. "We gave her the medicine precisely so she would fall asleep no matter what."

"If Madam is worried, tomorrow I will increase the dosage."

Cui Yichu nodded slightly, her expression darkening. "Go keep watch on the veranda. Call her out early."

Yu Wan hadn't taken the aphrodisiac tonight. She had taken the calming medicine but hadn't fallen asleep, meaning she was fully conscious while accompanying Zhao Xuanyou.

It was dangerous, far too dangerous.

"I understand."

Baozhu was about to leave when Cui Yichu suddenly spoke again. "Wait."

"Does Madam have any other orders?"

"Tell Cui Rong to return to the Xingguo Duke's mansion now. Inform my mother that I will go back home at dawn and tell her not to go out."

"Yes."

Seeing her serious expression, Baozhu didn't dare to delay and immediately went to pass on the message.

Before dawn, Baozhu helped Yu Wan out and took her directly to Cui Yichu's side room.

Seeing Yu Wan's drooping eyelids, Cui Yichu felt slightly reassured.

"Very sleepy?"

Yu Wan nodded. "I barely slept tonight."

"Did the Worldly Son say anything to you?"
