Yu Wan seemed to recall something important. "The Worldly Son said the Prince bestowed a dancing girl."

Hmph, such an important matter, and he had indeed told this cheap woman.

Cui Yichu's expression was unpredictable. "What did you say?"

Yu Wan, feeling the intense gaze of Cui Yichu and Baozhu on her, knelt down. "This servant is guilty. Please forgive me, Madam."

"What crime have you committed?"

Seeing Cui Yichu and Baozhu both staring at her intently, Yu Wan lowered her gaze.

"The Worldly Son said that the dancing girl was bestowed by the Prince and we couldn't refuse the Prince's face. He intended to make her a concubine and asked this servant for her thoughts." Yu Wan's speech became more stammering. "This servant thought that Madam is usually kind and has said before that she would add people for the Worldly Son. Since the dancing girl was bestowed by the Prince and the Worldly Son has accepted her, refusing might displease the Worldly Son. At that time, the Worldly Son kept asking, and this servant didn't dare to remain silent, so she agreed. Please forgive me, Madam."

chapters.title: Loosening the Soil
chapters.content:
Seeing Cui Yichu's face ashen, Yu Wan looked like a wrongdoer, fearfully pleading, "At that time, this servant only responded casually. If it was inappropriate, Madam can go and speak to the Young Master again. Changing his mind should be fine."

"Enough, go back to your room and stay there. What Madam does is none of your concern." Baozhu could see that Cui Yichu was in an extremely bad mood. Yu Wan standing there would only make her feel worse. It was best to send her away quickly; out of sight, out of mind.

Hearing Baozhu’s words, Yu Wan had a slight foreboding. She dared not speak further, rose, and curtsied to Cui Yichu before leaving.

Back in her side room, Yu Wan couldn't help but feel distressed.

Cui Yichu’s gaze, Baozhu’s words; all signs indicated that they had grown suspicious of her.

Yu Wan took the contraceptive pill with her tea. Distressed as she was, she was genuinely tired now.

After lying down for a nap, she got up again when the sun was already high in the sky.

Walking to the window, she heard two young maids outside saying that Baochuan and Baozhu had followed Cui Yichu back to her maiden home. Today would be a good day to slack off.

Yu Wan had a bad feeling in her heart.

Cui Yichu suddenly returning to her maiden home; she was probably going to consult the Duke and Duchess of Xingguo about some poisonous scheme. That couple was cunning and crafty.

From Cui Yichu’s position, the biggest difference between this life and the previous one was that Zhao Xuanyou had seen her.

In her plan, Zhao Xuanyou must never know of Yu Wan’s existence, or at least, he must never have seen her.

This was indeed beyond Yu Wan’s expectations. According to the original plan, she was supposed to secretly contact Zhao Xuanyou behind Cui Yichu’s back, letting him gradually realize that she was the one who had been with him at night.

But now, the two of them had unexpectedly met, and both Cui Yichu’s and Yu Wan’s plans had been ruined.

What would she do? Would she come after her...

She couldn’t just sit and wait for death!

Cui Yichu’s sudden return to her maiden home would surely lead to some action. She had to prepare in advance.

Having made up her mind, Yu Wan sat in front of the mirror and carefully applied her makeup.

Apart from her nightgown, she had no luxurious clothes or valuable jewelry. But for the sake of the act, the creams and rouge in her vanity case were the same as Cui Yichu’s.

Without fine clothes and pearls, she could only focus on her makeup.

Yu Wan’s skin was originally fair and tender, flawless even without powder. Now, with a thin layer of peach blossom powder and a touch of lip rouge, she looked delicate and charming.

She was a maid and couldn’t wear Cui Yichu’s clothes to go out. After some thought, Yu Wan untied her belt and re-tightened her waist.

Already slender, this made her waist appear even more delicate, as if it might snap.

After examining herself in the mirror for a moment, Yu Wan stood up and walked around the room. Seeing nothing amiss, she quietly pushed the door open and left.

In the courtyard, there were only a few maids and servants sweeping.

Baozhu and Baochuan had indeed followed Cui Yichu back to her maiden home. Zhou Mama was probably busy managing affairs somewhere.

Yu Wan walked out openly and, as expected, no one stopped her.

Leaving Liu Fang Guan, she headed straight for Zhao Xuanyou’s study, Honghui Hall.

Though called a study, Honghui Hall was on the central axis of the Marquis’s residence, connecting the front and rear courtyards.

Zhao Xuanyou handled political affairs and read here, and also received guests.

Unlike the elegant and beautiful Liu Fang Guan, Honghui Hall was spacious and grand.

Not only that, it was heavily guarded, with six guards standing at the entrance. There was no way to sneak in.

Yu Wan felt a little disheartened. After dressing up so carefully, could it be that she wouldn’t even be able to see Zhao Xuanyou?

After a moment’s thought, she stepped forward and asked, “Is Yuan Qing here?”

“Who are you?” The guard, seeing her unfamiliar face, didn’t sound very friendly.

“I am Yu Wan, a maid from Liu Fang Guan. Madam has something to instruct, and she told me to pass a message to Yuan Qing.”

Yuan Qing was the Young Master’s personal guard. Normally, the Young Master’s wife wouldn’t be able to give him orders, but recently, everyone in the Marquis’s residence knew that the Young Master and his wife were inseparable. The guard, seeing this, went inside to relay the message.

Soon, Yuan Qing came out and, catching sight of Yu Wan, was taken aback.

Previously, he had only seen her with a bare face. Today, with her makeup done, she looked extraordinary.

Yuan Qing suddenly felt that even the renowned beauty, Madam, paled in comparison to Yu Wan.

“Yu Wan, what did Madam instruct?”

Yu Wan gestured for Yuan Qing to step aside and whispered, “Is the Young Master in the study?”

Yuan Qing, though young, was not foolish. Hearing Yu Wan’s concern for the Young Master, he couldn’t help but ask, “What exactly did Madam instruct?”

Yu Wan remained calm and softly replied, “Before leaving, Madam ordered that the flower room had recently cultivated some jasmine, which were blooming beautifully. Thinking that jasmine is elegant and refined, placing them in Honghui Hall would be most suitable. If the Young Master isn’t here now, I can move the flowers over without disturbing him.”

She had already prepared her excuse.

With Cui Yichu not in the residence, Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t verify her story with Cui Yichu. She could mention the jasmine again when attending to him at night to cover her tracks.

“In that case, the Young Master is reading right now,” Yuan Qing scratched his head, thinking. Normally, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t mind others working while he read. So he said, “You can move the flowers now. Just be quiet about it.”

“Alright.”

Yu Wan returned to the flower room and told the managing servant that Honghui Hall needed some jasmine. The servant was suspicious, but Yu Wan had recently gained Madam’s favor. Baozhu had specifically instructed not to bother her, so the servant didn’t say much and let Yu Wan pick and choose in the flower room. She also had the servants help carry the flower pots.

Since she intended to linger in Honghui Hall, she couldn’t work too quickly. After the servants placed the flower pots in the courtyard, Yu Wan sent them back to the flower room.

“Can you handle it alone? Can you carry them?” Seeing the ground full of flower pots, Yuan Qing couldn’t help but ask.

“Didn’t you say the Young Master is reading? Too many people would disturb him. Moving flower pots is nothing. Don’t underestimate me.”

With that, Yu Wan squatted down and deftly moved a pot of jasmine to the steps of the corridor.

She might look frail, but having worked with her mother since she was young, she was stronger than she appeared.

Yuan Qing smiled and, without bothering her further, went back inside to attend to his duties.

Yu Wan arranged the flower pots in front of the main house and, after circling the courtyard, soon spotted Zhao Xuanyou’s study.

It was a hot summer day, and all the windows were wide open, with only window screens to keep out mosquitoes.

Zhao Xuanyou was tall, and even while sitting, Yu Wan could clearly see the upper half of his body.

He was a military general, usually exuding a cold and stern aura, commanding respect without anger.

At the moment, he wore a light blue brocade robe and held a book in his hands. His entire demeanor was much softer, less like a warrior and more like a refined scholar.

Yu Wan only glanced at him, and joy filled her heart.

It was rare that Cui Yichu wasn’t in the residence, and she had managed to enter Honghui Hall. She had to make the most of this opportunity.

Yu Wan took a deep breath, quickly averted her gaze, and didn’t linger in front of Zhao Xuanyou’s window.

She carefully examined the positions for placing the flower pots and, after confirming, rolled up her sleeves and carried the jasmine over, wiping the leaves and trimming the branches one by one.

On her first day working in the flower room, the old servant who taught her had said that transplanting flowers required patience. One must first loosen the soil gently to avoid damaging the roots.

Now, Zhao Xuanyou was fond of the person who had replaced Cui Yichu in his bed. Transferring that affection to herself wouldn’t be easy.

She couldn’t be impatient, nor could she go to Zhao Xuanyou and flirt with him.

She only needed to appear around him, gently, gently loosening the soil.

---

chapters.title: A Flare for Drama
chapters.content:
Yuan Qing entered the room with a teapot just as Zhao Xuanyou finished reading the book in his hands.

“Incense lit?” Zhao Xuanyou asked.

He had spent years on military campaigns and never used incense or carried sachets like the nobles in the capital.

When he first returned to the capital, entering Liu Fang Guan, he found the fragrance overwhelming. The censer was always burning incense in the room, his bedclothes were infused with a cold fragrance, and her hair and skin carried the scent as well.

After spending more nights in Liu Fang Guan, he gradually grew to like the fragrance.

“No, it’s the scent of flowers,” Yuan Qing said. “Madam ordered the flower room to place some jasmine in Honghui Hall. I thought it was Madam’s order, so I let Yu Wan come in and arrange them.”

Yu Wan?

Zhao Xuanyou’s mind conjured the image of that graceful figure holding a crape myrtle flower.

That night, when she approached, she also carried a fragrant breeze.

“Does the Young Master dislike it? Then I’ll have Yu Wan remove them.” Seeing Zhao Xuanyou’s silence, Yuan Qing thought he had done something wrong.

Zhao Xuanyou frowned at him, and without a word, Yuan Qing understood, grinning as he backed out.

Zhao Xuanyou stood up and selected another book from the bookshelf.

The Marquis of Jingyuan’s family had been in the military for generations, but the education of the young masters was no different from other noble families in the capital. They started school at six, and while they also studied martial arts and military strategies, they were also well-versed in literature.

Thus, Zhao Xuanyou was not a brute but a man of both literary and martial prowess, capable of writing with a pen and pacifying the nation on horseback.

After reading only a couple of pages, Zhao Xuanyou looked up toward the window.

It was the height of summer, and Honghui Hall’s courtyard was lush with greenery. In the corner of the moss-covered wall stood a row of jasmine, their tiny white flowers neither showy nor understated, perfectly complementing the monotonous green.

The placement was indeed excellent.

Zhao Xuanyou had been so engrossed in his reading that he hadn’t noticed when she had arranged the flowers.

He lowered his head to continue reading, but after two lines, he looked up again, and his eyes suddenly lit up.

Yu Wan, dressed in a plain-colored outfit, held a pair of scissors and was intently trimming the overgrown branches and leaves.

Though her clothes were the same as those of the other maids in the residence, her figure was slender and graceful.

With no pearls or gold ornaments in her hair, her eyes and brows still carried a hint of allure.

Zhao Xuanyou stared at her intently.

This attention wasn’t born of lust but from the first time he met Yu Wan. A strange sense of familiarity had taken root in his heart, as if they had met before.

Was it because she resembled Madam?

Indeed, she did, but when he saw Madam, he hadn’t felt this way.

The Yu Wan outside the window finished trimming the jasmine and turned around. Her gaze inadvertently met Zhao Xuanyou’s in the study.

Yu Wan respectfully curtsied to him, then went on to tend to the other flowers without any extra glances or movements.

Zhao Xuanyou watched her back as she walked away, then withdrew his gaze and returned to his book, forcing himself to stop thinking about Yu Wan.

She was a maid by Madam’s side. If he paid too much attention to her, Madam might be displeased.

Before he could finish a page, Yuan Qing entered again.

Zhao Xuanyou disliked being disturbed while reading, and his expression darkened, making Yuan Qing’s heart race.

“Young Master,” Yuan Qing steeled himself and said, “Miss Fengchang has arrived and wishes to pay her respects.”

“Who?” Zhao Xuanyou asked coldly.

Yuan Qing had no choice but to say, “Miss Fengchang, the one who came with you from Prince Ping’s residence yesterday.”

Ah, that dancer.

Zhao Xuanyou had no interest in her and barely remembered her name.

“Accept the gift, reward yourself with it. In the future, if she comes again, there’s no need to announce her. Just turn her away.”

“Yes.”

As Yuan Qing turned to leave, Yu Wan happened to be wiping the leaves of the flowers at the entrance.

“Miss Fengchang, the Young Master is reading right now and dislikes being disturbed. You should go back,” Yuan Qing said, thinking of a plausible excuse since she was from the Prince’s residence.

Yu Wan had already heard that a dancer had come to the residence last night. Seeing this scene, she immediately guessed it was the woman in front of her.

The woman was probably a year or two older than Yu Wan. The clothes and jewelry she wore were no less fine than Cui Yichu’s, with colorful gauze sleeves and a palace sash around her waist.

In terms of looks, she wasn’t as beautiful as Cui Yichu, but perhaps due to her dance training from a young age, her figure was graceful and slender.

The Prince’s residence was indeed grand. Even a dancer could be dressed so magnificently.

“When would be a good time for me to see the Young Master?” Fengchang asked.

As she spoke, her chin was slightly raised, not at all like a servant bowing and scraping.

“The Young Master is busy with official duties. If he wants to see you, he will naturally send someone to summon you. I’ll take the pastries first. Rest assured, I’ll present them to the Young Master later.”

Recalling Zhao Xuanyou’s attitude last night, this was clearly a dismissal.

Fengchang naturally guessed as much. Reluctantly, she handed the pastries to Yuan Qing.

“Thank you.”

“Don’t mention it.”

As Fengchang turned to leave, her gaze happened to meet Yu Wan’s. Seeing such a beautiful maid in Honghui Hall, her heart sank.

No wonder the Young Master had no interest in her.

Though she was unwilling to accept it, there was nothing she could do. She left in disappointment.

“What are you looking at? Want some pastries?” Yuan Qing walked over to Yu Wan and waved the food box in front of her.

Yu Wan averted her gaze, pretending not to recognize her. “Who was that? She doesn’t look like a maid.”

“Of course not. It’s not convenient to say now, but you’ll find out later.” Since Honghui Hall was full of men, the Young Master definitely wouldn’t touch her. He guessed that few guards would eat the pastries, so Yuan Qing simply placed the food box on the steps. “Yu Wan, you’ve been busy enough. Take these pastries back with you.”

“These are for the Young Master. I can’t take them.”

“Take them. These are rewards from the Young Master.”

Seeing that Yuan Qing was being kind to her, Yu Wan responded with an “oh,” then thought for a moment and said, “Thank you. Oh, by the way, jasmine is very delicate. From now on, I’ll come every day to water them and catch pests. Please inform the guards at the gate.”

“Taking care of flowers is so troublesome.”

“Of course. Otherwise, why would the flower room need more than a dozen people?”

Yuan Qing scratched his head and said, “Alright,” before going back inside.

Yu Wan packed up her tools and was just about to leave with the food box when she turned and caught sight of Zhou Mama, her face dark, standing at the entrance of Honghui Hall with two servants.

She had completely forgotten about that damned Zhou Mama!

Zhou Mama, as the head servant overseeing the inner courtyard on behalf of Cui Yichu, inspected each area daily. Normally, she wouldn’t come to Honghui Hall, but her presence here clearly indicated she had heard about Yu Wan being there.

It seemed she had already been to the flower room.

Facing Zhou Mama’s furious gaze, Yu Wan calmly gathered her tools, holding the basket in one hand and the food box in the other as she walked out.

Her deliberate slowness indeed infuriated Zhou Mama.

Originally, Zhou Mama had intended to take Yu Wan back to Liu Fang Guan before dealing with her, but as soon as Yu Wan stepped out of Honghui Hall, Zhou Mama couldn’t hold back her anger. “You little vixen, dressing up like a seductress, what are you trying to do here?”

In front of Zhou Mama, claiming it was Cui Yichu’s order wouldn’t work.

She was Cui Yichu’s confidante and knew that Cui Yichu least wanted Yu Wan to get close to Zhao Xuanyou.

Yu Wan put on a respectful front. “In response to Zhou Mama, the Young Master wanted some jasmine placed in the courtyard. I’ve just finished arranging them.”

“The Young Master’s order?” Zhou Mama’s anger flared. She grabbed Yu Wan’s wrist. “That’s not what Flower Room’s Mama Xu told you.”

“Is that so?”

So she had indeed been to the flower room and knew that Yu Wan had moved the flowers under Cui Yichu’s name.

This excuse wasn’t flawless, but she hadn’t expected it to be exposed so quickly, in just over an hour.

“You little slut, to think you’re so scheming. Back to Liu Fang Guan with you. Let’s see how I deal with you!” Zhou Mama knew Honghui Hall wasn’t the place for this, so she dragged Yu Wan away.

“Let go of me! Let go!” Yu Wan struggled as the three fierce servants overpowered her. In her desperation, she caught a glimpse of Zhao Xuanyou coming out of Honghui Hall from the corner of her eye and secretly sighed in relief.

Her fingers loosened, and the food box and basket fell to the ground with a clear crash.

“Zhou Mama, I admit my mistake. Please don’t hit me!”

chapters.title: Pear Blossoms in the Rain
chapters.content:
Madame Zhou was a household-born servant of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. In her youth, she had been beautiful, and with her quick wit and flattery, she had always served the Duchess of Xingguo, becoming well-versed in the art of survival within the inner quarters. She was the Duchess’s most trusted confidante.

Before Cui Yichu’s wedding, an incident occurred, and as he needed to plan major affairs at the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence, the Duchess of Xingguo sent Madame Zhou as part of the dowry retinue to accompany her to the Marquis’s mansion.

Seeing Yu Ying’s expression suddenly change and hearing her cry out nonsensical words, Madame Zhou immediately sensed something was amiss. She looked up and saw Zhao Xuanyou standing in the courtyard, his gaze shifting darkly as he watched them.

Madame Zhou suddenly realized; Yu Ying’s outburst had been staged for Zhao Xuanyou’s benefit.

She tried to let go, but Yu Ying grabbed her hand instead.

“What is this little slut trying to do?” Madame Zhou hissed.

Yu Ying then sobbed loudly, “Madame Zhou, I truly acted on the Duchess’s orders! I know you’re the steward here, but you can’t overstep the Duchess’s authority!”

“Nonsense! How dare you bring up the Duchess!” Madame Zhou seethed.

“What’s all this noise? This is Honghui Hall!” The guards at the door immediately stepped forward to shoo them away. “Take your business back to the inner quarters. Don’t make a scene here.”

“This servant girl is insubordinate. I’ll take her away at once; I wouldn’t dare disturb the Young Master.” Madame Zhou said this while signaling the two other matrons beside her.

Every part of the inner quarters was under Cui Yichu’s control; except for Honghui Hall.

Yu Ying had dared to come to Honghui Hall under Cui Yichu’s name and even caused a disturbance upon seeing the Young Master. This showed her wild ambitions. She absolutely could not be kept!

Madame Zhou made a swift decision. She covered Yu Ying’s mouth and ordered the two matrons to drag her away.

The three matrons used all their strength, and Yu Ying was instantly immobilized.

“Stop!”

Yuan Qing’s voice rang out from the courtyard. Madame Zhou ignored it, determined to take Yu Ying away as quickly as possible. Only when they were blocked by the guards of Honghui Hall did she halt.

“This…” the guard said, “All this noise; go explain yourselves to the Young Master.”

The four of them were taken back to Honghui Hall and forced to kneel before Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhao Xuanyou coldly asked, “Who gave you the audacity to cause a disturbance in Honghui Hall?”

His gaze was dark, and even a brief glance sent chills down Madame Zhou’s spine. She recalled the earlier scene and realized she had been outmaneuvered by that wretched girl, Yu Ying.

Yu Ying had deliberately cried out loudly to attract Zhao Xuanyou’s attention.

But Madame Zhou wasn’t flustered. She was a veteran of the Duke’s mansion, Cui Yichu’s personal attendant, and the one who managed the inner quarters. No matter how Yu Ying stirred up trouble, Zhao Xuanyou wouldn’t dare disrespect Cui Yichu. At most, he would scold them.

“In response to the Young Master, this servant girl tends to the flowers in Liu Fang Pavilion. She was insubordinate and made a scene here, disturbing your peace. It is entirely my fault.”

As Madame Zhou made her excuses, Yu Ying remained silent.

Earlier, when they had forcibly dragged her away, Madame Zhou had clamped her mouth shut. Yu Ying’s delicate skin bore clear finger marks from the forceful grip.

She looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, and upon confirming he was looking at her, quickly lowered her gaze.

After the struggle with Madame Zhou, her hair was disheveled, and her fair face bore red marks; she looked truly pitiful.

“Yu Ying was peacefully tending to the flowers in the courtyard. What insubordination is there?” Yuan Qing, though only a personal attendant, had long served Zhao Xuanyou and even received martial arts training from him. Thus, he carried himself with confidence in the mansion.

“Young Master Yuan doesn’t know; this girl came to Honghui Hall on her own. She told the flower room staff it was the Duchess’s order, but told me it was the Young Master’s. Her intentions are dishonest. I had to take her back for discipline.”

Yu Ying silently wiped away her tears.

“Yu Ying, is this true?” Zhao Xuanyou asked.

“In response to the Young Master, this servant did indeed act on the Duchess’s orders to come to Honghui Hall. I truly don’t know why Madame Zhou claims I acted on my own.” Yu Ying said softly. “This morning, when the Duchess left the mansion, Madame Zhou wasn’t at Liu Fang Pavilion. And the Duchess hasn’t returned yet. I truly don’t know why Madame Zhou is so certain I’m lying.”

Madame Zhou’s heart jolted in alarm.

At first, she had assumed Yu Ying came to Honghui Hall to get close to Zhao Xuanyou, to seduce him.

But now, Yu Ying’s rapid lies clearly targeted her.

Yu Ying was crying so pitifully, like pear blossoms in the rain. Even Madame Zhou felt sorry for her. How could the young and vigorous Young Master resist?

“Young Master, Yu Ying has always been cunning and slippery in her work. The Duchess has scolded her many times…”

“If the Duchess has scolded her so many times, why hasn’t she been punished?”

Madame Zhou hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to interrupt like this. She froze, momentarily speechless.

It seemed Zhao Xuanyou had completely fallen for that wretched girl Yu Ying’s tricks.

She forced herself to calm down. “Fine. Since you insist it was the Duchess’s order, then we’ll wait for the Duchess to return and settle this.”

Her words weren’t wrong, but as soon as she finished, Yu Ying let out a cold laugh.

“Wait for the Duchess to settle this? Everyone in the mansion knows you, Madame Zhou, are a veteran from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. You call all the shots here; even the Duchess can’t go against you. You always use the Xingguo Duke’s mansion to pressure her.”

Madame Zhou was baffled. “What are you talking about?”

Yu Ying said nothing, only silently wiping her tears.

Seeing Yu Ying’s pitiful state, Madame Zhou grew wary again. She quickly kowtowed to Zhao Xuanyou. “Young Master, all will be clear when the Duchess returns. I won’t argue with Yu Ying any further.”

Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod. “The jasmine matter isn’t urgent. We can wait for the Duchess to return for clarity.”

Madame Zhou breathed a sigh of relief.

That wretched girl Yu Ying was only causing trouble under Cui Yichu’s absence. Once Cui Yichu returned and learned of this, she would surely strip Yu Ying of her pretense!

“There is another matter that is more urgent.” Zhao Xuanyou suddenly changed the subject, his eyes darkening. “Yuan Qing.”

“At your service.”

“Go fetch the steward and the accountant. In my presence, have them thoroughly audit this old woman’s embezzlement from the Marquis’s mansion.”

Madame Zhou’s face turned ashen in an instant. She opened her mouth, barely managing to defend herself. “Young Master, please see clearly; I have always loyally served the Duchess and never embezzled a single coin.”

The moment she mentioned the Duchess, Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes flashed with killing intent.

He was a general who had taken countless lives on the battlefield. Madame Zhou’s heart pounded in terror, and she dared not say another word.

Soon, Steward Song and the accountant arrived at Honghui Hall. They listed, one by one, the sums Madame Zhou had embezzled from the public funds.

The Marquis and the Young Master were often away from the capital. After Cui Yichu married into the family, the Old Dowager also stopped managing affairs. Thus, Madame Zhou had acted without restraint, and a slight investigation revealed her misdeeds everywhere.

For the Old Dowager’s birthday banquet alone, she had embezzled two hundred taels of silver.

“You old thief, what do you have left to say?”

Feeling Zhao Xuanyou’s icy gaze, Madame Zhou knew her fate was sealed. The only one who could save her now was Cui Yichu.

She forced herself to stay calm and kowtowed repeatedly to Zhao Xuanyou.

“This old servant acted on the Duchess’s orders. If the Young Master does not believe me, he may ask the Duchess upon her return.”

Yu Ying lowered her head, a cold smile forming in her heart.

She had used Cui Yichu’s name to have Zhao Xuanyou deal with Madame Zhou. Now, Madame Zhou was desperately invoking Cui Yichu’s name; this was bound to provoke Zhao Xuanyou’s wrath.

Sure enough, the next moment, Zhao Xuanyou coldly declared, “Facing death, and still dragging your mistress into this.”

---

chapters.title: Settling a Small Grudge
chapters.content:
Madame Zhou could hear the rage in Zhao Xuanyou’s voice.

But no matter how she thought, she couldn’t figure out what she had said wrong.

All she could do was kowtow desperately, seeking the slightest chance of survival.

“This old servant has served the Xingguo Duke’s mansion for thirty years. It was the Duchess of Xingguo who sent me here to serve the Young Master’s Duchess. I beg the Young Master, for the sake of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion, to wait for the Duchess’s return before punishing me.”

Madame Zhou was Cui Yichu’s personal attendant. Even if she had committed a grave error, it would be reasonable for Cui Yichu to handle her.

But…

“You’ve reminded me,” Madame Zhou’s eyes lit up at these words, thinking she had found a lifeline. But Zhao Xuanyou’s next words shattered her hope entirely. “If I dismiss her directly, others will only think I bear a grudge against my in-laws. Steward Song.”

“Present.”

“Bind this old woman. Gather the witnesses and evidence, and send her to the authorities.”

Send… to the authorities?

Madame Zhou’s face turned deathly pale in an instant.

Even if Zhao Xuanyou drove her out of the mansion now, when Cui Yichu returned tonight, she could still find a way to smooth things over. At worst, even if she couldn’t stay in the Marquis’s mansion, she could still find work back at the Duke’s mansion.

In the worst case, there was still her son who ran a wine shop…

But Zhao Xuanyou wanted to send her to the authorities… Not only would her embezzlement be punished, but her son would also be implicated…

“Y-Young…”

The guards outside Honghui Hall were all veterans Zhao Xuanyou had brought back from the military. Each was swift and skilled in martial arts.

With Zhao Xuanyou’s order, they immediately stepped forward, bound Madame Zhou, and took her away to the authorities.

The other two matrons who had followed Madame Zhou were stunned to see the once-powerful Madame Zhou reduced to a prisoner in moments. They were too shocked to react.

However, Zhao Xuanyou’s punishment was only for Madame Zhou alone; no one else was implicated.

“All of you, leave.” Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze quickly swept over Yu Ying before he dropped these words and turned into the study.

Yu Ying’s delicate eyebrows twitched. She silently stood up.

Today’s events had completely taken Yu Ying by surprise; pleasantly so.

Madame Zhou had not only been driven out of the mansion but sent to the authorities.

In the year since Cui Yichu had married into the mansion, Madame Zhou had embezzled at least several hundred taels of silver.

From Zhao Xuanyou’s tone, Steward Song had already gathered witnesses and evidence. The authorities would surely impose a heavy sentence. Madame Zhou would either die or suffer greatly.

Recalling how she had been suffocated to death after childbirth in her past life, Yu Ying felt Madame Zhou’s fate was not tragic enough.

But… this was only the beginning.

As she left Honghui Hall, she saw the two matrons who had come with Madame Zhou trembling like leaves. Yu Ying said softly, “The Young Master dealt with Madame Zhou so harshly; even when the Duchess returns, it may be useless. From now on, be more careful. After all, this is Marquis Zhao’s mansion.”

With that, Yu Ying headed straight back to the flower room.

The steward of the flower room frowned as soon as she saw Yu Ying return.

Earlier, when Madame Zhou had come to inquire, she had already learned that Yu Ying had not been acting on the Duchess’s orders when she moved the flowers. Now, seeing Yu Ying return alone, she couldn’t help but ask in confusion, “Yu Ying, have you grown the courage of a bear or a leopard? How dare you falsely claim the Duchess’s orders to move so many flowers? This is a serious offense; I won’t be able to protect you.”

This steward was an old servant of the Marquis’s mansion and conducted herself fairly.

In her view, Yu Ying had schemed her way to Honghui Hall, clearly with ulterior motives toward the Young Master. Since she had been caught by Madame Zhou, there was no way she would be spared.

Yu Ying carefully tended to the jasmine in front of her, not even looking up as she said, “Who said I falsely claimed the Duchess’s orders?”

Hearing this response, the steward looked at Yu Ying with even greater confusion.

Earlier, Madame Zhou had stormed out in a rage upon hearing that Yu Ying had gone to Honghui Hall. How had Yu Ying returned as if nothing had happened? Had they not encountered each other?

Before she could ask further, a servant woman rushed in, muttering, “A huge incident has happened in the mansion!”

“What could have happened?”

“Madame Zhou… Madame Zhou was tied up and sent to the authorities!”

“Her? To the authorities?” Madame Zhou was the most trusted by the Young Master’s Duchess. Who could have sent her to the authorities unless…

The steward’s gaze fell on Yu Ying.

Yu Ying looked up, the corners of her mouth twitching slightly, and said indifferently, “If she was sent to the authorities, she must have committed a serious crime.”

The servant woman, spittle flying, said, “Yes! They say Madame Zhou embezzled a lot of silver from the mansion under the guise of her duties.”

“But… Madame Zhou always acted on the Young Master’s Duchess’s orders…”

“That’s why the Young Master took the opportunity while the Duchess was away to send her to the authorities. I heard Steward Song has witnesses and evidence. With the Marquis’s mansion involved, the magistrate will surely handle it severely. Those attendants from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion have been bullying our old servants; this time, the Young Master is making an example of her. Let’s see if they dare cause trouble again.”

The flower room was a thankless job with little profit, and from top to bottom, it was mostly staffed by old servants of the Marquis’s mansion.

Since Cui Yichu had taken charge, Madame Zhou had used her position to bully others, often suppressing the original servants of the Marquis’s mansion.

The flower room steward was naturally pleased to see Madame Zhou’s downfall, but at this moment, her concern was clearly not Madame Zhou.

Madame Zhou had come to her to ask about Yu Ying going to Honghui Hall, then rushed to Honghui Hall to catch Yu Ying. Then Yu Ying had returned as if nothing had happened, and Madame Zhou had been ordered bound to the authorities by the Young Master… To say this had nothing to do with Yu Ying, she didn’t believe it. But the Young Master and Yu Ying… The Young Master was known for his self-discipline and had never touched any of the mansion’s servant girls. However, Yu Ying was indeed beautiful…

She only wanted to manage her small domain in the flower room and had no desire to get involved in other matters.

After some thought, the steward said, “Yu Ying, the Duchess will surely ask about today’s events when she returns. If she asks me, I will tell the truth. If she doesn’t, I won’t say anything extra.”

“Naturally.”

“The last time, Baozhu said you only need to manage the flowers in Liu Fang Pavilion. You’ve already taken care of Honghui Hall’s matters, so there’s no need to stay here. Go back and look after your duties there.”

Yu Ying understood the steward’s desire to avoid trouble and naturally wouldn’t press the matter. She set down the jasmine in her hands and instructed, “The Young Master is very fond of those jasmine plants. If I’m not here, you’ll have to arrange for others to tend to the remaining jasmine and replace them in time.”

“I understand.”

After giving her instructions, Yu Ying returned directly to Liu Fang Pavilion.

Compared to the gossip in the flower room, Liu Fang Pavilion was in an uproar.

The maids and matrons were like ants on a hot pan, huddled together in conversation, too distracted to work.

“What does the Young Master mean by this? He wouldn’t drive all of us from the Duke’s mansion out, would he?”

“Yes, Madame Zhou is the most trusted by the Duchess. How could the Young Master just drive her out like that?”

“It’s not just driving her out; she’s been sent to the authorities. Will Madame Zhou even survive?”

“When will the Duchess return? Should we send her a message?”

“Cui Rong and the others all followed the Duchess back to the Duke’s mansion. Who can leave to deliver a message?”

“That’s right. We should just stay put and not even step out of Liu Fang Pavilion. We’ll wait for the Duchess to return and take charge.”

“If we’re driven out of the Marquis’s mansion, can we still work back at the Duke’s mansion?”

“It’s not like he’ll drive all of us out…”

Most of the servants in Liu Fang Pavilion were part of Cui Yichu’s dowry retinue, with only a few, like Yu Ying, having been purchased separately for the mansion.

Madame Zhou had been practically the inner quarters’ steward. To be sent to the authorities just like that; the other attendants from the dowry were naturally terrified.

Yu Ying had no time to engage with them. She went straight to her side room and lay down on the bed to rest.

When Cui Yichu returned, she still had a fierce battle to fight.

chapters.title: A Surprising Return Home
chapters.content:
The sky had not yet darkened when the courtyard began to stir.

"Madam has returned."

"She's finally back."

The maids and servants, who had been terrified all day after Zhou Mama was taken to the magistrate's office, finally had a pillar to rely on and perked up.

Yu Yuan also sat up from the daybed, pushing open the door of the side room slightly to listen carefully to the commotion outside.

The first sound that came was Baozhen’s scolding.

"Standing around like this for what? The courtyard is in such a mess. Do you think you're the masters now?"

"Madam, something terrible has happened! The Young Master had Zhou Mama tied up and sent to the magistrate!"

Zhao Xuanyou’s actions today had truly frightened the attendants. They had all hidden in the Lingfang Hall, not daring to leave the residence to send word, nor to wait at the gate for Cui Yichu’s return. They feared that if they drew attention to themselves, they might displease Zhao Xuanyou and end up like Zhou Mama.

Thus, it was only when Cui Yichu stepped into Lingfang Hall that she learned about Zhou Mama being taken to the magistrate.

Even though she was usually composed, at this moment, her expression twisted instantly, her features contorting.

"Taken to the magistrate? What happened? Tell me everything in detail!"

Cui Yichu’s eyes turned red in an instant, all traces of the dignified lady of the marquis’ household gone. She grabbed the maid’s collar.

"Madam, it’s..."

"Madam, this old servant has something to report."

Before the maid could speak, Steward Song hurried over from behind, standing outside Lingfang Hall and bowing to Cui Yichu.

"Madam," Baozhu, seeing Cui Yichu in such a state, though panicked inside, still stepped forward to support her, whispering, "These maids are all fools. Let’s hear what Steward Song has to say."

Cui Yichu took a deep breath, but her mind refused to calm down.

That was Zhou Mama.

Zhou Mama knew all her secrets, all her plans. Why had Zhao Xuanyou sent Zhou Mama to the magistrate? Had he noticed something? What did he want to know?

She had heard of the magistrate’s methods of torture to extract confessions. Could Zhou Mama withstand it?

Would she reveal everything? It was over, all over. Not only would Zhao Xuanyou find out about her switching places with Yu Yuan, but once the magistrate interrogated her, the entire capital would know.

Feeling Cui Yichu’s body trembling uncontrollably, Baozhu held her tightly and turned to Steward Song. "Madam has been sitting in the carriage for a long time and is tired. Steward Song, do you have news about Zhou Mama?"

Steward Song naturally saw that Cui Yichu looked terrible. Assuming it was because she had deep feelings for Zhou Mama and couldn’t accept the news, he quickly said, "I came to report about Zhou Mama. Since Madam is unwell, this old servant will come back tomorrow."

"No, speak." Cui Yichu had calmed down slightly.

No matter what, she still had the Xingguo Duke’s residence as her backing. She needed to know what had happened to respond properly.

Steward Song said, "After the Young Master returned to the capital, this old servant has been supervising the account room to reconcile this year’s ledgers for the Young Master’s review. During the check, some problems were discovered. Tracing back, it turned out that Zhou Mama had embezzled over a thousand taels of silver. Since Zhou Mama is from Madam’s courtyard, and the matter also involves her son who does business outside, the Young Master, fearing it would put Madam in a difficult position, ordered this old servant to report it to the authorities. Now, Zhou Mama is in jail, and her son has also been arrested."

So it was about embezzlement...

Cui Yichu felt slightly relieved.

"I had no idea Zhou Mama was doing such things behind my back. Truly despicable."

"The Young Master said Madam need not be upset over such a thief. If there’s a shortage of hands, more can be purchased."

Cui Yichu said, "Understood. Will the Young Master be dining at Lingfang Hall tonight?"

Just now, seeing Cui Yichu so agitated, and now suddenly calm, Steward Song also found it strange. But it wasn’t his place to speak.

"The Young Master didn’t know when Madam would return, so he accepted an invitation from Young Master Mo Han of the Anning Marquis’ residence. Before leaving, he specifically instructed Madam to have dinner first, and he will come to Lingfang Hall later."

That Ye Moqian again.

Cui Yichu felt a flicker of irritation but didn’t show it. She nodded. "Thank you for today’s work, Steward. Since the accounts are being checked, we might as well thoroughly investigate to see if there are any other pests like Zhou Mama in the residence."

"Madam, rest assured. Everything has been checked. Only Zhou Mama had issues."

Most of the attendants Cui Yichu brought with her had become managers, and none of them were clean. But others didn’t have as much power as Zhou Mama, and taking small amounts was harmless.

Moreover, Zhao Xuanyou had only ordered the investigation of Zhou Mama, so Steward Song naturally wouldn’t do anything extra.

"Madam has just returned. This old servant won’t disturb Madam’s rest any longer."

Cui Yichu gave a slight nod and turned to walk toward the main room.

As soon as Steward Song left, Baozhu immediately ordered the servants to close the courtyard gates and called in two quick-witted maids to report.

The maid said, "After Madam left the residence this morning, Zhou Mama went to inspect the back courtyard as usual. We did our usual tasks. Later, close to noon, someone suddenly came and said Zhou Mama had embezzled the residence’s silver and was sent to the magistrate by the Young Master’s men."

Cui Yichu found it hard to believe. "Nothing else?"

These past few days, with Yu Yuan attending to him, Zhao Xuanyou had been very good to her. How could he specifically wait for her to leave before arresting her attendant?

"The Young Master did this, and we all thought it was against us attendants, so we stayed honestly in the courtyard, not daring to go out and ask around."

"Useless!"

"Rumor has it that the Young Master personally handled it, and Steward Song carried it out. Even if we went out to ask, we wouldn’t find out anything. Not to mention us servants in Lingfang Hall, even the two servants who followed Zhou Mama were so scared they said the Young Master was angry and suddenly called Steward Song to handle it. They don’t know anything else."

Zhou Mama managed the back courtyard and wouldn’t have encountered Zhao Xuanyou at all. How could she have provoked his anger?

Moreover, Zhou Mama was an old servant of the Xingguo Duke’s residence. The reason her mother had chosen her to be a part of the dowry was because of her competence.

She had thrived in the Xingguo Duke’s residence, with such cunning and insight. She absolutely wouldn’t have angered Zhao Xuanyou.

Cui Yichu’s expression turned sharp as she decided to get to the bottom of it. "Bring those two servants here."

Soon, Baozhen brought the two servants to Lingfang Hall. Cui Yichu pressed her lips tightly together, letting Baozhu question them.

"Zhou Mama inspects the back courtyard every morning. How did she end up meeting the Young Master?"

"When we saw Zhou Mama, she was furious and ordered us to go with her to catch Yu Yuan." These two servants were strong and usually helped Zhou Mama manage the servants. They were people Zhou Mama often used.

After Zhou Mama came out of the flower room, she called them to help her catch someone.

"Where were you going to catch her?"

"At first, we didn’t know. We just followed her. We didn’t expect her to take us to Honghui Hall."

Hearing this, Cui Yichu, who had been silent all along, suddenly opened her eyes wide.

Baozhu quickly asked, "Yu Yuan was at Honghui Hall?"

"When we arrived, Yu Yuan seemed to be cutting flowers in the courtyard or something. We didn’t dare to barge into Honghui Hall. We waited until Yu Yuan came out, and then Zhou Mama went to question her."

"What did she ask?"

The servant truthfully replied, "Zhou Mama asked Yu Yuan why she was at Honghui Hall. They hadn’t said much before they alerted the Young Master."

Cui Yichu felt her mind buzzing. All she could think was "Yu Yuan was at Honghui Hall, Yu Yuan was at Honghui Hall." She clenched her fists, her palms filled with cold sweat, and suddenly said, "Bring Yu Yuan here!"

chapters.title: Flawless
chapters.content:
Baozhen barged into the side room, where Yu Yuan was pretending to be asleep on the daybed.

"Wretched girl! Get up! Madam wants to question you." Baozhen went forward and lifted the thin blanket off her, not caring if her clothes were in order. She grabbed Yu Yuan’s arm and dragged her out.

She knew that today, Yu Yuan had committed a grave offense against Cui Yichu by going to Honghui Hall. Her death was near, and there was no need to be polite to Yu Yuan anymore.

Yu Yuan, in pain from the grip, was also unwilling to endure it any longer. She grabbed Baozhen’s arm in return and pushed her hard outward.

Though Baozhen and Baozhu were maids, they had served Cui Yichu since childhood and had never done heavy labor. Their lives were more refined than those of girls from poor families, and they were no match for Yu Yuan in strength.

With this push, Baozhen immediately lost her balance and stumbled to the doorway.

Zhou Mama had been domineering in the marquis’ residence, and Baozhen had been tyrannical as well. When had they ever suffered such a loss? For a moment, she was stunned.

Yu Yuan had no time to waste on her. She stepped over Baozhen and walked toward the main room.

At this moment, only Cui Yichu, Baozhu, and the two servants were in the main room.

"Sister Baozhen said Madam urgently wanted to see this servant. This servant didn’t dare to delay and came without tidying up. Please forgive me, Madam."

Yu Yuan calmly and respectfully greeted Cui Yichu.

At this point, Baozhen finally caught up from behind. Remembering that Yu Yuan had dared to push her, she was furious and lunged to grab her.

"What are you doing!" Baozhu saw this and quickly pulled her aside.

Cui Yichu’s dark gaze fell on Yu Yuan.

Though the girl was covered by her sleeping clothes, one could still see the mountainous curves and her slender waist.

Her face, without any powder or makeup, was still naturally beautiful.

However, on her fair face, a faint handprint was vaguely visible.

"Did Zhou Mama hit you?" Cui Yichu concealed the severity in her eyes, trying her best to appear calm.

Yu Yuan said, "Zhou Mama didn’t hit this servant. She was trying to take this servant away."

"What happened today?" Cui Yichu asked.

"How many times have I told you to stay honestly in Lingfang Hall? Not only did you disobey, but you even dared to go to Honghui Hall," Baozhen, still resentful of the earlier push, angrily said. "Madam, I think she’s itching for trouble, trying to seduce the Young Master."

"Shut up!" Cui Yichu angrily said. "Did I ask for your opinion?"

Baozhen hadn’t expected Cui Yichu to vent her anger on her and could only lower her head, not daring to speak again.

Yu Yuan was not the least bit panicked. While resting in the side room with her eyes closed, she had already prepared her story.

"This morning, this servant saw the weather was nice and thought of going to the flower room to see how the beauty’s roses were blooming. On the way, I met Miss Feng Tang."

"Miss Feng Tang?"

Judging by Cui Yichu’s expression, she clearly didn’t know that the dancer from the prince’s residence was named Feng Tang. Yu Yuan became even more confident in her fabricated story.

"At first, this servant didn’t know who she was. She was dressed very elegantly. When she saw this servant, she asked where Honghui Hall was. This servant saw she wasn’t very familiar with the residence, so I led her there. When we arrived at Honghui Hall, this servant heard Yuan Qing call her Miss Feng Tang and learned she was the young lady sent by the prince’s residence."

Hearing this, Cui Yichu’s expression suddenly darkened. "What was she doing looking for the Young Master?"

"Miss Feng Tang had personally made some pastries for the Young Master and wanted to bring them to Honghui Hall for him to taste."

"Did the Young Master see her?"

Yu Yuan shook her head. "Yuan Qing said the Young Master doesn’t allow disturbances while he’s reading. He only accepted the food box and asked Miss Feng Tang to leave."

"She’s only been at the marquis’ residence for a day and already made pastries for the Young Master. She’s really trying her best to throw herself at him. Fortunately, the Young Master isn’t interested in her." Baozhen, having just angered Cui Yichu, was now eager to please her and quickly disparaged Feng Tang.

Baozhu saw Baozhen making another mistake and coughed. "She’s just a dancer. Madam has never paid her any mind. Right now, it’s more important to clarify Zhou Mama’s matter."

With no more interruptions, Yu Yuan continued, "Madam indeed doesn’t need to pay her any mind. Yuan Qing specifically said that the Young Master told her not to go to Honghui Hall on her own. When the Young Master wants to see her, he will send someone to fetch her."

"Never mind her."

"Yes," Yu Yuan continued. "After Miss Feng Tang left, Yuan Qing chatted with this servant for a while. When he heard this servant was going to the flower room, he asked if there were any flowers suitable to place in Honghui Hall. This servant thought jasmine was elegant and its small flowers were suitable, so Yuan Qing asked this servant to bring some over."

Previously, when Yuan Qing had come to Lingfang Hall, he had greeted Yu Yuan familiarly. So, her story wouldn’t seem suspicious.

"Was it Yuan Qing who told you to bring the flowers?"

"This servant did think it was inappropriate when going to the flower room. I didn’t dare to ask the Young Master’s opinion and was afraid the manager would say it was Yuan Qing’s idea and think it childish, refusing to let me take the flowers. So..." Yu Yuan cautiously glanced at Cui Yichu and timidly said, "This servant said it was by Madam’s order."

Yu Yuan’s story didn’t completely clear herself, but she had covered the important parts.

The flower room manager could confirm her story. As for Yuan Qing... he was Zhao Xuanyou’s personal attendant. At this juncture where Zhao Xuanyou had taken action against Zhou Mama, she would never go to Yuan Qing for verification.

Cui Yichu’s gaze flickered, darkly falling on Yu Yuan.

Baozhen, having been suppressed for a long time, could no longer contain herself. She jumped up and pushed Yu Yuan hard. "Wretched girl! How dare you falsely claim Madam’s orders? And you say you don’t want to seduce the Young Master!"

Cui Yichu ignored Baozhen and only looked at the two servants. "Is that what happened?"

"That’s how Zhou Mama scolded Yu Yuan."

The two servants looked at Yu Yuan, who had been pushed to the side by Baozhen, and recalled how she had cried pitifully in front of the Young Master.

Strictly speaking, after doing something so shameless, she should have immediately reported to Madam. But thinking of Zhou Mama being sent to the magistrate by the Young Master and Yu Yuan’s meaningful words, they still had some thoughts.

After all, what Yu Yuan said was mostly true. Madam wouldn’t find any problems, so there was no need to mention Yu Yuan’s shameless behavior in front of the Young Master.

The Young Master seemed to have some interest in Yu Yuan. Who knew if Yu Yuan wouldn’t gain power in the future?

The marquis’ residence was, after all, the Zhao family’s. If the Young Master could send Zhou Mama to the magistrate for Yu Yuan’s sake, what was killing them? It was better not to make trouble today.

"Continue." Cui Yichu said expressionlessly.

"After Zhou Mama quarreled with Yu Yuan, it alerted the Young Master. The Young Master didn’t ask what happened. Without a word, he called Steward Song over and said Zhou Mama had embezzled public funds and was to be sent to the magistrate."

"Understood. You two may leave."

"Yes." The two servants sighed in relief and quickly exited.

Only Yu Yuan and Cui Yichu, along with her two maids, remained in the main room.

Seeing that Cui Yichu was not punishing Yu Yuan, Baozhen was anxious. She wanted to speak, but Baozhu gave her a warning look, so she had to hold back.

"Yu Yuan, you have quite the nerve." Cui Yichu said neither lightly nor heavily.

"Madam... this servant... Zhou Mama’s matter has nothing to do with this servant." Yu Yuan pretended to be terrified, covering her chest. "It was truly Yuan Qing who told this servant to bring the flowers. This servant panicked and said it was Madam’s order. Please forgive this servant, Madam."

Her words made sense.

Steward Song had been able to produce evidence and witnesses of Zhou Mama’s embezzlement, which clearly wasn’t discovered today. Zhou Mama had chased Yu Yuan to Honghui Hall, but it was just a coincidence that she ran into Zhao Xuanyou’s wrath.

Cui Yichu was about to speak when the maid waiting outside hurriedly announced from the corridor.

"Madam, the Young Master has arrived."

chapters.title: As Supple as Boneless
chapters.content:
Back so soon?

The young masters of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion would never return before the curfew when they went out for feasts.

Cui Yichu silently cursed in his mind, feeling inexplicably irritated.

He glanced at Yuman, and the maid Baozhu beside him understood, pulling Yuman up from the floor.

"Go to the side room."

Yuman had rushed over from the couch, still in her nightclothes, her hair unbound. If she ran into Zhao Xuanyou like this, it would be impossible to explain.

Without needing Baozhu to push her, Yuman quickly walked toward the side room.

No sooner had she entered the side room than Zhao Xuanyou stepped in.

"Madam."

Cui Yichu heard the voice and plastered a smile on her face, walking toward him gracefully. She caught the scent of alcohol on him and asked with a smile, "Did the Young Master dine at the Anning Marquis’s mansion?"

"Their chef’s skills are nothing special. I didn’t eat much."

Yi Moqi and the others had wanted Zhao Xuanyou to go listen to music with them, but he had no interest at all. He had barely touched the food and wine before hurrying back.

Cui Yichu led him toward the warm pavilion, laughing as they walked, "It’s a coincidence; I haven’t eaten yet either. Why doesn’t the Young Master join me for a little more? My mother gave me many mountain delicacies when I returned. It’s the perfect time to try them."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

Compared to listening to the vulgar tunes of those mediocre singers, eating mountain delicacies at home was indeed better.

Hearing her mention the Xingguo Duke’s mansion, he asked about her visit to her maternal home that day, "How are my father-in-law and mother-in-law?"

"They’re both still in good health. They were very pleased with the Hetian jade Buddha the Young Master sent."

Before Cui Yichu had left that morning, Zhao Xuanyou had ordered someone to retrieve a jade Buddha from the storeroom for her to take back to the duke’s mansion.

"There are many jade artifacts in the Marquis’s mansion. When there’s time, I’ll invite my father-in-law and mother-in-law to come and appreciate them."

"They’ll be delighted to hear that."

Yuman hid in the side room, listening to their back-and-forth conversation, feeling only mockery.

If one didn’t know the truth, they would truly think the two were a loving and harmonious couple.

Then Zhao Xuanyou continued, "I’ve already reported the matter of Mama Zhou to my grandmother. She said that since the servants did wrong, it’s not your fault. You’ve managed the household extremely well."

The conversation finally turned to Mama Zhou. Cui Yichu clenched her hands tightly, her face still maintaining a smile, afraid of losing composure in front of Zhao Xuanyou.

"It’s good that my grandmother and the Young Master don’t blame me for failing to supervise my servants."

"Why blame you?" Zhao Xuanyou’s eyebrows twitched slightly. "There are so many people in the Marquis’s mansion, inside and out. How could you possibly oversee everything alone?"

"Thank you for your understanding, Young Master." Since the conversation had come to this, Cui Yichu still wanted to smooth things over, hoping to spare Mama Zhou if possible. "Is the Young Master well-acquainted with the magistrate?"

Cui Yichu had indeed noticed Mama Zhou’s embezzlement, but to keep her loyal, she had to give her some benefits.

The Marquis’s mansion had plenty of money, so giving Mama Zhou a little was no big deal.

"Not really. We’ve only met a few times. As for the officials, you needn’t worry. Nothing detrimental to the Marquis’s mansion will spread."

Cui Yichu wasn’t worried about that. She pretended to be indignant, "Mama Zhou did such a thing behind my back; she truly deserves to die ten thousand deaths. But she has served my mother for many years, and her son’s tavern is still worth some money. I was thinking, perhaps it would be better to have the yamen release her, and let her use the tavern to repay the debt. That way, my mother won’t lose face."

"The money will be recovered. As for the rest, you needn’t worry. No one will know she was your dowry maid."

Cui Yichu was slightly taken aback. She hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to shut down the conversation so directly.

Was Mama Zhou truly doomed?

She didn’t feel sad, but Mama Zhou had been efficient in her work, far better than Baozhu and Baochuan. Losing her would make future tasks much more troublesome.

Soon, the kitchen served the meal; fragrant meat dishes, refreshing side dishes, and the mountain delicacies Cui Yichu had brought back from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion: a dish of stir-fried bamboo shoots and another of hot mixed mushrooms.

Since they were freshly dug from the mountains that morning, they tasted especially fresh and delicious, very much to Zhao Xuanyou’s liking, so he had more than a few bites.

After the meal, the two took a walk in the garden to aid digestion.

Yuman took this opportunity to finally slip out of the side room. Just as she was about to head to her own room, Baozhu stepped forward, "Go back and tidy up. You’ll need to attend to the Young Master tonight."

"I know."

Back in her room, Baozhu brought her hot water. Yuman let out a long sigh, relieved that she had both taken down Mama Zhou and deceived Cui Yichu that day.

The remaining minor issues could be addressed later when she was with Zhao Xuanyou.

After washing up, Yuman changed into Cui Yichu’s nightclothes, took a birth control pill, and sat quietly by the couch, waiting.

About half an hour later, Baochuan called her to wait outside the corridor.

Voices of Zhao Xuanyou and Cui Yichu talking came from inside the room. It seemed they had both finished their evening routines, though she couldn’t make out what they were saying.

"Drink this." Baochuan brought over a bowl of medicinal soup.

The familiar scent wafted over; it was the sleeping draught.

Yuman took the bowl and drank it in one go, just like before, the liquid catching in her throat, refusing to go down.

If one looked closely, they might notice something amiss. Fortunately, her hair was already loose, and as long as she slightly lowered her head, her cascading dark hair could hide her throat and chin.

The door opened, and Cui Yichu walked out of the room, glancing at Yuman before gesturing for her to go in.

There was something odd in her gaze; not disdain, not jealousy, but more like... vigilance.

Yuman still went to the side room as before, spitting out all the medicinal soup from her mouth before heading to the couch.

Through the sheer curtains, she saw Zhao Xuanyou’s shadow already lying down.

Recalling Cui Yichu’s strange look before entering, Yuman suddenly had a premonition; tonight might be the last time she impersonated Cui Yichu to serve Zhao Xuanyou.

She let out a soft sigh, reached out to lift the curtain, and got onto the bed.

"Young Master."

Zhao Xuanyou pulled her into his embrace in one motion, "Why are you standing there in a daze?"

He had hurried back to the Marquis’s mansion precisely for this priceless spring night. He held her close, releasing all his pent-up energy.

By the time Yuman came back to her senses, the moon was already high in the sky.

On the bed, concealed by the curtains, Yuman was as supple as boneless, exceptionally alluring.

She had slept enough during the day, so now she was wide awake. Clinging to his arm, she said, "Thank you for today, Young Master."

"It was just dismissing a servant. No need to thank me." Zhao Xuanyou said lightly, "From now on, no one in this mansion will dare to point fingers at you."

"With the Young Master here, indeed no one would dare. But..." Yuman deliberately drew out her words. Tonight was the last time she could use Cui Yichu’s identity to do something, so she had to seize the opportunity and give her a big gift.

Zhao Xuanyou held the soft, delicate woman in his arms, lightly kissing her forehead. "Is something wrong?"

"Mama Zhou is an old servant of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. She has served my mother for many years. Now that we know she’s insatiably greedy, but having been in the Xingguo Duke’s mansion for so long, she must know many things about the household. I’m afraid she might talk out of turn."

"Hmm?"

Mama Zhou had been imprisoned by Zhao Xuanyou’s order. The evidence was overwhelming, so naturally, the Xingguo Duke’s mansion wouldn’t openly demand her release.

Moreover, although the Xingguo Duke held a high rank, his influence at court was no match for Zhao Xuanyou, who held military power. Even if they tried to reclaim her, the magistrate would side with Zhao Xuanyou.

Mama Zhou had followed the Duchess of Xingguo for many years, and no one knew how many wicked deeds she had committed. Since she couldn’t be saved, she posed a huge hidden danger to the Xingguo Duke’s mansion.

Cui Yichu treated lives as grass, so her parents, naturally, were even more ruthless. They would certainly not let Mama Zhou live.

Given that, Yuman could make a big deal out of it.

"I’m worried Mama Zhou might say reckless things in prison and affect my parents’ reputation."

"So?" Zhao Xuanyou seemed to guess what she was getting at, his tone noticeably cooler.

Sensing his displeasure, Yuman felt even more delighted.

Compared to the atrocities Cui Yichu had committed, silencing Mama Zhou was nothing.

Zhao Xuanyou was already shocked. What if one day he found out that his noble, otherworldly beautiful wife had a green meadow growing on her head? What would he think then?

Of course, Yuman wasn’t gloating.

No matter how much Zhao Xuanyou was cuckolded, he was still the high and mighty Young Master, a powerful minister who could decide others’ fates at will. It wasn’t her place to mock him.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou still hadn’t spoken, Yuman asked, "Does the Young Master find it inappropriate?"

"Since she’s an old servant of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion, she naturally knows what she should and shouldn’t say. Madam need not worry."

"I have nothing to worry about, but my parents... Sometimes I don’t agree with their actions, but they are my parents after all."

"Mama Zhou has already confessed to the crime of embezzling the Marquis’s mansion’s silver. The officials won’t interrogate her again. No need to worry."

Zhao Xuanyou’s influence was indeed great. Mama Zhou had been sent to the officials only half a day ago, and the case was already closed.

"With the Young Master here, I am naturally at ease." Yuman leaned against his arm.

Zhao Xuanyou merely held her lightly. Compared to the urgency when he first got on the bed, he was noticeably more indifferent now.

Yuman didn’t know if she would have another chance to speak with him under Cui Yichu’s identity. She couldn’t let the atmosphere turn stiff.

His reaction was somewhat unexpected.

The nobles of the capital didn’t consider the lives of servants as lives at all, especially under Cui Yichu’s hand, where beatings and killings were common.

She hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou, a general who had fought on the battlefield, to be reluctant to kill a servant.

Yuman took his large hand, gently rubbing the calluses on his palm from years of holding a sword.

Zhao Xuanyou indeed softened at her action, "I know you’re filial, but Mama Zhou, though greedy and foolish, will be punished by the law. There’s no need to kill her completely."

"I understand." Yuman shifted the topic away from Mama Zhou, chatting idly, "Did the Young Master only play with the Yi family’s young master tonight?"

"There were a few others. They were all childhood playmates."

"Are they all officials in the court?"

"One is in the Brocade Guard, one in the Military Command, and the other two are preparing for the imperial examinations. None of them are really official friends, so the conversation was very casual."

In noble families, aside from the eldest legitimate son inheriting the title, the other sons either relied on their family’s influence to secure minor positions or made their own way through the imperial examinations.

Before Yuman could speak, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly asked, "I still don’t know what kind of friends Madam has."

Yuman truly didn’t know what friends Cui Yichu had.

As for herself, she had followed her mother since she was young, doing household chores and farm work. When there was spare time, her mother would teach her to read. Her only playmate was Chen Da Niu, who was around the same age, but they had never shared any heartfelt words, so she couldn’t really call him a friend.

After thinking for a moment, she softly said, "There are many sisters in the mansion. When I was a child, we all played together as family. After entering the palace, I spent all day accompanying the princess, but I wouldn’t dare say I was the princess’s friend."

Zhao Xuanyou tightened his embrace around her, "Tomorrow, let’s go out for a stroll. How about that?"

Take Cui Yichu out? As if.

Yuman declined, "If the Young Master has the interest, that’s naturally good. But I just returned to my maternal home today. If I go out again tomorrow, people will talk."

"Who would dare talk if you’re with me?"

"They wouldn’t dare say it openly, but they’ll whisper behind our backs. Besides, Mama Zhou handled many things in the mansion. Now that she’s been dealt with, we need to arrange someone to take over her duties."

This reason was indeed hard for Zhao Xuanyou to refute. He thought for a moment and said softly, "It’s true, there’s no rush. Mo Han said the lotus flowers at Yuyang Lake in the outskirts of the capital are in full bloom. Another day, we can rent a boat to go and appreciate them."

Yuman’s heart stirred.

According to her memories from her previous life, Zhao Xuanyou would leave the capital in another seven or eight days. If he wanted to take Cui Yichu out to see the lotus flowers, he should be in a hurry. But he said there was no rush. Could it be that the matter of his extended stay in the capital had been settled?

That would be good news.

However, Yuman pretended not to notice. Such big news should be delivered by Zhao Xuanyou himself to Cui Yichu.

"Did the Young Master like the flowers Yuman sent to Honghui Hall today?"

"Yes, I did."

Yuman asked, "What flowers did she send?"

"Jasmine." Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat puzzled, "Weren’t they the flowers Madam chose?"

"I don’t understand gardening. I just told her to arrange whatever she thought was good. I was even worried she might ruin it."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a faint "mm," then said, "Speaking of which, Mama Zhou even went to Honghui Hall today to cause a scene and quarreled with Yuman."

"She went to Honghui Hall?" Yuman feigned surprise, "No wonder she angered you. I originally thought sending her out of the mansion would be enough. I don’t know what’s wrong with her; she’s always targeting Yuman."

"Why bully that girl? She’s just a maid in the flower room."

Yuman hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to genuinely care about her affairs. She felt a bit more confident and said slowly, "It was because I casually mentioned something before, which brought trouble to that girl. It’s not just Mama Zhou; even Baozhu and Baochuan are wary of her."

"What did Madam say?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yuman pursed her lips, teasingly holding back, "I don’t want to say."

This deliberate hesitation naturally piqued Zhao Xuanyou’s curiosity.

"What exactly did you say that makes them so wary of Yuman?"

Yuman pretended to hesitate, waiting a while before smiling, "A few days ago, when Yuman came to Liu Fang Pavilion to move flowers, I saw that she had a slender figure, delicate and charming; the best among the maids in the mansion. I thought that if the Young Master ever wanted to add someone to his household, promoting her wouldn’t be a bad idea."

Her voice was soft and alluring. Zhao Xuanyou’s mind immediately conjured the scene he had seen earlier that day.

In Honghui Hall, lush trees cast dense shadows, jasmine buds were in bloom, and the bright sunlight shone on Yuman, making her face look perfectly balanced, radiant with every glance.

She was indeed beautiful.

However, Zhao Xuanyou held the soft, fragrant woman in his arms, feeling her orchid-like breath, and naturally had no fanciful thoughts about others.

"There’s no need to add anyone to the household. Things are fine as they are."

"The Young Master just added someone yesterday."

Detecting the teasing in her tone, Zhao Xuanyou reached out and pinched her cheek, smiling, "If you’ve changed your mind, it’s not too late."

"I haven’t changed my mind. It’s the Young Master who promised not to touch her. Has he changed his mind?"

"Of course not."

The Jingyuan Marquis’s mansion had a reputation for integrity. The old Marquis and his wife were deeply in love, but due to difficulty in having children, the old Marquis took a concubine in the sixth year of their marriage to continue the family line. However, the concubine never bore any children, while the Marquis’s wife successfully gave birth to a son.

Zhao Xuanyou was not a lecherous man and had no desire for multiple wives and concubines.

His wife was noble, dignified, gentle, and charming. If they had children smoothly, he would be content to live a quiet life with his family.

Yuman listened to Zhao Xuanyou’s decisive response and suddenly felt a twinge of pity for him.

Although his kindness toward Cui Yichu was partly due to her own nightly attentive service, he had married Cui Yichu with the intention of growing old with her.

He was a good man, but unfortunately, he had bad luck in encountering Cui Yichu.
